description:
Designation: NA


Location: India Uttarakhand BSM Chowk, Roorkee


Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**1\) Job Purpose:** *Write the purpose for which the job exists (in 2\-3 lines)* **(****Max 1325 Characters)**
===============================================================================================================

  

The Branch Manager – Gold Loans is responsible for driving branch\-level business performance, ensuring compliance, delivering superior customer experience, and maintaining portfolio quality. The role leads the frontline team to achieve disbursement, new customer acquisition, yield, audit, collections, and risk KPIs while upholding operational governance. **2\) Dimensions:** *Mention quantitative or qualitative parameters that are relevant for the job and provide a better understanding of the scope and scale of the job.* **New Relationship**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Build strong relationships with local customers, partners, authorities, and community influencers to drive branch customer acquisition. **Managing Existing Relationship**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Lead and supervise branch staff including ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE; ensure productivity and performance management **Structuring new Transactions**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Ensure accurate gold valuation, loan structuring within LTV norms, and proper documentation for all new and renewal transactions **Compliance of regulatory guidelines**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Ensure strict adherence to RBI norms, internal policies, risk processes, purity testing, and audit standards. **Portfolio monitoring**

  

Monitor delinquencies, yield, tonnage, auction ratios, spurious/bentex cases, and branch growth metric**3\) Job Context \& Major Challenges:** Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section **(****Max 3975 Characters)**
==============================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity
**4\) Key Result Areas:** Writethe key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For most jobs typically there could be 4\- 7 key result areas)\- **Maximum 10 KRAs can be updated**
=======================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Key Result Areas (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)** **Business Growth \& Acquisition*** Achieve targets for new CUID creation.
* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks
**5\) Job Purpose of Direct Reports:** Describe the job purpose of the direct report/s to the job (in 2\-3 lines for each report)
=================================================================================================================================

  

* Assistant Branch Manager: Support branch business operations, supervise frontline staff, and drive daily productivity.
* Manager – Gold Valuation: Ensure accurate valuation, purity checks, risk adherence, and secure handling of gold assets.
* Gold Loan Officer: Acquire customers, drive disbursement, manage renewals, and maintain documentation accuracy.
* Customer Service Executive: Deliver superior customer experience, manage service transactions, and support branch operations.
**6\) Relationships:** Describe the nature and purpose of most important contacts or relationship (except superior/team members) with individuals, departments, organizations inside and outside of the organization, that job is required to interact with to deliver the job objectives

* Disbursement per sales officers / BM

Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.

* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.

title: Senior Manager - Compensation & Benefits
description:
Designation: Senior Manager


Location: India Maharashtra Indiabulls Ho\-mumbai


Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

#### **Job Purpose**


Support and execute compensation and benefits initiatives such as market surveys, compensation benchmarking, benefits plans, Performance Management System, payroll and other employee payout inputs, generation of MIS reports, repository creation of all JDs/KPI/KRA, audit needs, thus ensuring compensation \& benefits plans are executed seamlessly across all business units viz ABML, ABIF, ABARC.

#### **Job Context \& Major Challenges**


Job Context/Job Challenges:  

Aditya Birla Money Limited (ABML) is primarily a Broking Company, deals in Equity, Commodity \& Currency. Workforce of \~800 spread across \~40 locations with customer base of in excess of 3 lacs. Commodity operations are managed through its 100% subsidiary Aditya Birla Commodities Broking limited. ABML is one of the leading securities trading companies in the country. ABML operates in a fragmented equity broking business and has a daily turnover of close to 3,000 Crores with a market share of 1%. ABM works in a highly regulated environment with a host of regulators like SEBI, RBI, AMFI, FMC, IRDA etc. regulating its day to day operations. In addition to the regulator ABML is also subject to close monitoring and inspection through various agencies like NSE / BSE / NCDX / MCX / NSDL / CDSL etc. ABML also operates in a highly competitive market mainly in fragmented industry with ABML competition from major National Broking houses like ICICI Securities, HDFC Securities, Angel Broking, MOFSL etc. and a range of local broking outfits.
  

The Human Resources department manages the entire gamut of employee management and employee development activities for ABMML, ABML and ABCSPL. This includes Talent Acquisition, Training \& Development, Compensation \& performance management \& HR Statutory Compliance.  

  

The position is currently responsible for Three companies \-Aditya Birla Money Ltd, Aditya Birla Infrastructure Finance Ltd \& Aditya Birla Asset Reconstruction Company Ltd. These companies form part of the Aditya Birla Capitals core business and integral to the growth plan of ABCap.  

  

The Chief Manager \-Comp. \& Benefits, supports the C\&B function and will support the business on all compensation, remuneration and benefit related topics.
  

  

The major challenges in this role are:  

Providing analysis and accurate data inputs in short timeframes within defined timelines  

Ensure strategic plans with respect to compensation initiatives and benefits plans are executed seamlessly  

Support in managing compensation and benefits programs in alignment with the ABCap Compensation architecture.

#### **Key Result Areas**

**KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)**  


KRA1 Ensure accurate and timely payroll inputs Ensure timely updation \& generation of changes in salary annexures as and when due.  

Liaise with payroll team for timely processing of various employee payout inputs.  


KRA2 Execute the Annual Performance Management process with respect to data analyses in line with budgets \& the proposal finalisation document as per given timelines Analyse performance ratings, normal distribution curve and promotion recommendations  

Provide regular update on the rating summary pre / post performance appraisal to the Functional Heads  

Review employee records and ensure that information is uploaded on the Poornata system within defined TATs  


KRA3 Provide MIS \& Analytics periodically on compensation and benefits utilization \& ensure controls and Data Management Support in the analysis of benefits utilization/ cash out trends/business performance (budgets vs actuals)  

Support in the analysis of comp \& ben costing with respect to Manpower budgets for the year.  

Provide periodic \& standardised reports on Goal setting, PMS completion, etc  

Provide dashboard on various C\&B related analysis  

Provide and ensure quick availability for basic C\&B data and various analytics to aid in making right and informed decision w.r.t. C\&B and HR policies  

Ensure employee data is recorded accurately on Poornata system  


KRA4 Handle Compensation Helpdesk to support and close employee queries Close all employee queries within TAT, especially during special initiatives and performance review cycles.  

Analyse the trend in the inflow of queries, arrive at FAQs for repeat queries  

Proactively help in closing requirements related to repeat queries by sharing information to hr help desk  


KRA5 Ensure smooth management of Poornata System for the organisation to ensure that employee records are maintained and updated in a timely manner Ensure adequate documentation and updation of JDs/KPI/KRA for all the roles in the organization and their validity against goal settings of the respective incumbents.  

Collaborate on periodic information audits  

Ensure efficient data management on Poornata System pertaining to employee records

**Job Description – Product Manager – Direct Supplies \& Supply Chain**

**Role Overview**

The Product Manager – Direct Supplies \& Supply Chain will be responsible for managing Snackit’s Direct Supplies business along with product planning, procurement coordination, inventory, stock movement, expiry management, client requirements, pricing, margins, and business growth.

The role will involve managing the complete product lifecycle — from understanding client requirements and selecting the right products and brands, to procurement, stock planning, allocation, supply, monitoring product performance, controlling expiry and wastage, and ensuring profitable business growth.

The person will work closely with clients, suppliers, procurement, operations, finance, and internal teams to ensure the right product is available at the right location, at the right time, and at the right cost.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Product Management**

* Manage Snackit’s product portfolio across vending and Direct Supplies categories.
* Understand customer and client requirements and identify suitable products.
* Identify new products, brands, and categories based on market demand and client requirements.
* Develop and maintain the right product mix for different client locations.
* Identify high\-margin products and brands and drive their adoption where commercially suitable.
* Monitor product sales, demand, margins, and performance.
* Identify slow\-moving, low\-margin, and non\-performing products and take corrective action.
* Review product pricing regularly based on purchase cost, market conditions, client expectations, and target margins.
* Introduce new products and remove products that are not commercially viable.
* Work with suppliers and brands to improve product availability, pricing, schemes, and commercial terms.

**2\. Direct Supplies Management**

* Manage the complete Direct Supplies business for Snackit.
* Understand requirements of existing clients and identify opportunities for additional business.
* Meet new and existing clients to understand their pantry, snack, beverage, and other workplace supply requirements.
* Prepare product proposals and commercial quotations based on client requirements.
* Negotiate pricing, discounts, margins, and commercial terms with clients.
* Ensure that client requirements are fulfilled accurately and within agreed timelines.
* Develop long\-term client relationships and increase repeat business.
* Identify cross\-selling and upselling opportunities.
* Expand the range of products supplied to existing clients.
* Develop new business opportunities and contribute to Direct Supplies revenue growth.

**3\. Demand Planning \& Stock Planning**

* Forecast product requirements based on historical consumption, current orders, client requirements, and expected demand.
* Plan stock requirements for different client locations.
* Ensure adequate stock availability without unnecessary overstocking.
* Determine minimum and maximum stock levels for key products.
* Plan replenishment based on consumption and lead time.
* Monitor demand fluctuations and adjust stock plans accordingly.
* Coordinate with procurement and operations teams to ensure timely replenishment.
* Ensure stock is available at the right location based on actual business requirements.

**4\. Inventory Management**

* Monitor overall inventory levels across Snackit locations.
* Maintain accurate inventory records and ensure proper stock tracking.
* Monitor fast\-moving, slow\-moving, and non\-moving inventory.
* Identify excess stock and plan movement or utilization to avoid inventory blockage.
* Monitor stock ageing and take timely action on ageing inventory.
* Plan stock transfers between locations based on demand.
* Ensure inventory is aligned with expected sales and client requirements.
* Minimize inventory holding costs while maintaining required service levels.

**5\. Expiry \& Wastage Management**

* Take ownership of product expiry management across all Direct Supplies and relevant inventory.
* Monitor expiry dates regularly and maintain an expiry tracking system.
* Follow FIFO/FEFO principles wherever applicable.
* Identify products approaching expiry and take timely action.
* Plan stock movement between locations based on expiry and demand.
* Prioritize products with shorter shelf life for consumption or supply.
* Coordinate with operations and clients to reduce expiry\-related losses.
* Analyse expiry and wastage trends and implement corrective measures.
* Minimize product expiry, damage, wastage, and inventory losses.

**6\. Supply Chain \& Procurement Coordination**

* Coordinate the complete supply chain from supplier to client/location.
* Work with procurement teams to ensure products are purchased at competitive prices.
* Plan purchases based on demand, stock levels, lead times, and client requirements.
* Coordinate with suppliers regarding availability, pricing, delivery schedules, schemes, and replacement of damaged/expired products where applicable.
* Identify alternate suppliers when required.
* Negotiate with suppliers to improve purchase costs and commercial terms.
* Ensure timely movement of products from warehouse/supplier to required locations.
* Identify supply\-chain gaps and recommend improvements.

**7\. Margin \& Commercial Management**

* Maintain target margins across products and clients.
* Analyse product\-wise and client\-wise profitability.
* Evaluate the impact of discounts before offering commercial terms to clients.
* Negotiate with clients to achieve commercially viable pricing.
* Negotiate with suppliers to improve purchase costs.
* Identify opportunities to improve gross margin through better product selection, pricing, supplier negotiations, and product mix.
* Monitor products with low or negative margins and take corrective action.
* Ensure business growth does not compromise profitability.

**8\. Client Relationship \& Requirement Management**

* Meet existing and potential clients regularly.
* Understand their current and future product requirements.
* Identify gaps in their existing pantry/supply arrangements.
* Recommend products and solutions based on their consumption and requirements.
* Maintain strong relationships with key client contacts.
* Ensure client issues related to products, pricing, availability, and fulfilment are resolved promptly.
* Collect client feedback and use it to improve Snackit’s product and supply offering.
* Ensure commitments made to clients are properly communicated to internal teams.

**9\. Vending \& Direct Supplies Integration**

* Identify opportunities to combine Snackit’s vending\-machine services with Direct Supplies.
* Analyse consumption at vending locations and identify additional products that can be supplied directly to clients.
* Use vending\-machine sales and consumption data to support product and demand planning.
* Identify products that can be introduced across vending and direct\-supply channels.
* Coordinate with vending operations to ensure product availability and efficient stock utilization.
* Develop integrated food, beverage, and pantry solutions for clients.

**10\. Product Performance \& Business Analysis**

* Monitor product\-wise sales, margins, demand, inventory, and expiry.
* Analyse which products and brands are performing well and which are not.
* Track client\-wise revenue and profitability.
* Identify trends in customer consumption.
* Use data to make decisions regarding product selection, pricing, stock levels, and procurement.
* Prepare regular reports for management covering sales, margins, inventory, expiry, and business growth.
* Recommend actions based on business and operational data.

**11\. Process Improvement**

* Develop and improve processes for product selection, procurement, stock planning, inventory tracking, expiry management, and client fulfilment.
* Create systems to improve visibility of stock, demand, expiry, and product profitability.
* Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend practical solutions.
* Improve coordination between sales, procurement, operations, finance, and clients.
* Build scalable processes as Snackit’s Direct Supplies business grows.

**End\-to\-End Ownership**

The person will be expected to take ownership of the complete cycle:

**Client Requirement → Product Selection → Supplier/Procurement → Pricing → Margin → Purchase Planning → Inventory → Stock Allocation → Supply → Expiry Management → Client Feedback → Repeat Business → Business Growth**

**Key KPIs**

* Direct Supplies revenue growth
* Gross margin and profitability
* New client acquisition
* Existing client revenue growth
* Client retention
* Product\-wise profitability
* High\-margin product growth
* Inventory turnover
* Stock availability
* Reduction in stock\-outs
* Reduction in excess and dead stock
* Reduction in expiry and wastage
* Purchase cost savings
* Supplier commercial improvements
* Order fulfilment efficiency
* Client satisfaction

**Ideal Candidate**

· 0–6 years of experience in product management, supply chain, FMCG, B2B sales, institutional sales, category management, procurement, or a related field. Freshers with strong interest in product management, supply chain, inventory, and business operations are also welcome to apply.

· Experience in FMCG, food \& beverage, pantry supplies, vending, hospitality, or corporate supply business is preferred.

· Strong understanding of inventory, demand planning, procurement, and supply\-chain processes.

· Strong commercial and margin\-management mindset.

· Good negotiation and client\-management skills.

· Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.

· Good knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and reporting.

· Ability to work with multiple teams and manage end\-to\-end responsibilities.

· Willingness to meet clients and visit client locations when required.

· Strong ownership, accountability, and ability to work independently.

**Ideal Mindset**

The ideal candidate should think beyond simply selling products.

They should understand:

**What does the client need?**  
**What should we supply?**  
**At what price should we buy?**  
**At what price should we sell?**  
**What margin will we make?**  
**How much stock should we maintain?**  
**Where should the stock be placed?**  
**How can we avoid expiry and wastage?**  
**How can we increase the business from the same client?**  
**How can we grow the business profitably?**

Pay: From ₹400,000\.00 per year

* Provident Fund

title: HR Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION — HR MANAGER

**Position:** HR Manager  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Reports To:** Director / Management  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** \[Ambala Cantt]

1\. Position Purpose

The HR Manager will be responsible for building and managing the company's complete **Human Resources function and employee lifecycle**.

The role will cover the employee journey from **Recruitment to Wellness**, including manpower planning, recruitment, onboarding, training, performance management, career growth, salary and incentives, engagement, retention, employee welfare, wellness, discipline and exit management.

The objective is to build a **professional, fair, transparent and scalable HR system** that helps the company attract the right people, develop their capabilities, retain valuable employees and create a productive and positive work environment.

2\. Employee Lifecycle \& Growth

The HR Manager will design and manage the complete employee lifecycle:

**Manpower Planning → Recruitment → Selection → Joining → Onboarding → Training → Performance → Growth → Compensation → Engagement → Retention → Wellness → Exit**

Responsibilities include:

* Manpower planning
* Recruitment and selection
* Joining and onboarding
* Role clarity and goal setting
* Skill assessment
* Training and development
* Performance management
* Career growth and promotion
* Salary increments and incentives
* Employee recognition
* Employee engagement
* Leadership development
* Employee retention
* Employee satisfaction
* Grievance management
* Employee welfare
* Employee wellness and work\-life well\-being
* Exit management and exit interviews

The HR Manager should ensure that employees are not only hired but also **developed, motivated, rewarded, retained and supported throughout their journey with the organization**.

3\. HR Policies \& Systems

Develop, implement and continuously improve HR policies covering:

* Attendance and punctuality
* Working hours
* Leave and holidays
* Employee conduct and discipline
* Recruitment
* Probation and confirmation
* Salary and increments
* Incentives and bonuses
* Performance appraisal
* Training and development
* Promotion and career growth
* Employee grievances
* Employee welfare
* Employee wellness
* Confidentiality
* Company assets
* Workplace behaviour and ethics
* Resignation and notice period
* Exit and full \& final settlement

Ensure that policies are:

**Clearly documented → Communicated → Implemented → Monitored → Improved**

4\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

Develop a structured and professional recruitment process:

**Manpower Requirement → JD → Candidate Sourcing → Screening → Interview → Assessment → Selection → Salary Negotiation → Offer → Joining → Onboarding**

Responsibilities:

* Identify manpower requirements with department heads.
* Prepare and update Job Descriptions.
* Define qualification and skill requirements.
* Develop candidate sourcing channels.
* Screen CVs and applications.
* Conduct initial HR interviews.
* Coordinate technical/functional interviews.
* Maintain candidate database.
* Manage offers and joining.
* Track recruitment cost.
* Track time\-to\-hire.
* Build talent pipelines for critical positions.
* Continuously improve recruitment quality.

5\. Employee Onboarding

Develop a structured onboarding program covering:

* Joining documentation
* Company introduction
* Organization structure
* Department introduction
* Job responsibilities
* Reporting structure
* Company policies
* Attendance and HR systems
* Initial training
* Workplace rules
* Probation objectives
* First 30/60/90\-day review

The objective is to ensure every employee understands:

**What the company expects → What the employee has to deliver → How the employee will be evaluated → How the employee can grow**

6\. Training \& Development

Develop a systematic employee training and development process.

Responsibilities:

* Identify training requirements.
* Conduct skill\-gap analysis.
* Prepare annual and monthly training calendars.
* Coordinate internal and external trainers.
* Conduct induction training.
* Arrange technical, behavioural and managerial training.
* Maintain training records.
* Evaluate training effectiveness.
* Link training with performance gaps.
* Develop career\-development plans.
* Identify high\-potential employees.
* Develop future leaders.

Training should be based on **actual job requirements and identified skill gaps**, rather than being conducted only as a formality.

7\. Performance Management

Develop and manage a structured performance management system.

Define:

* KRAs
* KPIs
* Performance standards
* Review frequency
* Performance rating system
* Manager evaluation
* Employee self\-evaluation
* Performance Improvement Plans
* Increment criteria
* Promotion criteria
* Incentive linkage

Performance should be evaluated on **measurable results, behaviour, skills, quality, discipline and contribution**, rather than personal opinions.

8\. Career Growth \& Employee Development

Create a transparent employee growth framework.

Responsibilities:

* Define career paths for key positions.
* Establish promotion criteria.
* Identify high\-potential employees.
* Create individual development plans.
* Identify future supervisors and managers.
* Develop internal talent before looking externally wherever practical.
* Link skill development with career progression.
* Conduct periodic career discussions.

The objective is to provide employees with a clear answer to:

“If I perform well and develop myself, where can I reach in this organization?”9\. Salary, Compensation \& Incentives

Manage and continuously improve the company's compensation structure.

Responsibilities:

* Salary structures
* Position\-wise salary bands
* New employee salary recommendations
* Annual increments
* Performance\-based increments
* Sales incentives
* Production incentives
* Attendance incentives
* Performance bonuses
* Employee benefits
* Salary revisions
* Payroll coordination
* Internal salary equity

Ensure compensation is:

**Fair \+ Competitive \+ Performance\-linked \+ Financially sustainable**

10\. Employee Engagement \& Recognition

Develop initiatives to improve employee engagement and motivation:

* Employee recognition
* Rewards
* Performance appreciation
* Employee celebrations
* Team\-building activities
* Suggestion mechanisms
* Employee communication
* Employee feedback
* Grievance resolution
* Employee welfare activities

Build a workplace where employees feel:

**Respected → Valued → Heard → Recognized → Connected**

11\. Employee Retention

Develop and implement an employee retention strategy.

Monitor:

* Employee turnover
* Reasons for resignation
* Salary competitiveness
* Career growth
* Training opportunities
* Recognition
* Work environment
* Manager\-employee relationships
* Employee satisfaction
* Internal growth opportunities

Conduct exit interviews and identify **repeated reasons for employee attrition**.

Convert those findings into specific corrective HR actions.

12\. Employee Wellness \& Well\-being

Develop an employee wellness program covering the overall well\-being of employees.

This may include:

* Workplace safety and healthy working conditions
* Employee welfare initiatives
* Work\-life balance
* Stress\-management initiatives
* Employee support mechanisms
* Health awareness activities
* Rest and break practices
* Workplace environment
* Mental and emotional well\-being support within appropriate professional boundaries
* Recognition and appreciation
* Healthy communication between employees and management

The objective is to create a workplace where employees can **perform effectively without compromising their overall well\-being**.

13\. Attendance, Discipline \& HR Administration

Manage:

* Attendance
* Leave
* Late coming
* Absenteeism
* Overtime records
* Employee documentation
* Disciplinary procedures
* Warning letters
* Policy violations
* Employee records
* HRMS/ERP systems

Ensure policies are implemented **fairly and consistently across employees and departments**.

14\. Employee Grievance Management

Develop a structured grievance mechanism.

The HR Manager will:

* Provide employees with a proper channel to raise concerns.
* Maintain confidentiality.
* Investigate complaints objectively.
* Coordinate with relevant management personnel.
* Resolve issues within defined timelines.
* Maintain grievance records.
* Identify recurring organizational problems.
* Recommend corrective actions.

15\. HR Compliance

Ensure compliance with applicable employment and labour regulations.

Coordinate with management and professional consultants where required regarding:

* Labour laws
* PF/ESI and applicable statutory benefits
* Minimum wage requirements
* Working hours
* Leave requirements
* Employee records
* Workplace safety
* POSH and applicable workplace regulations
* Other applicable statutory requirements

16\. HR MIS \& Management Reporting

Prepare a monthly HR dashboard covering:

AreaKey MetricsManpowerRequired vs. ActualRecruitmentOpen positions / Hiring statusRecruitmentTime\-to\-hire / Cost\-to\-hireAttritionEmployee turnoverAttendanceAttendance / AbsenteeismTrainingPlanned vs. CompletedSkillsSkill gaps / ImprovementPerformancePerformance ratingsSalaryPayroll / Salary revisionsIncentivesIncentive payoutsDisciplineCases / Policy violationsRetentionResignation / RetentionWellnessEmployee welfare initiativesEmployee CostTotal HR costProductivityEmployee productivity

Management should receive **data, analysis and recommendations**, not merely activity reports.

17\. HR Process Improvement

The HR Manager will continuously identify opportunities to improve HR systems.

The approach should be:

**Identify Problem → Analyse Cause → Develop Solution → Implement → Monitor → Measure Result → Improve**

HR processes should increasingly become:

**System\-driven \+ Documented \+ Measurable \+ Transparent \+ Less Person\-dependent**

18\. Key Deliverables

The HR Manager will be responsible for establishing and maintaining:

* Organization structure
* Job descriptions for all positions
* Recruitment process
* HR policy manual
* Employee handbook
* Onboarding process
* Training and development system
* Skill matrix
* Performance appraisal system
* Salary structure
* Incentive structure
* Career\-growth framework
* Employee engagement program
* Employee retention strategy
* Employee wellness program
* Grievance management system
* Attendance and discipline system
* HR compliance system
* HR MIS/dashboard
* Exit and full \& final settlement process

19\. First 90\-Day PrioritiesFirst 30 Days — Understand \& Audit

* Understand company structure and culture.
* Review existing HR systems.
* Audit employee records.
* Review current salaries and incentives.
* Identify manpower gaps.
* Review recruitment process.
* Identify major HR problems.
* Meet department heads and understand their requirements.

31–60 Days — Build

* Establish HR policies.
* Improve recruitment process.
* Standardize JDs.
* Establish onboarding process.
* Create training framework.
* Establish performance management framework.
* Review salary and incentive structure.
* Establish HR MIS.

61–90 Days — Implement \& Improve

* Implement HR policies.
* Launch employee training calendar.
* Implement performance review system.
* Establish retention strategy.
* Launch employee engagement/wellness initiatives.
* Establish HR dashboard.
* Create annual HR plan.
* Present HR improvement roadmap to management.

**20\. Required Qualifications \& Experience**

**Education:**

* **MBA/PGDM in Human Resources preferred**
* **Graduate with relevant HR experience may also be considered**

**Experience:**

**5–10 years of relevant HR experience**, preferably in a **manufacturing, engineering,food\-processing, machinery or growing SME environment**.

Experience in **building HR systems in a growing organization** will be highly preferred.

21\. Required SkillsCore HR Skills

* Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition
* HR Operations
* HR Policy Development
* Training \& Development
* Performance Management
* Compensation \& Benefits
* Salary \& Incentive Management
* Employee Engagement
* Employee Retention
* Employee Welfare \& Wellness
* Grievance Management
* Labour Law \& Compliance

Management \& Technical Skills

* HRMS/ERP
* MS Excel / Google Sheets
* HR MIS and reporting
* Data analysis
* Process development
* Documentation
* SOP creation
* Communication
* Interviewing
* Problem solving

22\. Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be able to **build the HR function**, rather than simply perform routine HR administration.

The person should be:

* Mature and professional
* Fair and unbiased
* Confidential and trustworthy
* Strong communicator
* Data\-driven
* Practical and solution\-oriented
* Proactive
* Well organized
* Strong in follow\-up
* Good at documentation
* Firm but fair
* Employee\-oriented but business\-conscious
* Capable of working independently
* Comfortable working directly with senior management

23\. Key Performance Indicators for HR Manager

The HR Manager will be evaluated on:

* Quality of recruitment
* Time\-to\-hire
* Recruitment cost
* Employee retention
* Attrition rate
* Training completion
* Skill improvement
* Employee performance improvement
* Attendance and discipline
* Employee engagement
* Employee satisfaction
* Salary/incentive administration accuracy
* HR compliance
* Policy implementation
* HR process efficiency
* Employee wellness initiatives
* Management satisfaction with HR services

Core Objective of the PositionTo build and manage a complete employee lifecycle system—from recruitment to growth, engagement, retention and wellness—so that the organization attracts the right people, develops their capabilities, rewards performance, retains valuable employees and provides a professional, productive and healthy workplace.HR Philosophy

**Right Person → Right Position → Right Training → Right Performance → Right Growth → Right Reward → Right Environment → Right Wellness → Long\-term Retention**

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Life insurance

Work Location: In person

================================================================================================================================================================================================================

  

Organization Context:


Aditya Birla Capital Limited. ABCL is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Mar’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with 450 branches and a lending book of Rs. 1\.2 Lack Crores.

  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.

  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII.

  

Business Context:


The Retail Collections function within an NBFC like Aditya Birla Capital plays a critical role in safeguarding asset quality, minimising credit losses, and optimizing cash flows across the retail loan portfolio. It encompasses end\-to\-end oversight of overdue loan accounts, encompassing early intervention, portfolio monitoring, customer engagement for repayment, structured recovery strategies, and regulatory compliance. As a strategic pillar, collections not only protects the organization’s financial health by reducing delinquency and non\-performing assets (NPAs) but also supports sustainable growth by balancing risk with cost\-effective recovery practices across secured and unsecured retail credit products.

  

Job Context


The National Collection Manager oversees regional and zonal collection teams managing multiple products and delinquency stages. This role demands an analytical mindset to interpret performance data, identify improvement levers, and execute corrective actions across the network. The role also requires continuous liaison with credit, risk, and product teams to drive collection strategies, monitor partner performance, and ensure cost optimization while maintaining customer experience and compliance standards

  

Challenges

* Ensuring consistent collection efficiency and governance across diverse regions, products, and customer segments.
* Managing vendor partners, field agencies, and legal stakeholders while maintaining process adherence and productivity.
* Balancing aggressive collection targets with ethical recovery practices and compliance expectations.
* Aligning regional operations with centralized performance dashboards and analytics\-led decision\-making frameworks.
* Adapting to evolving customer behavior, digital repayment patterns, and regulatory requirements in real time.

Supporting Actions

 **Portfolio Performance \& Efficiency**

  

* Achieve target collection efficiency and ensure continuous reduction in delinquency and NPA ratios.
* Implement early warning and predictive monitoring systems to identify stress accounts and mitigate slippages.
* Monitor DPD movements across regions and recommend interventions for improving recovery rates.
 **Regional Governance \& Team Management**

  

* Drive performance of zonal and regional collection heads through regular reviews, target setting, and performance dashboards.
* Ensure adherence to standardized SOPs, incentive structures, and performance\-linked processes across geographies.
* Facilitate skill development and leadership capability building among regional teams.
 **Vendor \& Agency Management**

  

* Establish governance framework for empaneled collection agencies, ensuring adherence to cost, quality, and compliance parameters.
* Drive periodic audits, performance scorecards, and penalty/reward mechanisms for external partners.
* Implement technology\-enabled partner monitoring systems to enhance transparency and productivity
 **Process \& Compliance Control**

  

* Ensure 100% adherence to internal audit norms, RBI guidelines, and ABCL compliance standards across all regions.
* Regularly review operational process gaps and drive continuous improvement through automation and digital tools.
* Implement risk mitigation strategies and ensure data accuracy across reporting platforms
 **Analytics \& Digital Integration**

  

* Leverage collection analytics to design performance dashboards, predict recovery trends, and improve field productivity.
* Collaborate with the digital team to integrate tele\-calling, digital payment links, and automated reminders for better efficiency.
* Ensure consistent MIS and business intelligence reporting to senior leadership for decision support
 **Stakeholder \& Cross\-functional Collaboration**

  

* Work closely with Credit, Risk, Operations, and Legal teams to resolve policy, process, and customer\-related challenges.
* Provide data\-driven insights to senior management on portfolio trends and emerging collection risks

 **Zonal Collection Manager \-** To lead and manage front\-end collections operations for the assigned zone within Aditya Birla Capital’s retail business. About the Role

DETARA LTD is looking for an enthusiastic SEO Executive Intern to join our digital team. The intern will work on real websites and eCommerce projects and learn how to improve organic visibility, search rankings, website traffic, and overall search performance.

The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of SEO and be interested in learning SEO, AEO, GEO, content optimization, and AI\-assisted search strategies.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform keyword research and competitor analysis.
* Optimize website pages for search engines.
* Work on on\-page SEO, including titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, and internal linking.
* Optimize website content for relevant search queries.
* Assist with technical SEO audits and identify website issues.
* Monitor keyword rankings and organic traffic.
* Work with Google Search Console and Google Analytics.
* Optimize images, alt text, and other on\-page elements.
* Assist with sitemap, indexing, canonical, and robots.txt checks.
* Support link\-building and off\-page SEO activities.
* Research SEO trends and Google search updates.
* Work with the content team to create SEO\-friendly content.
* Help optimize product pages and category pages for eCommerce websites.
* Analyze competitors and identify new ranking opportunities.

AI, AEO \& GEO

The intern will also get exposure to modern search strategies, including:

* AI\-assisted SEO research
* AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)
* GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)
* AI search visibility
* AI\-assisted content optimization
* Entity and topical SEO
* Search intent analysis
* Structured content for AI search engines

Required Skills

* Basic understanding of SEO.
* Basic knowledge of keyword research.

description:

Timings: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM · Mon–Sat (last Saturday of every month off)  
About StarClinch

StarClinch is India's largest artist booking and discovery platform. Since 2015 we've owned the full booking journey \- shortlist, availability, negotiation, booking, payment, and escrow \- for singers, bands, dancers, photographers, and performers across weddings, corporate, and private events. We're a lean, tech\-first team building fast.

About the Role

We're looking for an HR Manager who can own the people function end\-to\-end in a high\-velocity startup \- from hiring across IT and non\-IT roles to building the culture, systems, and compliance backbone that let a small team scale without breaking. You'll operate hands\-on: close hires yourself, run the day\-to\-day, and set up HR to run cleanly whether you're in the room. If you like ambiguity, own outcomes, and want direct influence on how the company is built, this is that seat.

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition (core of the role)

* Own end\-to\-end hiring across IT and non\-IT roles \- sourcing, screening, structured interviews, negotiation, offer, and onboarding.
* Run fast, high\-pressure hiring cycles; build and maintain a live pipeline against anticipated needs.
* Use AI\-enabled sourcing, resume\-screening, and candidate\-matching tools to improve speed and quality of hire.

People Operations \& Compliance

* Administer the employee lifecycle in greytHR — onboarding, attendance, payroll inputs, exits.
* Ensure statutory compliance (in coordination with payroll/CA); keep policies current and documented.

Employee Relations \& Performance

* Handle grievances, conflict resolution, and disciplinary matters with a firm\-but\-empathetic hand.
* Run performance cycles and translate feedback into development and retention actions.

Culture, Retention \& Workforce Planning

* Build a culture of ownership, high performance, and accountability sized for a lean team.
* Drive engagement and retention; use HR metrics and attrition insights to inform decisions.
* Manage joiners, movers, and exits so transitions stay smooth and non\-disruptive.

Team \& Systems

* Guide and develop the junior HR layer (Associates / Interns), whenever we hire in future.
* Own and improve the HR tech stack (greytHR, Zoho Recruit); suggest and adopt no\-code tools that make HR smoother and smarter.

Requirements

* 3\+ years across HR, with real recruitment ownership; startup experience strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of core HR functions \- TA (technical \& operations), HR operations, performance, employee engagement, and Indian labour compliance.
* Strong negotiator who can convince, close, and onboard; sharp, logical, street\-smart.
* Comfortable being non\-rigid about scope — willing to step beyond a narrow HR brief.
* Excellent communication, organization, and time management.
* Proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace; hands\-on with HRMS and ATS.

Benefits

* 27 days of paid leave a year \- generous time off to rest and recharge, well above the statutory minimum.
* Health and accidental insurance coverage \- so you and your peace of mind are protected from day one.
* Startup exposure — a young, dynamic team and the kind of fast, ownership\-driven environment where you see your work land.
* Learn and own the HR tech stack \- get hands\-on with modern HRMS, ATS, and AI\-driven HR tools, with the freedom to adopt what makes the function smarter.
* Mentoring and coaching from a senior HR leader \- direct access to experienced guidance as you take on bigger calls.
* Build from scratch \- freedom to experiment and design HR systems, not inherit red tape.
* Real influence \- a high\-impact role shaping team building and company culture from the front.

**Job Title:** Team Lead \- Customer Support**Location:** Bangalore (On\-Site) **About Teachmint:**
At Teachmint, we believe that education moves the world forward and deserves the best technology. As a
pioneer in AI\-powered educational technology, we deliver a unified ecosystem. We bring together AI, a
connected classroom app, and smart hardware in one place. This ensures teachers spend less time
managing tools and more time teaching. Our mission is to transform learning one classroom at a time —
giving every educator the tools to teach at their best. Today, Teachmint’s app is available in more than 90
languages, powering educational infrastructure across 10\-plus countries with offices in Bengaluru,
Singapore, Dubai, and Manila. Discover our complete solutions at http://teachmint.com **About the Role:**
We are seeking an energetic, analytical, and empathetic Team Leader – Customer Support to lead and
elevate our customer support and onboarding operations.  

In this role, you will elevate the day\-to\-day functions of our support team from basic ticket resolution
into a high\-performing support and training engine. You will manage a team of Customer Support
Specialists and Interns, oversee customer onboarding and product training initiatives across our
SaaS and hardware solutions (Teachmint X), maintain tight SLA adherence, handle high\-priority
customer escalations, and drive continuous quality improvement across all customer support
touchpoints. **Key Responsibilities:** **1\. Team Leadership \& People Management*** Lead, coach, and mentor a high\-performing team of Customer Support Executives and Support/Training Interns.
* Conduct regular 1\-on\-1s, perform quality audits on support tickets/calls, and drive continuous skill development across the team.
* Manage shift schedules, roster planning, ticket volume allocation, and team capacity to ensure optimum workflow coverage.

**2\. Support Operations \& SLA Governance*** Oversee end\-to\-end customer query resolution across channels (Phone, Email, Chat, and On\-site support ticketing).
* Define and enforce strict SLAs for First Response Time (FRT), First Call Resolution (FCR), and Turn\-Around Time (TAT).
* Serve as the senior point of escalation for complex technical bugs, hardware issues with Teachmint X boards, or dissatisfied client accounts.

**3\. Process Improvement \& Feedback Loops*** Perform root\-cause analysis (RCA) on recurring customer queries and friction points to provide actionable insights to the Product, Engineering, and Hardware teams.
* Identify recurring customer issues and Implement long term solutions to fix them / automate them to drive efficiency and customer delight
* Optimize internal knowledge systems, ticketing workflows (e.g. Zoho Desk), and customer feedback tracker databases.
* Create SOPs to enhance team efficiency.

**Education \& Experience Requirements:*** **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, HR, Communications, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 3 to 6 years of core experience in Customer Support, Customer Experience, or Technical Support in a tech environment, with at least 1–2 years in a direct team handling/leadership role.
* **Industry Background:** Prior experience in SaaS, EdTech, Enterprise IT Support, or Consumer Electronics/Hardware support is highly desirable.

**Key Skills \& Competencies:*** **People Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to build, train, and motivate support reps and interns, fostering a culture of ownership and high performance.
* **Tools \& Systems:** Hands\-on expertise with omni\-channel customer support platforms (Freshdesk, Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, or Zoho Desk) and analytics dashboards.
* **Problem\-Solving \& Data Acumen:** Strong proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace (Excel, Sheets, Data Visualization) to track metrics, report CSAT trends, and optimize workflows.
* **Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi (knowledge of additional Indian regional languages is a major plus).
* **Customer Centricity:** Strong emotional intelligence, de\-escalation skills, and a genuine passion for creating delightful customer outcomes..

 **Why Join Teachmint?**
Be part of a mission\-driven company transforming education through technology.
Work with high\-impact teams solving real\-world operational challenges.
Gain exposure to large\-scale nationwide operations and partner networks.
Grow your career in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.  

Join Teachmint and lead us in reshaping the future of education! **Disclaimer:** *Kindly note that Teachmint Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We are dedicated**to providing equal opportunities in all aspects of employment, including recruitment, training, and**development of employees, which encompasses promotions, transfers, assignments, and various**benefits. Teachmint Technologies strictly prohibits discrimination in the workplace based on colour,**disability, marital status, nationality, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national or ethnic origins,**religious beliefs, or age.*

title: Associate Editorial Operations Administrator, Bangalore
description:
**Associate Editorial Operations Administrator**

The Associate Editorial Operations Administrator will be responsible for ensuring the smooth execution of all local administrative activities, working closely with the Bureau Chief and General Manager to provide comprehensive administrative support.


**About the Role:**

As an **Associate Editorial Operations Administrator** , you will be expected to:


* Providing administrative and operational support to editorial leadership and newsroom teams in Bangalore, including bureau administration, procurement, transportation coordination, and contractor management.
* Ensuring the smooth and timely execution of all newsroom\-related administrative activities, working closely with the Bureau Chief and General Manager.
* Coordinating visitor travel arrangements, including visa applications, cost estimates, hotel reservations, and ground transportation for colleagues visiting India from other locations.
* Supporting business travel and expense management by assisting with travel estimates, obtaining approvals, coordinating flight and hotel bookings, and ensuring timely expense submission with appropriate documentation.
* Maintaining organized digital and physical filing systems to facilitate efficient document retrieval and ensure compliance with local regulations and internal policies.
* Acting as a liaison with Facilities, HR, IT, local authorities, and other key stakeholders, while managing bureau\-wide communications such as holiday schedules and office service updates.
* Providing onboarding and offboarding support in partnership with News Support and Technology teams.
* Coordinating and supporting training initiatives, team meetings, and company events across the region.
* Managing subscriptions, memberships, and communication services (such as mobile phones, television services, and news feeds), while providing budget\-related updates to the Regional General Manager.
* Taking ownership of safety equipment management and maintaining accurate records within centralized databases, including tracking business assets such as mobile phones, UPS devices, and SIM cards.
* Supporting vendor onboarding and management, including service providers, contractors, and interns, while partnering with internal sourcing and procurement teams.
* Coordinating with third\-party partners, such as Ascent, on contractor payments, leave administration, and shift or holiday allowances.
* Partnering with the Accounts Payable team to ensure vendor invoices are processed and paid within agreed timelines.
* Working closely with drivers and transport providers to manage bureau vehicle usage, fuel claims, and the timely renewal of insurance and statutory compliance requirements.

**About You:**

You’re a great fit for the **Associate Editorial Operations Administrator** role if you possess:


* Strong organizational, administrative, and problem\-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.
* 1\-2 years of experience in administration, operations, office management, or a related field. Previous experience supporting a newsroom or media environment is an advantage.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, along with proficiency in at least one additional language relevant to the region.
* The ability and willingness to support diverse teams across multiple geographies, cultures, and working styles.
* A flexible, proactive approach and the ability to perform effectively in a fast\-paced and deadline\-driven environment.
* A solutions\-oriented mindset with a strong focus on delivering results and meeting business objectives.

\#LI\-BD1


**What’s in it For You?**

* **Hybrid Work Model:** We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2\-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office\-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* **Flexibility \& Work\-Life Balance:** Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work\-life balance.
* **Career Development and Growth:** By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real\-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills\-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI\-enabled future.
* **Industry Competitive Benefits:** We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company\-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* **Culture:** Globally recognized, award\-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work\-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* **Social Impact:** Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro\-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* **Making a Real\-World Impact:** We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.
**About Us**

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.


We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.


As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug\-free workplace.


We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here .


Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here .


More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com.

title: Buyside Contracting Counsel Manager
description:
**Legal Buyside Contracting Role Summary** – To provide comprehensive legal support to Procurement and Business teams which includes drafting, reviewing, negotiation and execution of contracts, NDA’s and other documents relevant to procurement support in accordance with company policies and procedures, applicable laws and customer requirements. Provide advisory support to procurement and business teams by driving the creation of templates, standardize the templates, maintain and continuously improve the standard contracts templates and procedures for complex buyside deals in accordance with changing laws and company policies. Develop specialized subject\-matter expertise in support area to seamlessly address any potential risks or issues.

**Specific Responsibilities aligned to Role**

* Draft, review and negotiate high value and high complex supplier/buyside agreements and similar/related documentation with Accenture suppliers, to procure various goods and services including but not limited to Contactors, Human Resources Support, IT \& Telecom, Marketing \& Communications, Workplace Support (Facilities \& Services), Software as a Service etc. in accordance with Accenture’s supplier’s contracting standards, applicable laws, and business requirements.
* Address complex contract queries and matters regarding contract negotiations, obligations and revisions. Identify risks and issues, suggest alternatives that lead to the best solutions. In this regard effectively manage the internal stakeholders such as deal teams, Solution Architects, Procurement, HR, Workplace, Finance, Marketing \& Communications etc.,
* Strategize with company executives prior to vendor negotiations and represent the company’s interests and liaise directly with vendor negotiating teams for legal point on complex contract reviews with high stakes for the company.
* Act as a point of contact from legal and work closely with the stakeholders to help them understand the contractual clauses in terms of interpretation and its applicability in the contract basis the business opportunity.
* Advise the Business from legal perspective to address the potential contractual risks that may pose as risks to Accenture business operations.
* Conduct gap analysis and create legal risk assessment by identifying and flagging potential risks to Accenture and/or clauses which are non\-negotiable. Provide recommendations to Business and other related stakeholders to sensitize them on the extent of risk Accenture exposes itself in context of the services and to minimize or mitigate such risks effectively.
* Educate and bring awareness to the Business teams and other relevant stakeholders with respect to vendor contracting practice and risk management issues
* Structure the legal transactions to be most advantageous from a contracting and business perspective and manage escalations
* Autonomously works across all categories and complexities of contractual agreements with vendor/clients deals including reviewing, advising and negotiating legal issues.
* Assign \& Manage Tasks to the team.
* Manages escalations of serious or unresolved issues in accordance with prescribed guidelines and ensures all interested parties are kept informed and escalation controlled.
* Responsible for consultation and escalation to a senior director, of contractual, business or resource positioning issues which are not solved satisfactorily by the project team in a timely manner.

**Generic Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with other functional leads, sub leads to strategize and develop additional capabilities and create efficiencies within the team
* Manage the team and performance related aspects of the team (not applicable to individuals working as an independent contributor) Supervise the management of SharePoint and communication records, ensure creation of checklists and other process documents
* Effective management of team, including execution of performance management of direct reportees, sub leads, rewarding high performance and correcting deficiencies, demonstrate ability to manage conflict effectively and achieve required team utilization levels
* Regularly conducts audit of the work done by the team members, provides reports to the leadership on the gaps observed. Responsible for ensuring such gaps are closed by the respective team members.
* Understand company's approval processes in context of the services and ensure that all stakeholders are timely engaged and informed on the relevant process including understanding the Code of Business Ethics (COBE), Data Privacy \&, Information Security Anti\-Corruption Laws and related policies and apply the same to ensure compliance and manage the Accenture deals within the procurement or Corporate Functions domain.
* Create and develop training materials for the team as well as to the internal stakeholders to ensure transactions are completed in accordance with applicable company policies, procedures and local laws.
* Work with the leadership team closely to identify and implement new trainings for the team. Lead, support, promote and implement initiatives and trainings within the group.
* Develop and implement internal best practices, lessons learnt, playbook and toolkits, and packaged knowledge on various vendor contracting and business issues.
* Stay updated on the leadership vision and developments affecting the company, its clients, and industries and orchestrate the information to incorporate it into company’s vendor contracting practices.
* Provide Legal support in the review of local \& global Data Privacy initiatives. Identify risks according to local law and Accenture policies and flag potential issues.
* Identify process improvements and effectively lead the team in developing/drafting of guidelines, handbooks, know how material, checklists and process/tools associated documents (global/regional and local) for standardizing the process.
* Collaborate with tech teams in development of new tool or enhancement of existing ones
* Drive and manage the recruitment process for the team. Act as a point of contact from the team and closely work with HR in terms of conducting interviews.
* Provide coaching and mentoring to junior members of the team, effective management of direct reports and team; quick conflict resolution, provide feedback to team members and drive talent discussions for the team
* Commit to ‘give back’ to GLN/Legal

  

**Management Level Description**

**Complexity**:

* Requires identifying and assessing complex problems for area of responsibility. Creates solutions in situations in which analysis requires an in\-depth evaluation of variable factors.
* Requires adherence to strategic direction set by senior management when establishing near\-term goals.
* Interaction is with senior management of the team, internal stakeholders third party vendors, contractors subcontractors etc., involving matters that may require acceptance of an alternate approach..

**Authority**: Latitude in decision\-making. Acts independently to determine methods and procedures on new assignments.

**Impact or Decision Impact**: Decisions have a major day to day impact on area of responsibility.

**Scope**: Might manages large \- medium sized teams and/or work efforts (if in an individual contributor role).

**Relationships:**

**Supervises:**

* Team members providing services on a process/project or account/portfolio of accounts

**External Relationships:**

* Procurement, Business Executives, Contract Management, Outside counsels, Vendors, Corporate Function related stakeholders like HR, Workplace etc.

**Qualifications:**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Law

**Certifications and Membership:**

* Contract related global professional certification considered a plus

**Work Experience:**

* Minimum of 13 years of experience at law firm or as in\-house counsel and/or in legal outsourcing

**Knowledge and Skill Requirements:**

* Expert level understanding of both commercial and legal contractual risks and displays ability to provide business\-oriented legal advice
* Fluent in English with strong oral and written skills
* Experience in managing end\-to\-end projects and teams on function specific processes and/or areas, work with internal and external teams, and understands delivery requirements
* Demonstrate excellent interpersonal skills, is detail\-oriented, has sound judgement, is adaptable, demonstrate promptness, accuracy, and consistency with the activities supported, and drive tasks to closure, has strong time management, prioritization, organizational skills
* Build trust\-based relationships by delivering on commitments, ability to work under pressure, with exposure to senior management
* Effectively manage priorities and stakeholder expectations
* Able to effectively influence senior management.
* Good understanding of Accenture offerings and function specific services performed, very good understanding of commercial agreements, legal and compliance fundamentals, corporate business practices, and contracting regulations
* Comfortable with technology and has experience in the use of tools \& databases

**Behaviours and Attributes:**

* Open to work with and understand cross\-cultures and locations throughout Accenture global organization
* Understand the value of diversity and recognize the strengths that different styles, innovative perspectives and experiences bring to Accenture
* Demonstrate inclusion and respect for all individuals regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, age, disability, culture, social status and/or sexuality
* Leader as well as team player, collaborative and persuasive; able to work well with executives and non\-executives.

**Work Requirements:**

* Travel may be required
* Fluency in English and/ other language, depending on geography supported with very strong oral and written communication skills.

title: Ethics and Compliance Counsel Data Privacy Manager
description:
**Job Title:** Legal Counsel \- Ethics \& Compliance, Data Privacy

**Career Level:** Manager

**Career Track:** Corporate Function

**Skill Track:** Legal

**Job Summary:**


The Legal Counsel \- Ethics \& Compliance, Data Privacy is a permanent and full\-time Manager role within Accenture's Global Data Privacy team, to be filled by an experienced data privacy professional. The successful candidate will combine strong legal and privacy expertise with business acumen, and demonstrate interest and experience in AI, digital technologies and emerging technologies.


The role serves as a strategic advisor to business and corporate functions globally, helping embed privacy requirements into services, products, technology solutions and operational processes. In addition to providing privacy counsel, the successful candidate will lead and coordinate strategic initiatives aimed at enhancing the maturity, effectiveness and scalability of Accenture's global privacy program, governance framework, operating model and privacy\-by\-design capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**


The role has the following data privacy responsibilities:

* Provide strategic and practical subject matter expertise to internal corporate and business functions globally on data privacy compliance, privacy risk management, privacy reviews and privacy by design.
* Lead and coordinate strategic initiatives that further strengthen and mature Accenture's global privacy program, including governance frameworks, operational processes, review methodologies, reporting, stakeholder engagement models and privacy\-by\-design capabilities.
* Drive continuous improvement efforts to enhance efficiency, consistency, scalability and effectiveness of privacy advisory processes and related privacy program capabilities.
* Conduct and lead Privacy by Design reviews for new and existing internal projects, services, offerings, products, technology solutions and other data privacy compliance strategic projects on a regional and global scale.
* Partner with key business stakeholders and senior individuals to ensure privacy considerations are addressed at the outset of new services, offerings, projects, products and initiatives.
* Conduct legal research, interpret legal and regulatory requirements, and apply a risk\-based assessment of how those requirements affect new services, offerings, projects, products or initiatives.
* Advise on privacy considerations associated with AI, analytics, automation, digital technologies and emerging technologies, balancing innovation objectives with legal, ethical and compliance requirements.
* Build and maintain strong and trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders, in particular Legal, business teams, Corporate Functions, Data Privacy and Information Security leads, and clients as needed.
* Work with regional and local stakeholders to create, maintain and continuously improve privacy review processes and embed privacy\-by\-design methodology into relevant business processes.
* Work with other Data Privacy team roles on global Data Privacy initiatives, projects, program enhancements and cross\-functional workstreams.
* Stay abreast of legal and regulatory developments related to data privacy and adjacent fields, including AI, technology trends and developments, and translate them into guidance, training, communications and thought leadership for internal audiences.

**Relationships:**


Reports to: Ethics \& Compliance, Data Privacy Director

**Key Relationships:**

* Legal, including Geographic Compliance \& Corporate, Employment Law, Disputes \& Litigation, eDiscovery, IP, Sourcing and external counsel.
* Corporate Functions, including Global IT, Information Security, HR and other business stakeholders.
* Market Unit leadership and senior stakeholders involved in privacy reviews, strategic initiatives and technology\-enabled transformation.
* Data Privacy and Information Security leads globally.
* Related subject matter experts, including security professionals, records retention SMEs, analytics, AI, technology, risk management and government compliance stakeholders.

  

**Qualifications:**

**Education:**

* University law degree (Master or comparable level).
* CIPP/CIPM or comparable privacy certification considered a plus.

**Work experience:**

* Minimum 7 years' experience in global data privacy law and practice in a global company, law firm, consulting environment or technology and IT sector.
* Proficiency in English (both spoken and written).
* Experience and expertise with major national data privacy legislation and cross\-border privacy issues.
* Experience advising on privacy risk management, privacy reviews, privacy by design, incident handling, individual rights requests and regulatory enquiries.
* Demonstrated experience managing or coordinating complex cross\-functional projects and strategic initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, geographies and competing priorities.
* Experience supporting, designing or enhancing privacy governance frameworks, operational processes, methodologies, controls or compliance program capabilities.
* Experience advising on privacy aspects of digital transformation, AI, cloud, analytics, automation, emerging technologies or data\-driven business initiatives.
* Knowledge of Information and Communication Technologies or a technology degree or qualification.
* Experience monitoring privacy trends and developments and translating them into actionable requirements, guidance and program enhancements.

**Work Requirements:**

* Limited to no travel required.
* Must have the ability to work effectively and independently with others remotely, manage a schedule with global clients and internal stakeholders, conduct privacy reviews and support strategic privacy program initiatives across time zones.

**Knowledge and Skill Requirements**

* Strong expertise in data privacy, data security and global privacy laws.
* Strong project, program management and operational skills in multicultural, matrixed environments.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders, build consensus and translate privacy requirements into business outcomes.
* Strong verbal, written and interpersonal skills across management levels and cultures.
* Ability to lead global teams, coordinate workstreams and deliver strategic privacy program objectives.
* Ability to simplify complex ideas, processes and plans for legal, technical and business audiences.
* Creative, collaborative and able to bridge differing views, requirements and risk considerations.
* Proactive, solutions\-oriented and able to identify risks, priorities and mitigation options.
* Sound judgment in applying company policy and escalating issues timely.
* Flexibility and resilience in a fast\-paced environment with changing priorities.
