title: Senior Manager - ServiceNow Technical Lead
description:
Overview:

The ServiceNow Technical Lead is the senior technical authority responsible for solution design, architecture governance, technical delivery leadership and platform quality across IT Service Management, HR Service Delivery and broader Enterprise Service Management capabilities. The role ensures that ServiceNow solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable and aligned to enterprise architecture, platform standards and business outcomes.

  

This role partners with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Architects, Developers, Scrum Masters, vendors and business stakeholders to convert strategic demand into technically sound solutions that improve service excellence, employee experience and operational efficiency across IT, HR and enterprise functions.


Responsibilities:
**Platform Architecture \& Governance**
---------------------------------------

* Own technical design authority for ServiceNow initiatives across ITSM, HRSD and ESM.
* Define and enforce platform architecture principles, development standards, coding guidelines and reusable design patterns.
* Review and approve technical design documents, integration designs, data models, workflow designs and customization requests.
* Ensure platform solutions comply with security, identity, access management, data privacy, audit and enterprise architecture requirements.
* Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt, improve maintainability and increase reuse of common platform capabilities.

**Technical Delivery Leadership**
---------------------------------

* Lead technical planning for epics, features, user stories, releases and platform upgrades.
* Guide developers and administrators through design, build, test, deployment and hyper\-care phases.
* Act as escalation point for complex technical issues, production defects, release blockers and integration risks.
* Coordinate with Delivery Leads and Scrum Masters to manage technical dependencies, estimates, sprint readiness and release readiness.
* Provide hands\-on support where required for complex scripting, workflow design, integrations or platform troubleshooting.

**ITSM, HRSD \& ESM Solution Leadership**
-----------------------------------------

* Lead ITSM solution design across Incident, Problem, Change, Request, CMDB, Knowledge and Service Catalog capabilities.
* Lead HRSD solution design across Employee Center, HR Case Management, Lifecycle Events, Knowledge and employee self\-service capabilities.
* Lead ESM solution design for Workplace Services, Facilities, Finance, Procurement, Legal and Corporate Function service workflows.
* Ensure service designs are consistent, reusable and aligned to a consumer\-grade employee experience.
* Promote catalog\-first, workflow\-first and automation\-first patterns across service owners and product teams.

**Automation, Integration \& AI Enablement**
--------------------------------------------

* Define integration approaches using Integration Hub, REST, SOAP, scripted APIs, event\-based integration and enterprise middleware patterns.
* Evaluate and guide adoption of Virtual Agent, AI Search, Now Assist, predictive capabilities and knowledge automation.
* Partner with security, IAM, data and infrastructure teams to ensure safe integration with systems such as Microsoft 365, Azure DevOps, identity platforms and enterprise SaaS solutions.
* Champion automation that reduces manual effort, improves first\-contact resolution and strengthens end\-user self\-service.

  


Qualifications:
* 9\-11 years of ServiceNow platform experience with hands\-on technical background.
* 3\+ years leading technical teams or serving as technical authority on enterprise\-scale ServiceNow programs.
* Strong functional and technical experience across ITSM, HRSD and ESM.
* Experience with global Agile delivery, backlog refinement, sprint planning, release management and platform upgrades.
* Proven experience with enterprise integrations, data model design, technical troubleshooting and production support escalation.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or equivalent practical experience.

**Technical Skills**
====================

* ServiceNow: ITSM, HRSD, Employee Center, Service Catalog, Flow Designer, Integration Hub, CMDB, Knowledge, Reporting and Dashboards.
* Development: JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, ACLs, UI Policies, UI Actions and portals.
* Integration: REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, OAuth, SSO, web services, Integration Hub and enterprise integration patterns.
* Delivery: Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, release management, testing strategy, defect triage and technical documentation.
* Enterprise Platforms: Microsoft 365, Azure DevOps, identity management, cloud concepts and security controls.

**Certifications**
==================

* Required: ServiceNow CSA.
* Preferred: ServiceNow CAD, Certified Technical Architect path, SAFe Agilist, Certified Scrum Master, PMP or PMI\-ACP. CIS\-ITSM or CIS\-HRSD, ITIL v4 Foundation.

title: Manager, Growth (South Asia & APAC)
description:
THE ORGANIZATION
The Entrepreneurs’ Organization (EO) is a high\-quality support network of 18,000 business founders and owners in 220 chapters and 76 countries worldwide. EO’s purpose is to move the world forward by unlocking the full potential of entrepreneurs. Since 1987, EO has helped entrepreneurs achieve transformational growth through the power of life\-enhancing connections, shared experiences, and collaborative learning. Guided by EO’s core values: trust and respect, thirst for learning, think big, be bold, and together we grow, EO’s international staff collaborates successfully across diverse cultures. As an EO employee, you will gain access to the world’s top experts in entrepreneurship, grow beyond your perceived limits, and make breakthroughs as you refine and realize your personal goals. EO’s competitive total rewards package, flexible work environment, and generous professional development resources are frequently cited as among the most popular benefits of working at EO.  

POSITION SUMMARY
The Manager, Growth at Entrepreneurs' Organization (EO) is responsible for driving and executing growth strategies for membership at both regional and chapter levels. Collaborating closely with member leaders and regional staff teams, the Manager, Growth tailors and implements localized recruitment initiatives to seize market opportunities within the South Asia and APAC regions. Key responsibilities include optimizing chapter growth through data\-driven analytics, tracking and assessing growth metrics, and engaging in a variety of market growth activities such as recruitment events, growth model implementations, campaigns, and new chapter launches.  

This role requires a high degree of collaboration with member leaders and staff across multiple functions and regions to leverage existing EO products and programs for growth. The Manager, Growth, is instrumental in achieving EO’s ambitious growth objectives by fostering a dynamic and supportive environment for current and prospective members, ensuring sustained organizational expansion and success.  

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES*Supporting \& Partnering with Regional* *Member**Growth Directors***Objective:** **Drive alignment and execution of regional growth priorities by serving as a proactive strategic and operational growth partner.*** Lead the onboarding and transition process for new Growth Directors, including a 90\-day ramp\-up plan, access to tools, and alignment with the Growth Portfolio.
* Prioritized Markets \& Chapter Launches Business Cases
	+ Support the development and execution of business cases by coordinating discussions, engaging stakeholders, identifying gaps, and ensuring alignment across regional, chapter, and portfolio teams.
* Provide planning support, data analysis, and operational recommendations aligned with regional growth goals and Growthcast feedback.
* Assist in the development and execution of co\-investment plans, business cases, and chapter launch initiatives
* Recommend and support the growth and development of chapters in current existing markets, focusing on strategic growth initiatives
* Collaborate with Growth Directors and Growth Experts to identify at\-risk chapters and develop growth plans to ensure sustainability and stabilization
* Work with Growth Director and regional leadership on succession planning for growth\-related roles for continuity
* Manage systems for tracking growth progress and ensuring accountability
* Facilitate timely, transparent communication between regional staff, Growth Directors, and the Growth Portfolio
* Ensure Growth Directors have access to the tools, reporting, and resources needed to lead effectively
* Support follow\-through on action items, documentation, and execution of regional growth initiatives

 *Supporting Recruitment Experts***Objective:** **Strengthen the effectiveness and consistency of chapter\-level recruitment execution.*** Lead the onboarding and transition process for new Membership Experts, including a 90\-day ramp\-up plan, access to tools, and alignment with the Membership Experts.
* Facilitate collaboration between Growth Directors and Membership Experts
* Equip Experts with updated tools, templates, and onboarding materials
* Support escalation tracking (e.g., red flags in recruitment efforts)
* Help surface training needs or operational blockers from Experts
* Monthly calls with membership – content development

 *Supporting Membership Chairs***Objective:** **Ensure Membership Chairs have consistent onboarding experience, operational support, and access to best practices.*** Manage and deliver the Membership Chair onboarding process, including yearly checklists, role orientation, and transition support from outgoing Chairs.
* Monitor chair engagement and support request patterns, surfacing concerns to the region and growth portfolio.
* Track prospect journey health and application pipeline reporting
* Serve as the behind\-the\-scenes coordinator to ensure Chairs receive timely support, resources, and follow\-up
* Effectively bridge and articulate Global growth initiatives
* Work closely with Chapter staff to provide guidance and assistance on recruitment resources and onboarding members.

 *Regional Planning \& Development***Objective****: To support regional growth and chapter development through strategic recruitment, market expansion, and cross\-regional alignment.*** Implements and executes organizational strategies across recruitment at the chapter level in collaboration with the regions, focusing on:
	+ Chapter recruitment initiatives and best practices
	+ Regional market segmentation plans
	+ Feeder programs and initiatives
* Implementation and organization of adapted recruitment and launch activities in new and existing markets.
* Collaborate with regional teams across South Asia and APAC for alignment and drive successful execution of cross\-regional strategic initiatives
* Document and analyze growth challenges on a chapter level.
* Manage the application process for new applicants.
* Integrate new chapters into the existing support system globally and within the regions.
* Track and monitor regional growth targets and investment plans.
* Execute strategies for increasing the number of mega chapters in regions.
* Monitor and stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in non\-profits at the chapter level.

 *Operational Optimization***Objective:** **To improve recruitment through MFD collaboration, data insights, event leadership, and tech optimization.*** Liaise with respective MFDs for accountability, support, and best practice sharing.
* Generate and distribute growth team reports for optimization of recruitment strategies and engagement with MFDs.
* Leads and participates in launch and recruitment events assigned.
* Optimize and suggest technology capabilities to improve and enhance recruitment efforts.

*Ad\-Hoc* *Portfolio \&* *Region Specific***Objective****: Enable the successful execution of Growth Portfolio priorities*** Gather and collect the investment plan (both rounds) for further analysis and summation.
* Support the specific portfolio stream (including chapter launches and recruitment campaigns/initiatives)
	+ Regional growth empowerment leaders
	+ Recruitment – Multi\-Channel Growth
	+ Chapter Launches

  

QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS, AND KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED* Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience in a growth or development role.
* 3 years of project management experience required, with a track record of successful project delivery.
* Preferred experience working with entrepreneurial incubators, accelerators, or non\-profit organizations.
* Experience in event management, including handling program budgets and coordinating marketing efforts, is preferred.
* Ability to interact with entrepreneurs and stakeholders with tact, diplomacy, and poise.
* Exceptional organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Superior writing and presentation skills, dedicated to providing outstanding support to internal and external stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Monday.com, and other relevant tools and technologies.
* Collaborative self\-starter with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Strong attention to detail and solution\-based thinking.
* Flexibility and willingness to learn and grow in a dynamic environment.
* Comfort and proficiency in working across cultures, geographies, and time zones.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.
* Experience in using data analytics to drive growth and optimize recruitment strategies.
* Ability to travel as required to support regional and chapter growth initiatives.

  

POSTING DISCLOSURES
Compensation: 183,250\-208,275 INR Gross Monthly Salary
Candidate Data Privacy Notice: HR Candidate Privacy Notice 2026\.pdf
Accessibility / Accommodations: EO will provide accommodations during the recruitment process and employment as required by applicable law. Applicants needing assistance should contact recruiting@eonetwork.org  

WORK ENVIRONMENT / PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS / ROLE CONDITIONS* This role is primarily sedentary/light work and requires regular use of a computer, telephone, and video\-conference platforms.
* The role requires the ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally and to participate in virtual and in\-person meetings.
* The role requires travel up to 5%
* The role requires occasional early morning/evening meetings across time zones
* The role requires lifting/moving up to 5 kgs, as applicable.

  

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY / FAIR RECRUITMENT
EO is committed to equal opportunity and fair treatment in recruitment and employment.

title: Assistant Vice President - Regulatory Registrations
description:
**Some careers shine brighter than others.**


If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.


 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.


We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Assistant Vice President \- Regulatory Registrations**

**In this role, you will:*** Manage Wholesale GB HBEU UK Certification registration requirements for employees based in the UK and overseas, in partnership with MSS.
* Oversee the registration of MSS and Research employees across relevant certification and regulatory regimes.
* Embed and maintain procedures and controls relating to the Dodd\-Frank Act, including contingency cover.
* Manage the registration and ongoing compliance of Front Office staff across a range of European exchanges, including contingency cover.
* Monitor employees in scope of the UK Certification Regime (Wholesale GB and MSS) to ensure a fair, consistent and compliant process is applied.
* Identify employees in scope for UK Certification through HR reporting and business requests, and maintain accurate population records.
* Conduct case\-by\-case Training \& Competency assessments (new joiners, movers, and ad\-hoc requests) to determine certification scope and regulatory requirements against HSBC benchmarks.
* Actively manage completion of learning and qualification requirements, including enrolment for external exams, progress tracking and timely completion.
* Provide employee support throughout the study programme, including wellbeing support, handling exam failures, and managing consequences with line management and HR, in line with HR policy (including certification withdrawal).
* Deliver governance and reporting: annual recertification, maintenance of master lists and historical records, MI/reporting for DFA/TCS, support regulatory visits/submissions (NFA/SEC), register Senior Executives (NFA/SEC), and manage the external learning vendor and exam timetable.

**To be successful you will:*** Strong English communication skills (written and verbal).
* Strong understating of regulatory environments \- minimum of 2 years’ experience in compliance, regulatory affairs/filings or a similar environment is essential.
* Previous experience liaising with regulators, or experience in a similar environment in Financial Services is highly preferred.
* Experience of training and competence processes and Senior Managers and Certification Regime (SMCR) with focus on Certification of investment banking staff.
* Knowledge of the regulatory framework relating to SMCR.
* Understanding of MiFID 2 T\&C requirements
* Knowledge of Dodd Frank Act, National Futures Association and Securities and Exchange Commission registrations
* Meticulous attention to detail, strong organizational skills and time\-management skills.

 **You’ll achieve more at HSBC**
www.hsbc.com/careers


HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. title: Director, Data Engineering & Platforms
description:
At Charles River, we are passionate about improving the quality of people’s lives. When you join our global family, you will help create healthier lives for millions of patients and their families.

  

  

Charles River employees are innovative thinkers, who are dedicated to continuous learning and improvement. We will empower you with the resources you need to grow and develop in your career.  



  

As a Charles River employee, you will be part of an industry\-leading, customer\-focused company at the forefront of drug development. Your skills will play a key role in bringing life\-saving therapies to market faster through simpler, quicker, and more digitalized processes. Whether you are in lab operations, finance, IT, sales, or another area, when you work at Charles River, you will be the difference every day for patients across the globe.  

  



**Job Overview**
----------------

At **Charles River Laboratories** , we’re transforming how we work by harnessing the power of AI, data, and digital innovation to accelerate the discovery and development of life\-saving therapies. Our vision is to embed artificial intelligence and advanced analytics across every stage of our scientific and operational workflows—empowering our teams with smarter tools, seamless data, and actionable insights to deliver client\-centric services and solutions that better serve our customers and, ultimately, improve patients’ lives.

  

This position is a technology leader who thrives at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, data engineering, and AI innovation. Serve as a trusted advisor and hands\-on expert, partnering across business units and IT to architect and optimize our Azure\-based enterprise data platform. Mentor engineering and operations teams, champion best practices, and drive automation and scalability through modern DevOps and data engineering tools. Possesses deep expertise in the Microsoft Azure data ecosystem, a passion for building resilient, future\-ready platforms, and a desire to shape the next generation of data and AI capabilities at Charles River. Solves complex challenges, influences architectural decisions, and enables transformative analytics.

  

This position reports directly to the local country manager in India, with a dotted line reporting relationship to the VP, Global Data and Analytics Officer. In addition to the leadership and team management role within the data \& analytics team, this position will also have all remote Global Tech (GT) employees based in India as direct reports, including from teams such as, but limited to: IT Infrastructure \& Support, Applications, Design \& Development, and InfoSec \& Compliance. This added responsibility is to ensure high\-level local management support to all GT remote staff in India. This position will be required to partner with local HR, corporate HRBP, matrix managers, and the local country manager on employment processes, such as hiring and onboarding, performance management, compensation processes (bonus \& salary planning), etc.

  

* This is a fully remote, work\-from\-home position based in India.
* Candidates must be able to work standard UK business hours.
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**  



* Serve as a key member of the Enterprise Data \& Analytics leadership team
* Provide leadership and support to data \& analytics team members in a follow the sun support model for building and managing data solutions
* Serve as a local manager for all remote GT staff based in India, host regular check\-in meetings with each employee.
* Regularly meet with matrix managers of India\-based GT employees
* Provide support to users of data \& analytics products
* Ensure our data solutions are secure, cost\-effective, highly responsive and fit for purpose across our extensive database and storage infrastructure
* Champion the use of data, technology \& modern tooling to optimize our solutions and provide continuous process improvements
* Assist in monitoring technology budgets and spend recommending cost optimization where appropriate
  

**Knowledge/Skill Requirement:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Math, or related fields; Master’s degree is preferred
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* 12\+ years of progressively responsible experience in information technology
* 7\+ years building data platforms in Azure with the following services Azure Data Lake, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Service Bus, Azure Virtual Machines, Blob Storage, Azure SQL Database, Virtual Network, Azure App Service, Fabric, Power BI
* 7\+ years of management experience in a technology organization with a strong track record of building and leading high\-performing teams
* 7\+ years managing data and analytics teams
* 5\+ years managing and facilitating follow\-the\-sun data operations and/or data engineering
* 5\+ years of incident management and resolution
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may be accepted as a satisfactory substitute for the specific education and experience listed above.
  

**Preferred Skills:**

* Proficiency in troubleshooting database issues.
* Proficiency in Data Warehousing \& BI Analytics.
* Experience with Infrastructure As Code.
* Experience designing and managing Generative AI systems for document ingestion, summarization, and content generation.
* Expertise in DevOps and MLOps for developing Generative AI solutions
  
  

**About Corporate Functions**  

The Corporate Functions provide operational support across Charles River in areas such as Human Resources, Finance, IT, Legal, Sales, Quality Assurance, Marketing, and Corporate Development. They partner with their colleagues across the company to develop and drive strategies and to set global standards. The functions are essential to providing a bridge between strategic vision and operational readiness, to ensure ongoing functional innovation and capability improvement.  

  



  

**About Charles River**  

Charles River is an early\-stage contract research organization (CRO). We have built upon our foundation of laboratory animal medicine and science to develop a diverse portfolio of discovery and safety assessment services, both Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and non\-GLP, to support clients from target identification through preclinical development. Charles River also provides a suite of products and services to support our clients’ clinical laboratory testing needs and manufacturing activities. Utilizing this broad portfolio of products and services enables our clients to create a more flexible drug development model, which reduces their costs, enhances their productivity and effectiveness to increase speed to market.  

  



  

With over 20,000 employees within 110 facilities in 20 countries around the globe, we are strategically positioned to coordinate worldwide resources and apply multidisciplinary perspectives in resolving our client’s unique challenges. Our client base includes global pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, government agencies and hospitals and academic institutions around the world.  

  



At Charles River, we are passionate about our role in improving the quality of people’s lives. Our mission, our excellent science and our strong sense of purpose guide us in all that we do, and we approach each day with the knowledge that our work helps to improve the health and well\-being of many across the globe. We have proudly worked on 80% of the drugs approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in the past five years.

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Charles River Laboratories is an Equal Opportunity Employer \- M/F/Disabled/Vet.

  

If you are interested in applying to Charles River Laboratories and need special assistance or an accommodation due to a disability to complete any forms or to otherwise participate in the resume submission process, please contact a member of our Human Resources team by sending an e\-mail message to crrecruitment\_US@crl.com. This contact is for accommodation requests for individuals with disabilities only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

  

For more information, please visit www.criver.com.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in a customer or client\-facing support role in operations management.
* 5 years of experience building relationships with stakeholders or clients.
* 5 years of experience identifying issues in processes and creating solutions, and working with cross\-functional teams to drive these changes.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* MBA or Master's degree.
* Certification in Operations Six Sigma, COPC, Lean, or other relevant operations coursework.
* 5 years of experience analyzing data and generating business insights in order to guide business decisions.
* Experience using tech and analytics tools, with knowledge on SQL.
* Experience leading operational transformations with a focus on AI automation, process re\-engineering (e.g., Six Sigma, Lean) and change management.

**About the job**
-----------------


gTech Ads is responsible for all support and media and technical services for customers big and small across our entire Ad products stack. We help our customers get the most out of our Ad and Publisher products and guide them when they need help. We provide a range of services from enabling better self help and in\-product support, to providing better support through interactions, setting up accounts and implementing ad campaigns, and providing media solutions for customers business and marketing needs and providing complex technical and measurement solutions along with consultative support for our large customers. These solutions range from bespoke and customized ones for our customers to scalable support for millions of customers worldwide. Based on the evolving needs of our ads customers, we partner with Sales, Product and Engineering teams within Google to develop better solutions, tools, and services to improve our products and enhance our client experience. As a cross\-functional and global team, we ensure our customers get the best return on investment with Google and we remain a trusted partner.

  


As the Scaled Delivery Manager, you will manage operations serving Google’s customers at scale. You will be responsible for working closely with managed service partners as well as Googlers in gTech, LCS, and GCS. You will manage vendor service providers to deliver performance seamlessly, meet metrics, and ensure business continuity driving operations with an AI first mindset.


The Global Business Organization (GBO) is the engine that powers Google’s full ecosystem of products and services to help customers and partners succeed and grow. GBO includes the commercial arms of Ads sellers, business development teams, and customer services and support, as well as overlay programs that enable coordinated engagement with Google's most complex and important customers and partners.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead operations, inspire vendor teams, and enable an ecosystem of vendors/partner teams and support specialists to deliver positive customer experiences.
* Optimize and maintain processes, ensuring comprehensive training and resources.
* Drive impact through efficiency driven by AI, automation leading to reduced effort, and positive interactions.
* Collaborate with a set of cross\-functional stakeholders and manage multiple relationships across global vendor management teams, sourcing teams, strategy and operations, tools and automation, HR, legal and finance.
* Deliver Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), maintain infrastructure, and secure budgets. Collaborate with stakeholders, support vendors, and advocate for operational needs.

title: Consultant Talent Acquisition
description:
**Job ID** R.0061672 **Primary location** Bengaluru, Karnataka **Date posted** 08/18/2026 **Worker type** Regular **Workplace flexibility** Hybrid Save


Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well\-being, and work\-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.


Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.


**What You Will Do**


* Partner with HR Business Partners and hiring managers as a trusted advisor to understand current and anticipated talent needs and develop effective recruitment strategies for IT and non\-IT positions.
* Manage full\-cycle recruitment for professional and management\-level positions, from intake and strategic sourcing through candidate assessment, selection, and offer support.
* Establish and maintain effective communication with hiring managers and key stakeholders, align on service expectations, and deliver recruiting support that meets business needs.
* Develop and maintain talent pipelines through strategic sourcing, effective job postings, employee referrals, social media, job boards, proactive outreach, and other recruitment channels in accordance with organizational guidelines and recruiting best practices.
* Provide hiring managers with talent\-market insights and sourcing recommendations to support effective recruitment and selection decisions.
* Coach and advise hiring leaders on recruitment and selection practices that promote a positive candidate experience and support objective decision\-making.
* Use Workday Recruiting to manage requisitions, candidate activity, recruiting workflows, and talent pipelines throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
* Support employer\-branding initiatives through professional engagement with employment\-focused social media platforms, job boards, and other recruiting channels.
* Build and maintain relationships with prospective candidates and effectively communicate the organization's employment value proposition and career opportunities.
* Share Talent Acquisition best practices, emerging recruiting approaches, market trends, and industry insights with colleagues and stakeholders.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives designed to increase the effectiveness and efficiency of Talent Acquisition and Human Resources processes.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**What You Will Bring**


* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
* 8–10 years of related Talent Acquisition/recruiting experience, including experience partnering with hiring managers and HR stakeholders to develop and execute recruitment strategies.
* Demonstrated experience managing full\-cycle recruitment across both IT and non\-IT roles, including professional and management\-level positions, from intake and strategic sourcing through candidate assessment, selection, and offer support.
* Experience developing and executing strategic sourcing strategies and building talent pipelines for IT and non\-IT professional and management\-level positions using multiple sourcing channels.
* Demonstrated experience serving as a trusted advisor to hiring managers and HR Business Partners throughout the recruitment and selection process, including providing talent\-market insights, sourcing strategies, candidate assessment guidance, and hiring recommendations.
* Experience using Workday Recruiting or a comparable applicant tracking system (ATS) to manage requisitions, candidates, recruiting workflows, and talent pipelines.
* Experience using candidate sourcing platforms, job boards, social recruiting tools, and other recruiting technologies.
* Demonstrated ability to anticipate and resolve recruiting challenges at both strategic and operational levels.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills with a demonstrated ability to build effective relationships with hiring managers, HR partners, candidates, peers, and other stakeholders.
* Strong customer and stakeholder focus with the ability to provide consultative Talent Acquisition support.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and recruitment activities effectively in a dynamic environment.

**What Will Set You Apart**


* Experience providing Talent Acquisition consultation and recruiting expertise across a broad range of IT and non\-IT functions.
* Experience recruiting for complex, specialized, or hard\-to\-fill professional and management\-level positions.
* Advanced experience with Workday Recruiting and the effective use of recruiting technology to manage candidate pipelines and recruitment workflows.
* Experience using talent\-market intelligence, sourcing insights, and recruiting data to inform recruitment strategies.
* Demonstrated ability to share Talent Acquisition best practices, guide colleagues, and serve as a subject\-matter expert.
* Experience supporting employer branding, recruitment marketing, campus recruiting, job fairs, or other talent\-engagement initiatives.

Major Deliverables\-
  
  

**Talent/Capability Gap Assessment:** Lead a top\-down and bottom\-up diagnostic of current capability and talent gaps, across both flying and non\-flying roles, with clear recommendations for action.
  
**Design \& Institutionalization of Talent Management Processes:** Develop and embed systems for talent review, internal mobility, succession planning, HiPo identification, and career pathing.
  
**Succession Planning:** Establish succession frameworks for mission\-critical roles with defined success profiles, development plans, and readiness assessments.
  
**Talent Refresh Strategy:** Design and implement mechanisms to ensure the organisation remains agile with regular talent inflow, outflow, and upskilling.
  
**Leadership Bench Strength Building:** Partner with Capability \& Culture and Performance COEs to develop future leaders aligned to business strategy.
  
**HR Operating Rhythm Integration:** Embed Talent Management into the regular operating rhythm of HR and line reviews (e.g., quarterly talent reviews).
  
**Data \& Insights:** Build dashboards and insights that translate talent data into actionable intelligence for the business and CHRO.
  
**Change Enablement:** Position Talent Management as a credible and value\-adding function in a resistant and legacy\-led environment.
  
**Leadership Hiring:** Lead end\-to\-end leadership hiring initiatives, partnering closely with senior leadership and key stakeholders to drive timely closure of critical leadership positions.
  
  

Essential Behavioural Attributes\-
  
  

**Execution Excellence:** Strong bias for action and focus on delivering outcomes within tight timelines and shifting priorities.
  
**Stakeholder Management:** Ability to engage, influence, and align resistant stakeholders—including pilots, legacy employees, and territorial functions.
  
**Resilience \& Tenacity:** Grit to thrive in an unsupportive, often hostile, cross\-functional environment.
  
**Credibility \& Confidence:** Gravitas to stand ground and push best practices despite opposition or cultural inertia.
  
**Collaboration without Dependency:** Able to create alliances, drive results, and move initiatives forward without formal authority.
  
**Strategic Thinking with Operational Focus:** Ability to think in systems and long\-term, while anchoring initiatives in business reality.
  
**Learning Agility:** Constant learner who adapts quickly to industry nuances and brings in external best practices judiciously.
  
  

Desirable Behavioural Attributes\-
  
  

**Political Savvy:** Ability to read the room, navigate power structures, and find alternate routes to achieve goals.
  
**Influencing through Data:** Use of metrics and talent insights to persuade stakeholders and establish fact\-based decisions.
  
**Empathy with Edge:** Balance between being people\-centric and holding a high bar for performance.
  
**Innovative Mindset:** Willingness to challenge legacy thinking and bring in bold, yet business\-aligned solutions.
  
**Enterprise View:** Preference for what's best for the airline over siloed functional success.
  
  

Education and Skill set \-
  
  

Minimum 6\+ Yrs. of experience in Talent Management role from Tier 1 B\-school background
  
Strategic alliance and partnering
  
Industry experience will be preferred

title: Head - HR Business Partner
description:
**Location:**  

., IN
  
  

**\#job\-location.job\-location\-inline { display:** inline; }
  
Aug 18, 2026
  
  

Role Purpose
  
  

The Head– HR Business Partner will lead the people agenda for an assigned business cohort, acting as a strategic advisor to leadership while ensuring robust execution through a team of HR Partners. The role is responsible for driving people strategy, building an engaged and future\-ready workforce, enabling performance and talent outcomes, strengthening capability and capacity, and shaping culture and change journeys across the cohort.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

1\) People Strategy for the Cohort
  
  

Partner with business leadership to define and execute People Strategy, aligned to business goals.
  
Build workforce plans (capacity, capability, succession, critical roles) and align hiring, redeployment, and build/buy/borrow strategies.
  
Establish quarterly people reviews with leadership; track progress through dashboards and OKRs.
  
Integrate DEI objectives, future skills, digital adoption, and cost\-to\-serve efficiency into the people plan.
  
  

2\) Business Partnering \& Building an Engaged Workforce
  
  

Serve as a trusted advisor to BU heads and line leaders, influence decisions with data, insights, and external benchmarks.
  
Drive engagement strategy for the cohort—manager enablement, recognition, communication cadence, and inclusion initiatives.
  
Use listening to mechanisms (engagement surveys, eNPS) to identify hotspots; run action plans with owners and timelines.
  
Partner with COEs (TA, L\&D, C\&B, ER) to ensure cohesive solutions; ensure timely delivery of HR processes across the employee lifecycle.
  
  

3\) Performance \& Talent Management
  
  

Orchestrate the annual and mid\-year performance cycles; ensure calibration quality, fairness, and linkage to rewards.
  
Lead talent reviews and succession planning for critical roles; maintain healthy bench strength and ready\-now pipelines.
  
Identify skill gaps; design and deploy cohort\-wide capability programs (technical, leadership, managerial effectiveness) with measurable impact.
  
Enable Career Pathing, IDPs, and mobility pathways (internal marketplace, cross\-functional moves, stretch assignments).
  
Partner with TA on strategic hiring and internal movement to address capacity constraints and attrition risk.
  
  

4\) Culture \& Change Management
  
  

Lead as a Culture and Change Architect, embedding culture in collaboration with the business through defined rituals, leadership behaviours, and governance mechanisms
  
Lead change programs—org design changes, restructuring, digitization—ensuring change readiness, communication, and adoption.
  
Drive ethical practices and compliance; ensure consistent and fair application of policies and code of conduct.
  
  

5\) Leadership of HRBP Team
  
  

Lead and mentor a team of HR Partners while overseeing\-
  
**Employee Relations \& Grievance Management:** Timely resolution, root\-cause correction, case tracking, and preventive controls.
  
**Disciplinary Actions:** End\-to\-end management aligned with policies and statutory compliance.
  
**HR Processes:** Onboarding, confirmation, transfers, payroll inputs, exits, and documentation with SLA and accuracy controls.
  
**Employee Pulse:** Run periodic pulses, stay interviews, exit analytics; convert insights into actions, working as eyes and ears of the organization.
  
Build a high\-performing HR team via setting goals, reviewing performance, uplifting capability, and ownership.
  
  

Qualifications \& Experience
  
  

**Education:** MBA/PGDM in HR or equivalent.
  
**Experience:** 12–15 years total HR experience with at least 8\+ years in HR Business Partnering; prior team leadership experience is essential.
  
Experience in talent management, organization design, employee relations, and change management.
  
Airline Industry experience is preferred.
  
  

Skills \& Competencies
  
  

**Business Acumen \& Data Fluency:** Ability to link people levers to P\&L, productivity, and risk; strong use of analytics and dashboards.
  
**Influence \& Stakeholder Management:** Credible advisor to senior leadership; conflict resolution and negotiation skills.
  
**ER \& Policy Governance:** Solid understanding of labour laws and disciplinary protocols; risk mitigation mindset.
  
**Capability Building:** Designing and measuring learning impact; future\-skilling.
  
**Change Leadership:** Communication planning, adoption strategies, and cultural transformation.
  
**People Leadership:** Coaching, performance management, and talent growth of HR teams.
  
**Tools:** HRIS (e.g., SAP/SuccessFactors), engagement tools, survey platforms, Excel/Power BI.

Cricket is a sport built on conversations, CommBox is a new player in that field.

You will work closely with the marketing and leadership team to research potential brands, identify relevant decision\-makers, build prospect databases, conduct outreach, and support the development of brand partnerships and sponsorship opportunities.

This is a **high\-ownership role** where you will be expected to take initiative, experiment with different outreach strategies, and actively contribute to CommBox's business growth.

* Schedule meetings between interested brands and the CommBox team.

**Email \& Communication**

* Write professional and personalized brand partnership emails.
* Develop different outreach messages based on the brand and its marketing objectives.
* Follow up with prospects professionally without being repetitive.
* Communicate CommBox's value proposition clearly to potential partners.

**Marketing Responsibilities**

* Support marketing campaigns and brand partnership initiatives.
* Research market trends, competitors, and potential partnership opportunities.
* Assist in identifying new customer and brand segments.
* Help develop marketing ideas and campaigns targeted at cricket audiences.
* Track outreach metrics such as:
* Number of brands researched
* Contacts identified
* Emails sent
* Calls completed
* Responses received
* Meetings scheduled
* Partnerships generated
* Analyze outreach performance and suggest ways to improve conversion.

**Partnership Support**

* Assist the team in preparing brand partnership proposals and presentations.
* Research potential sponsorship opportunities around cricket events, tournaments, creators, and content.
* Coordinate with internal teams to support partnership execution.
* Maintain professional relationships with prospects and partners.

**Required SkillsMarketing Skills**

* Basic understanding of digital marketing.
* Understanding of brand positioning and target audiences.
* Market research and competitor research.
* Lead generation.
* Basic understanding of customer acquisition and conversion.

**Business Development Skills**

* Lead generation and prospecting.
* Cold calling.
* Cold emailing.
* LinkedIn outreach.
* Relationship building.
* Follow\-up and pipeline management.
* Basic sales and negotiation understanding.

**Research \& Data Skills**

* Excellent internet research skills.
* Ability to find relevant company and decision\-maker information.
* Good working knowledge of **Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel**.
* Ability to organize and maintain large prospect databases.
* Attention to detail while collecting contact information.

**Communication Skills**

* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Strong English communication skills.

**Good to have:** LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, CRM tools, Canva, or email outreach tools.

**What We're Looking For**

description:
PTKInfoTech is looking for highly motivated and technically strong freshers who have **excellent knowledge of Python and JavaScript** and are interested in building a career in **Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML)**.

This is not a traditional internship where you are only expected to perform basic tasks. We are looking for candidates with strong programming fundamentals who are willing to learn, experiment, solve real\-world problems, and grow into professional AI/ML developers.

PTKInfoTech will provide structured learning, mentoring, and practical exposure to **AI, Machine Learning, automation, APIs, data processing, and modern software development technologies**.

What You Will Do

* Work on real\-world Python and JavaScript development projects.
* Develop and maintain applications, APIs, scripts, and automation solutions.
* Learn and implement Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning concepts.
* Work with AI/ML libraries, frameworks, APIs, and modern development tools.
* Assist in developing AI\-powered applications and automation solutions.
* Debug, test, optimize, and improve existing applications.
* Work with databases, APIs, JSON, and third\-party services.
* Research new AI technologies and development approaches.
* Collaborate with senior developers and technical team members.
* Gradually take ownership of development tasks as your technical skills improve.

What We Are Looking ForMust Have

* **Excellent knowledge of Python**.
* **Excellent knowledge of JavaScript**.
* Strong understanding of programming fundamentals.
* Good knowledge of Object\-Oriented Programming concepts.
* Understanding of functions, classes, arrays/objects, loops, conditions, and error handling.
* Ability to write clean and logically structured code.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Basic understanding of Git/version control.
* Good understanding of APIs and JSON.
* Strong willingness to learn new technologies.
* Ability to learn independently and research solutions.

Good to Have

* Basic knowledge of Machine Learning.
* Basic knowledge of AI or Generative AI.
* Experience with Python libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, or similar.
* Knowledge of Flask, FastAPI, Node.js, React, or similar technologies.
* Basic SQL/database knowledge.
* Experience with GitHub or other version\-control platforms.
* Personal projects, GitHub repositories, or coding projects.

**Freshers are welcome, but strong programming knowledge is mandatory.**

AI \& Machine Learning Learning Opportunity

One of the major benefits of this position is the opportunity to learn **AI and Machine Learning while working with the company**.

Candidates who demonstrate strong programming ability will receive guidance and practical exposure to areas such as:

* Artificial Intelligence fundamentals
* Machine Learning fundamentals
* Generative AI
* LLMs and AI APIs
* AI\-powered applications
* Python AI/ML ecosystem
* Data processing and analysis
* Automation using AI
* Prompt engineering
* Vector databases and embeddings
* RAG\-based applications
* AI agents and automation
* Integration of AI into real\-world business applications

The goal is to help a strong developer transition into a **professional AI/ML\-focused development role**.

Paid Contract \& Long\-Term Career Opportunity

This position includes a **paid employment contract**.

The initial period will focus on learning, technical training, mentoring, and practical project experience. Once the candidate successfully completes the initial learning and evaluation period, the expectation is that the candidate will continue working with PTKInfoTech for **at least 2 years**, subject to the mutually agreed employment contract.

This structure is designed to provide both:

**For the candidate:**  
A structured path from strong programming fundamentals → professional development → AI/ML expertise → long\-term career growth.

**For PTKInfoTech:**  
The opportunity to invest in and develop talented programmers who can become valuable long\-term members of the AI/software development team.

All contract terms, compensation, learning period, and long\-term employment conditions will be clearly discussed with the selected candidate before joining.

Who Should Apply?

This role is ideal for someone who:

* Is a recent graduate or is starting their professional career.
* Has spent significant time learning Python and JavaScript.
* Can write code independently rather than only following tutorials.
* Enjoys solving programming problems.
* Is genuinely interested in AI and Machine Learning.
* Wants to build a career in software development and AI.
* Is willing to make a long\-term commitment to learning and working with the company.
* Has personal projects or GitHub work that demonstrates their programming ability.

Important

**This is not a basic internship or training\-only position.**

We are specifically looking for candidates who already have a **strong foundation in Python and JavaScript**.

You do not need to be an AI/ML expert when you join. **We will help you learn AI and Machine Learning.**

What we expect from you is strong programming ability, curiosity, dedication, and the willingness to learn.

Why Join PTKInfoTech?

* Paid position.
* Structured technical learning.
* AI \& Machine Learning training and mentoring.
* Opportunity to work on real\-world projects.
* Exposure to modern AI technologies.
* Opportunity to work alongside experienced developers.
* Long\-term career opportunity.
* Opportunity to grow from a developer into an AI/ML\-focused engineer.

How to Apply

* Your GitHub profile, if available.

* A brief description of your strongest Python project.
* A brief description of your strongest JavaScript project.
* Why you are interested in learning AI and Machine Learning.

About the Role

Elixa Technologies is looking for a **Service Engineer – Field Service** to support the installation, operation, monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization of water treatment and automation programs at customer sites.

The role will involve regular travel to customer locations across Kerala, including **commercial buildings, industrial facilities, hospitals, hotels, data centers, and other large HVAC installations**.

The ideal candidate should be technically sound, comfortable working at customer sites, willing to travel extensively, and capable of independently handling routine service activities as well as troubleshooting and technical support.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct regular **site visits and field service activities** at customer locations across Kerala.
* Monitor and test **chilled water and cooling water quality** using appropriate testing equipment and procedures.
* Carry out routine water analysis and maintain accurate records of test results and site parameters.
* Monitor the performance of **chilled water treatment and HVAC water treatment programs**.
* Identify deviations in water quality, system performance, chemical dosing, and operating parameters.
* Troubleshoot issues related to **water treatment, dosing systems, sensors, controllers, and automation systems**.
* Support the installation, commissioning, calibration, and maintenance of **water monitoring and automation equipment**.
* Collect operating data from customer sites and prepare **service reports, test reports, and technical recommendations**.
* Analyze site data and recommend corrective actions to improve system efficiency and water quality.
* Ensure that chemical dosing and treatment programs are operating within recommended parameters.
* Provide technical support and guidance to customers and coordinate with their engineering and maintenance teams.
* Work closely with the internal technical, sales, and operations teams to resolve customer issues.
* Escalate complex technical issues to the appropriate internal team and follow through until resolution.
* Maintain proper documentation of customer visits, test results, equipment performance, issues, and corrective actions.
* Build and maintain strong professional relationships with customers through responsive and reliable service.
* Follow all applicable **site safety procedures and company safety protocols**.

Key Skills \& Competencies

* Basic understanding of **HVAC systems, chilled water systems, cooling towers, and water treatment**.
* Knowledge of water quality parameters such as **pH, conductivity/TDS, hardness, alkalinity, chloride, corrosion indicators**, etc. will be an advantage.
* Ability to use basic **water testing instruments and field testing kits**.
* Understanding of electrical/electronic instruments, sensors, controllers, pumps, and dosing systems is preferred.
* Good troubleshooting and problem\-solving ability.
* Ability to read and understand basic technical documents, equipment manuals, and system parameters.
* Good communication and customer\-handling skills.
* Ability to prepare clear service reports and maintain accurate records.
* Comfortable working independently in the field with minimum supervision.
* Willingness to travel extensively across Kerala.

Educational Qualification

* Diploma / B.Tech / B.E. in **Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Environmental Engineering, or a related field**.
* Candidates with relevant field\-service experience in **water treatment, HVAC, cooling tower/chilled water systems, industrial utilities, instrumentation, or automation** will be preferred.

Experience

**0–3 years** of relevant experience preferred.

Freshers with the right technical aptitude and willingness to work in a field\-service role may also be considered.

Other Requirements

* **Valid two\-wheeler driving licence** is preferred.
* Willingness to travel extensively across Kerala and visit customer sites regularly.
* Candidates should be comfortable working in industrial, commercial, healthcare, hospitality, and other technical environments.
* Good working knowledge of **MS Excel, Word, email, and basic digital reporting tools** is preferred.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is **hands\-on, technically curious, disciplined, and customer\-focused** — someone who is comfortable getting into the field, understanding the problem at site, collecting the right data, troubleshooting systematically, and ensuring that the customer receives timely technical support.

**This is primarily a field\-based role and requires regular travel to customer locations across Kerala.**

title: Operations Executive
description:
**\#\# Operations Executive – Atmann \& Your Pandit Ji**

**Company:** Atmann App Private Limited

**Position:** Operations Executive

**Department:** Operations / Platform Operations

**Work Location:** \[Location / Remote / Hybrid]

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Reports To: Operations Manager / Business Head / Founder

**Platforms:** Atmann \& Your Pandit Ji

\-\-\-

**\#\# 1\. About Atmann App Private Limited**

Atmann App Private Limited is building technology\-enabled platforms for \*\*wellness, healing and spiritual services\*\*.

The company operates two digital platforms:

\* \*\*Atmann\*\* – a wellness and healing platform connecting users with healers/practitioners.

\* \*\*Your Pandit Ji\*\* – a spiritual services platform connecting customers with Pandits and enabling digital booking of religious/spiritual services.

The Operations Executive will support the smooth day\-to\-day functioning of \*\*both platforms\*\*.

\-\-\-

**\# 2\. Role Summary**

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive and customer\-focused \*\*Operations Executive\*\* who can manage daily platform operations across Atmann and Your Pandit Ji.

The role will act as a bridge between:

\*\*Customers ↔ Healers/Pandits ↔ Technology Team ↔ Management\*\*

The candidate will be responsible for monitoring bookings, customer queries, practitioner/Pandit coordination, payment\-related operational activities, issue tracking, platform data, and day\-to\-day operational execution.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a \*\*startup environment\*\*, taking ownership, identifying problems independently and coordinating with different teams to get issues resolved quickly.

\-\-\-

**\# 3\. Key Responsibilities**

\#\# A. Daily Platform Operations

\* Monitor daily operations of both Atmann and Your Pandit Ji.

\* Check whether users can successfully register, login, browse services and book sessions/services.

\* Monitor booking status and identify failed or incomplete transactions.

\* Check session/service schedules and availability.

\* Ensure practitioners/Pandits are available for confirmed bookings.

\* Monitor cancellations, rescheduling and no\-show cases.

\* Maintain daily operational reports.

\* Escalate critical platform issues immediately.

\-\-\-

\#\# B. Customer Operations

\* Handle customer queries through WhatsApp, phone, email or platform support channels.

\* Assist customers with:

\* Registration/login issues

\* OTP issues

\* Booking

\* Payment issues

\* Rescheduling

\* Cancellation

\* Refund\-related queries

\* Practitioner/Pandit\-related queries

\* Maintain a record of customer complaints and their resolution status.

\* Follow up with customers until the issue is properly closed.

\* Maintain a professional and empathetic communication style.

\-\-\-

\#\# C. Healer / Practitioner Operations – Atmann

\* Coordinate with healers/practitioners for onboarding.

\* Verify basic practitioner information and documentation as required.

\* Assist practitioners with profile creation and updates.

\* Ensure practitioner profiles contain:

\* Name

\* Profile photo

\* Experience

\* Specialization

\* Session details

\* Pricing

\* Availability

\* Cancellation policy, where applicable

\* Coordinate session availability and scheduling.

\* Follow up with practitioners regarding upcoming bookings.

\* Maintain practitioner records and operational status.

\* Escalate practitioner complaints or performance issues to management.

\-\-\-

\#\# D. Pandit Operations – Your Pandit Ji

\* Coordinate onboarding of Pandits.

\* Assist Pandits in creating and maintaining their profiles.

\* Verify required information/documents.

\* Ensure service details and pricing are correctly configured.

\* Coordinate Pandit availability for bookings.

\* Confirm upcoming bookings with Pandits.

\* Handle rescheduling and cancellation coordination.

\* Follow up on completed services.

\* Maintain Pandit operational records.

\-\-\-

**\# 4\. Booking \& Session Management**

The Operations Executive will monitor the complete booking lifecycle:

\*\*Customer Enquiry → Service Selection → Booking → Payment → Confirmation → Service Delivery → Completion → Review\*\*

Responsibilities include:

\* Monitor new bookings.

\* Confirm practitioner/Pandit availability.

\* Ensure booking confirmation reaches the relevant parties.

\* Track upcoming sessions/services.

\* Follow up on pending bookings.

\* Handle rescheduling requests.

\* Coordinate cancellations.

\* Track completed and missed sessions.

\* Escalate booking conflicts immediately.

\-\-\-

**\# 5\. Payment \& Transaction Operations**

\* Monitor successful and failed payments.

\* Coordinate with the technology team regarding payment failures.

\* Maintain transaction records.

\* Verify booking/payment status when customers raise payment\-related complaints.

\* Coordinate refund\-related cases with the appropriate team.

\* Monitor practitioner/Pandit payment and payout status.

\* Maintain payout\-related operational records.

\* Support reconciliation between platform bookings and payment records.

\*\*Important:\*\* The Operations Executive will not independently authorize refunds, payouts or financial adjustments unless specifically authorized by management.

\-\-\-

**\# 6\. Platform Testing \& Issue Reporting**

The Operations Executive will also participate in \*\*basic functional testing\*\* of both platforms.

Testing should be performed from a \*\*real user's perspective\*\*, not only from a technical perspective.

Examples:

\* Registration

\* Login

\* OTP

\* Profile creation

\* Search/discovery

\* Booking

\* Payment

\* Booking confirmation

\* SMS/WhatsApp notification

\* Cancellation

\* Rescheduling

\* Session completion

\* Reviews

\* Logout

\* Error scenarios

Any issue should be documented with:

\*\*Issue → Platform → Screen → Steps to Reproduce → Screenshot/Video → Priority → Status\*\*

The candidate will coordinate with the technology/development team until the issue is resolved and retested.

\-\-\-

**\# 7\. Notification \& Communication Operations**

Monitor operational notifications including:

\* OTP

\* Booking confirmation

\* Booking reminders

\* Cancellation messages

\* Rescheduling messages

\* Payment notifications

\* Service/session completion notifications

\* WhatsApp notifications

\* SMS notifications

\* Email notifications, where applicable

Report any missing or incorrect notification to the technology team.

\-\-\-

**\# 8\. Data \& MIS Reporting**

Maintain simple daily/weekly operational reports covering:

\#\#\# Customer Metrics

\* New registrations

\* Active users

\* Customer queries

\* Complaints

\* Resolved issues

\#\#\# Booking Metrics

\* Total bookings

\* Confirmed bookings

\* Completed bookings

\* Cancelled bookings

\* Rescheduled bookings

\* Failed bookings

\#\#\# Practitioner/Pandit Metrics

\* New onboardings

\* Active practitioners/Pandits

\* Available practitioners/Pandits

\* Pending documentation

\* Booking fulfillment

\#\#\# Payment Metrics

\* Successful transactions

\* Failed transactions

\* Refund cases

\* Pending payouts

\* Completed payouts

Reports should be accurate, concise and management\-ready.

\-\-\-

**\# 9\. Coordination With Technology Team**

The Operations Executive will work closely with developers/testers.

Responsibilities include:

\* Report bugs and operational issues.

\* Maintain issue tracker.

\* Provide screenshots/videos and reproduction steps.

\* Prioritize customer\-impacting issues.

\* Follow up on unresolved issues.

\* Retest fixes provided by developers.

\* Confirm whether an issue is resolved from the user perspective.

\* Maintain a list of recurring operational problems.

\-\-\-

**\# 10\. Launch \& Beta Operations**

During Beta/Go\-Live, the Operations Executive will support:

\* Daily platform monitoring.

\* Customer support.

\* Practitioner/Pandit coordination.

\* Booking monitoring.

\* Payment monitoring.

\* Notification monitoring.

\* Issue escalation.

\* Daily operational reporting.

\* Hypercare support after launch.

The candidate should be comfortable working with increased operational activity during the launch period.

\-\-\-

**\# 11\. Tools \& Systems**

The candidate should be comfortable learning and using:

\* Google Workspace

\* Google Sheets / Excel

\* WhatsApp Business

\* Email

\* Jira / Taiga / Trello or similar task\-management tools

\* CRM/support tools

\* Payment dashboards such as Razorpay

\* SMS/WhatsApp communication dashboards

\* Admin dashboards

\* Basic analytics/reporting tools

Technical coding knowledge is \*\*not mandatory\*\*, but the candidate should be comfortable working with technology products and dashboards.

\-\-\-

**\# 12\. Key Skills Required**

\#\#\# Must Have

\* Good communication skills

\* Strong follow\-up ability

\* Good organizational skills

\* Customer handling skills

\* Basic Excel/Google Sheets knowledge

\* Attention to detail

\* Problem\-solving ability

\* Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders

\* Ability to work independently

\* Comfortable with technology and web/mobile applications

\#\#\# Good to Have

\* Experience in startup operations

\* Marketplace operations experience

\* Customer support experience

\* E\-commerce/HealthTech/WellnessTech experience

\* Experience with booking platforms

\* Experience with payment platforms

\* Experience coordinating vendors/service providers

\* Basic understanding of APIs, dashboards and software testing

\-\-\-

**\# 13\. Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is someone who:

\* Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions.

\* Can manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

\* Is comfortable communicating with customers and service providers.

\* Notices operational problems before they become major issues.

\* Can work in a fast\-moving startup environment.

\* Is willing to learn new software/tools quickly.

\* Has strong follow\-up discipline.

\* Understands that customer experience is more important than simply completing a task.

\-\-\-

**\# 14\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The Operations Executive will be measured on:

1\. Booking fulfillment rate

2\. Customer response time

3\. Customer issue resolution time

4\. Practitioner/Pandit onboarding completion

5\. Booking cancellation/rescheduling management

6\. Payment issue resolution

7\. Accuracy of operational reports

8\. Timely escalation of critical issues

9\. Platform issue identification and retesting

10\. Customer satisfaction

11\. Practitioner/Pandit satisfaction

12\. Daily operational discipline

\-\-\-

**\# 15\. First 30\-Day Expectations**

During the first 30 days, the candidate should:

**\#\#\# Week 1**

\* Understand Atmann and Your Pandit Ji.

\* Learn the complete customer journey.

\* Learn admin dashboards.

\* Understand booking/payment flows.

\* Understand practitioner/Pandit operations.

**\#\#\# Week 2**

\* Start handling customer queries.

\* Start monitoring bookings.

\* Start practitioner/Pandit coordination.

\* Start maintaining operational trackers.

**\#\#\# Week 3**

\* Independently manage routine operations.

\* Identify recurring issues.

\* Participate in platform testing.

\* Prepare daily/weekly MIS.

**\#\#\# Week 4**

\* Take ownership of assigned operational areas.

\* Reduce dependency on management for routine tasks.

\* Establish a structured daily operations process.

\-\-\-

**\# 16\. Education \& Experience**

\*\*Education:\*\* Graduate in any discipline.

\*\*Experience:\*\* 1–3 years preferred in:

\* Operations

\* Customer support

\* E\-commerce

\* Marketplace

\* Healthcare/Wellness

\* Hospitality

\* Service businesses

\* Startup operations

Freshers with excellent communication, organizational ability and strong technology aptitude may also be considered.

\-\-\-

**\# 17\. Reporting Structure**

\*\*Operations Executive\*\*

↓

\*\*Operations Manager / Business Head\*\*

↓

\*\*Founder / Management\*\*

The role will also work closely with:

\* Technology/Development Team

\* QA/Testing Team

\* Finance

\* Marketing

\* Healers/Practitioners

\* Pandits

\* Customers

\-\-\-

**\# 18\. Employment Nature**

This is a \*\*hands\-on startup operations role\*\*.

The candidate should be prepared to work across both platforms and take responsibility beyond a narrowly defined job description when required.

The primary objective is:

\> \*\*Ensure that customers can successfully discover, book, pay for and complete services while practitioners/Pandits receive timely operational support.\*\*

\-\-\-

**\#\# Core Mission of the Role**

\*\*Keep Atmann and Your Pandit Ji running smoothly every day.\*\*

The Operations Executive will own the operational layer connecting:

\*\*Customer → Platform → Payment → Practitioner/Pandit → Service Delivery → Feedback\*\*

and ensure that problems are identified, communicated and resolved quickly.

Pay: ₹180,000\.00 \- ₹240,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

* Support Attack Surface Management activities, including identification, validation, and tracking of internet\-facing assets, domains, IPs, exposed services, and external risks
