title: Product Manager
description:
**Job Description – Product Manager – Direct Supplies \& Supply Chain**

**Role Overview**

The Product Manager – Direct Supplies \& Supply Chain will be responsible for managing Snackit’s Direct Supplies business along with product planning, procurement coordination, inventory, stock movement, expiry management, client requirements, pricing, margins, and business growth.

The role will involve managing the complete product lifecycle — from understanding client requirements and selecting the right products and brands, to procurement, stock planning, allocation, supply, monitoring product performance, controlling expiry and wastage, and ensuring profitable business growth.

The person will work closely with clients, suppliers, procurement, operations, finance, and internal teams to ensure the right product is available at the right location, at the right time, and at the right cost.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Product Management**

* Manage Snackit’s product portfolio across vending and Direct Supplies categories.
* Understand customer and client requirements and identify suitable products.
* Identify new products, brands, and categories based on market demand and client requirements.
* Develop and maintain the right product mix for different client locations.
* Identify high\-margin products and brands and drive their adoption where commercially suitable.
* Monitor product sales, demand, margins, and performance.
* Identify slow\-moving, low\-margin, and non\-performing products and take corrective action.
* Review product pricing regularly based on purchase cost, market conditions, client expectations, and target margins.
* Introduce new products and remove products that are not commercially viable.
* Work with suppliers and brands to improve product availability, pricing, schemes, and commercial terms.

**2\. Direct Supplies Management**

* Manage the complete Direct Supplies business for Snackit.
* Understand requirements of existing clients and identify opportunities for additional business.
* Meet new and existing clients to understand their pantry, snack, beverage, and other workplace supply requirements.
* Prepare product proposals and commercial quotations based on client requirements.
* Negotiate pricing, discounts, margins, and commercial terms with clients.
* Ensure that client requirements are fulfilled accurately and within agreed timelines.
* Develop long\-term client relationships and increase repeat business.
* Identify cross\-selling and upselling opportunities.
* Expand the range of products supplied to existing clients.
* Develop new business opportunities and contribute to Direct Supplies revenue growth.

**3\. Demand Planning \& Stock Planning**

* Forecast product requirements based on historical consumption, current orders, client requirements, and expected demand.
* Plan stock requirements for different client locations.
* Ensure adequate stock availability without unnecessary overstocking.
* Determine minimum and maximum stock levels for key products.
* Plan replenishment based on consumption and lead time.
* Monitor demand fluctuations and adjust stock plans accordingly.
* Coordinate with procurement and operations teams to ensure timely replenishment.
* Ensure stock is available at the right location based on actual business requirements.

**4\. Inventory Management**

* Monitor overall inventory levels across Snackit locations.
* Maintain accurate inventory records and ensure proper stock tracking.
* Monitor fast\-moving, slow\-moving, and non\-moving inventory.
* Identify excess stock and plan movement or utilization to avoid inventory blockage.
* Monitor stock ageing and take timely action on ageing inventory.
* Plan stock transfers between locations based on demand.
* Ensure inventory is aligned with expected sales and client requirements.
* Minimize inventory holding costs while maintaining required service levels.

**5\. Expiry \& Wastage Management**

* Take ownership of product expiry management across all Direct Supplies and relevant inventory.
* Monitor expiry dates regularly and maintain an expiry tracking system.
* Follow FIFO/FEFO principles wherever applicable.
* Identify products approaching expiry and take timely action.
* Plan stock movement between locations based on expiry and demand.
* Prioritize products with shorter shelf life for consumption or supply.
* Coordinate with operations and clients to reduce expiry\-related losses.
* Analyse expiry and wastage trends and implement corrective measures.
* Minimize product expiry, damage, wastage, and inventory losses.

**6\. Supply Chain \& Procurement Coordination**

* Coordinate the complete supply chain from supplier to client/location.
* Work with procurement teams to ensure products are purchased at competitive prices.
* Plan purchases based on demand, stock levels, lead times, and client requirements.
* Coordinate with suppliers regarding availability, pricing, delivery schedules, schemes, and replacement of damaged/expired products where applicable.
* Identify alternate suppliers when required.
* Negotiate with suppliers to improve purchase costs and commercial terms.
* Ensure timely movement of products from warehouse/supplier to required locations.
* Identify supply\-chain gaps and recommend improvements.

**7\. Margin \& Commercial Management**

* Maintain target margins across products and clients.
* Analyse product\-wise and client\-wise profitability.
* Evaluate the impact of discounts before offering commercial terms to clients.
* Negotiate with clients to achieve commercially viable pricing.
* Negotiate with suppliers to improve purchase costs.
* Identify opportunities to improve gross margin through better product selection, pricing, supplier negotiations, and product mix.
* Monitor products with low or negative margins and take corrective action.
* Ensure business growth does not compromise profitability.

**8\. Client Relationship \& Requirement Management**

* Meet existing and potential clients regularly.
* Understand their current and future product requirements.
* Identify gaps in their existing pantry/supply arrangements.
* Recommend products and solutions based on their consumption and requirements.
* Maintain strong relationships with key client contacts.
* Ensure client issues related to products, pricing, availability, and fulfilment are resolved promptly.
* Collect client feedback and use it to improve Snackit’s product and supply offering.
* Ensure commitments made to clients are properly communicated to internal teams.

**9\. Vending \& Direct Supplies Integration**

* Identify opportunities to combine Snackit’s vending\-machine services with Direct Supplies.
* Analyse consumption at vending locations and identify additional products that can be supplied directly to clients.
* Use vending\-machine sales and consumption data to support product and demand planning.
* Identify products that can be introduced across vending and direct\-supply channels.
* Coordinate with vending operations to ensure product availability and efficient stock utilization.
* Develop integrated food, beverage, and pantry solutions for clients.

**10\. Product Performance \& Business Analysis**

* Monitor product\-wise sales, margins, demand, inventory, and expiry.
* Analyse which products and brands are performing well and which are not.
* Track client\-wise revenue and profitability.
* Identify trends in customer consumption.
* Use data to make decisions regarding product selection, pricing, stock levels, and procurement.
* Prepare regular reports for management covering sales, margins, inventory, expiry, and business growth.
* Recommend actions based on business and operational data.

**11\. Process Improvement**

* Develop and improve processes for product selection, procurement, stock planning, inventory tracking, expiry management, and client fulfilment.
* Create systems to improve visibility of stock, demand, expiry, and product profitability.
* Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend practical solutions.
* Improve coordination between sales, procurement, operations, finance, and clients.
* Build scalable processes as Snackit’s Direct Supplies business grows.

**End\-to\-End Ownership**

The person will be expected to take ownership of the complete cycle:

**Client Requirement → Product Selection → Supplier/Procurement → Pricing → Margin → Purchase Planning → Inventory → Stock Allocation → Supply → Expiry Management → Client Feedback → Repeat Business → Business Growth**

**Key KPIs**

* Direct Supplies revenue growth
* Gross margin and profitability
* New client acquisition
* Existing client revenue growth
* Client retention
* Product\-wise profitability
* High\-margin product growth
* Inventory turnover
* Stock availability
* Reduction in stock\-outs
* Reduction in excess and dead stock
* Reduction in expiry and wastage
* Purchase cost savings
* Supplier commercial improvements
* Order fulfilment efficiency
* Client satisfaction

**Ideal Candidate**

· 0–6 years of experience in product management, supply chain, FMCG, B2B sales, institutional sales, category management, procurement, or a related field. Freshers with strong interest in product management, supply chain, inventory, and business operations are also welcome to apply.

· Experience in FMCG, food \& beverage, pantry supplies, vending, hospitality, or corporate supply business is preferred.

· Strong understanding of inventory, demand planning, procurement, and supply\-chain processes.

· Strong commercial and margin\-management mindset.

· Good negotiation and client\-management skills.

· Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.

· Good knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and reporting.

· Ability to work with multiple teams and manage end\-to\-end responsibilities.

· Willingness to meet clients and visit client locations when required.

· Strong ownership, accountability, and ability to work independently.

**Ideal Mindset**

The ideal candidate should think beyond simply selling products.

They should understand:

**What does the client need?**  
**What should we supply?**  
**At what price should we buy?**  
**At what price should we sell?**  
**What margin will we make?**  
**How much stock should we maintain?**  
**Where should the stock be placed?**  
**How can we avoid expiry and wastage?**  
**How can we increase the business from the same client?**  
**How can we grow the business profitably?**

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

title: Waterproofing Engineer- Civil
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Subject Matter Expert Trainer is the lead technical faculty for Foxscan's four\-section training program — Why Structures Fail, How Structures Fail, Impacts of Building Failures, and Solutions (Inspection, Diagnosis \& Repair) — delivered to civil engineering students and aspirant contractors. This role owns end\-to\-end training delivery, technical accuracy of course content, hands\-on diagnostic tool instruction, and mentoring of the Fresher Trainer, and represents Foxscan's technical credibility to trainees, clients and industry partners. Beyond training delivery, the role is also responsible for identifying trainee talent suitable for Foxscan's own Site Engineer roles, and for converting industry stakeholders met through training into subscribers of the Foxscan platform to build recurring business.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Independently design, curate and deliver all four sections of the training program, referencing applicable IS Codes, ASTM/ACI/BS standards and established building\-pathology literature.

Lead classroom and on\-site sessions covering causes and mechanisms of structural and waterproofing failure, their financial/safety/health/legal impacts, and repair \& rehabilitation solutions.

Conduct hands\-on training on diagnostic and non\-destructive testing tools — rebound hammer, ultrasonic pulse velocity (UPV), cover meter, half\-cell potential, moisture meters and similar equipment.

Lead training on the Foxscan AI diagnosis platform, ensuring trainees can apply it confidently in real assessment scenarios.

Mentor, brief and supervise the Fresher Trainer(s) for each weekend batch, ensuring consistent quality of delivery.

Design and administer the end\-of\-program evaluation test; certify trainee readiness for certificate distribution.

Continuously update training content with current case studies, code revisions and repair\-industry best practices.

Represent Foxscan technically during client visits, demonstrations and industry outreach at the Experience Centre.

Provide input to the Sales/Pre\-sales team on technical positioning of Foxscan's diagnostic and training offerings.

Assess trainee students throughout the program and identify those suitable for onboarding as Site Engineers within Foxscan, recommending shortlisted candidates to the hiring team.

Drive subscription conversion of Foxscan's diagnostic platform among waterproofing contractors, architects, painters and project contractors engaged through training and outreach, to build recurring platform revenue.

Build and maintain healthy, ongoing relationships with all stakeholders — trainees, contractors, architects and channel partners — to support repeat engagement, subscriptions and referrals.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE**

B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering; M.E./M.Tech in Structural Engineering or a related specialisation preferred.

Minimum 10\+ years of professional experience in structural engineering, waterproofing, building pathology, concrete repair or a closely related field.

Demonstrated prior experience in technical training, faculty, or corporate training delivery to contractors and/or engineers.

Strong working knowledge of IS Codes (IS 456, IS 3067, IS 1893, IS 13920 and related), and familiarity with ASTM/ACI/BS standards relevant to concrete durability and repair.

Hands\-on familiarity with common NDT and diagnostic instruments used in structural condition assessment.

Excellent verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain advanced technical concepts to a mixed audience of students, contractors and engineers.

description:
**Job Description**  

  

**Position:** Assistant Manager – Business Finance \& Automation  

**Qualification:** Chartered Accountant (CA)  

**Experience:** 0 to 2 years, Qualified Freshers included  

**Location:** Chennai  

**Reports To:** Works directly with CFO and Business Finance team**About Qube**  

  

Qube is a high\-growth, transformation\-driven company experiencing rapid expansion through aggressive M\&A activity. Having completed 5 major acquisitions in just 18 months, Qube is evolving into a diversified, multi\-vertical business powerhouse in the media\-tech space.  

At Qube Cinema, technology and innovation are at our core. Our purpose is to bring every story to life—to engage, entertain, and enlighten the world. As a company with a passion for cinema, we are committed to creating a seamless world of digital cinema with innovative, robust, reliable, and cost\-effective products, constantly evolving to cater to the needs of the global cinema business.  

Qube is currently in the midst of deep transformation and strategic repositioning. Here, finance professionals don't just crunch numbers—they shape business strategy, drive integration, and directly influence executive decisions.**Role Overview**  

  

As Assistant Manager – Business Finance \& Automation, your role has two parts.  

1\. **Finance Automation**: Our company runs high volumes of invoicing, posting, receipts and reconciliation every month, and the next step is to give the teams behind them better tools. We want someone who can assist in building that leverage: working with the ERP team, business finance and the CFO to design automation workflows, deploying AI where it genuinely earns its place, and measuring the result in time given back to the team, not in tools built.  

2\. B**usiness Finance:** The other half of the role is business finance and strategy. You will work closely along with CFO and the Business Finance \& Strategy team on MIS, valuation, integration and board reporting.  

You will see how decisions actually get made in a company midway through transformation and be a part of that journey.**Key Responsibilities**  

  

1\. **Finance automation and AI deployment*** Own automation of high\-volume finance processes.
* Assist in deploying AI where it does real work: document extraction on supplier invoices, matching and exception handling on reconciliations, first\-cut narrative on MIS, and more.
* Work with the ERP team to centralise processing that may be scattered across locations and functions today, so the automation reaches the branches rather than stopping at head office.


2\. **Business finance and MIS*** Assist in building the monthly MIS and the dashboards that go to the board and to investors. Build the extraction logic that automates them, and turn data into a story about what happened and what it means.
* Partner with business lines on performance, pricing and unit economics.
* Bring commercial insight on business performance and investment returns, not just variance tables.


3\. **Integration of acquired entities*** Support the integration of finance processes, systems and controls across newly acquired businesses.
* Help surface the hidden risks and the value drivers that only become visible once a business is inside the tent.


4\. **Valuation, diligence and corporate development*** Build and maintain valuation models, DCF, multiples and scenario analysis, for internal growth initiatives and for acquisition targets.
* Support financial due diligence on live transactions, including working capital analysis and post\-deal planning. You will assist experienced people here and take more of it on as you prove out.
* Contribute to cross\-border structuring and international taxation work as it arises.

**What We're Looking For**  

* Chartered Accountant, 0 to 2 years. Fresh qualifiers are genuinely welcome.
* Evidence that you have build things \- A model, a macro, a Python script, a Power Query pipeline, a dashboard or automation at articleship. Anything you made that removed work for someone else. Even hobby projects are welcome.
* Exceptional Excel and financial modelling. Power BI, SQL, Python or Power Query is a strong plus. Practical exposure to LLM tooling is a plus.
* Exposure to valuation, diligence or strategic finance during articleship or audits is a plus.
* Real business curiosity.
* Operates with urgency, clarity and independence.
* Quantitative aptitude and a good memory for numbers definitely helps.

Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Ops Staff** is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.


The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Shipment Processing \& Operations**

* Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.

**Data Entry \& Operational Documentation**

* Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.

**Operational Support**

* Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.
* Assist Shift In\-charges in achieving daily operational targets.
* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.

**Safety, Security \& Compliance**

* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.
* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement**

* Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of experience in logistics, warehousing, courier, manufacturing, retail operations or similar operational environments.
* Freshers with the aptitude and willingness to work in operational roles are encouraged to apply.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years**.
* Physically fit to perform operational activities involving standing, walking, lifting and movement of shipments throughout the shift.
* Willingness to work across rotational shifts, weekends and public holidays based on business requirements.
* Basic understanding of English for reading operational instructions, shipment labels and safety guidelines.
* Basic computer and handheld scanner/mobile application usage.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.


**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Shipment Sorting \& Segregation
* Shipment Scanning \& Processing
* Bagging, Tagging \& Labelling
* Shipment Loading \& Unloading
* Basic Data Entry
* Shipment Reconciliation
* Barcode Scanner \& Mobile Device Usage
* Basic Computer Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Operational Discipline
* Customer Focus
* Teamwork \& Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Integrity \& Accountability
* Time Management
* Learning Agility
* Safety Consciousness
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Grooming \& Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Processed • Sorting \& Processing Productivity • SLA Adherence

  

  

Quality \& Accuracy

  

Scanning Accuracy • Zero Mis\-sort • Shipment Handling Accuracy

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

SOP Compliance • Safety Compliance • Zero Safety Violations

  

  

Operational Discipline

  

Attendance • Punctuality • Uniform \& Grooming Standards • Workplace Discipline

  

  

Teamwork \& Operational Support

  

Team Collaboration • Process Adherence • Support During Peak Operations \& Continuous Learning


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

**Disclaimer:**  

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.


Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.

* Assist in building backlinks through outreach and link\-building strategies.
* Perform on\-page and off\-page SEO audits and generate reports.
* Monitor website performance using tools like Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Bing Webmaster Tools.
* Track keyword rankings and prepare performance reports.
* Stay updated with the latest SEO and digital marketing trends.

* Basic understanding of SEO concepts and best practices.
* Familiarity with HTML/CSS, content management systems (WordPress is a plus).
* Knowledge of tools like Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and SEO plugins.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work in a team and manage time effectively.

title: Software Development Engineer, Backend
description:
**About The Company**
 Our mission is that “Any financial application can onboard any user, anywhere in the world, in 1 click.”
   

  

 Transak provides onboarding to financial applications through authentication, KYC, risk checks, and fiat on/off ramps. This is a next generation of infrastructure for the next generation of financial applications that are built on blockchain and stablecoin rails. Our API and widget\-based solutions are used by top partners like MetaMask, Coinbase, Ledger, and Trust Wallet to enable seamless onboarding of over 10 million users across over 450 active applications.
   

  

 We have raised over $37M from top\-tier investors including Consensys, Tether, and Animoca Brands.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Software Development Engineer 1 (Backend) to build and scale the APIs and services that power Transak's global on/off ramp platform. You will work primarily with Node.js, MongoDB, and Redis in a microservices environment, shipping production features that are used by millions of users across our partner applications.
   

  

 This role is ideal for an engineer with 2–5 years of experience who writes clean, well\-tested code, cares about correctness and performance, and wants to grow into owning services end\-to\-end. You will collaborate closely with senior engineers, product, and other pods, learning how we design for scale, reliability, and security in a regulated fintech environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* API \& Service Development
+ Build, test, and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services in Node.js.
+ Model data effectively in MongoDB and use Redis for caching, queues, and rate limiting.
+ Contribute to microservices with clean, readable, and well\-documented code.

* Quality \& Reliability
+ Write unit and integration tests; participate in code reviews.
+ Debug, profile, and fix issues in staging and production.
+ Follow secure coding practices in a compliance\-sensitive domain.

* Collaboration \& Delivery
+ Understand the product and business context behind engineering requirements and contribute to shaping solutions, not just implementation.
+ Break down tasks, give reliable estimates, and ship iteratively.
+ Work with senior engineers on design and integrate feedback quickly.
+ Coordinate with frontend, product, and other backend pods on shared contracts.

* Learning \& Growth
+ Ramp up on distributed systems concepts and asynchronous communication patterns.
+ Proactively improve areas of the codebase you touch.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 2–5 years of backend development experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience building APIs with Node.js.
* Working experience with MongoDB and Redis.
* Exposure to a microservices architecture.
* Solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and problem solving.
* A good team player who collaborates well and gels easily with the team.
* Strong problem\-solving ability and product thinking — able to understand the underlying user/business problem, break down ambiguous requirements, evaluate trade\-offs, and propose practical solutions rather than simply executing predefined tasks.


**Nice\-To\-Haves**
* Exposure to distributed systems complexity (consistency, idempotency, retries, failure handling).
* Experience with asynchronous communication (message queues, event\-driven patterns, pub/sub).
* Understanding of frontend systems and how they consume backend APIs.
* Experience in high\-growth fintech or Web3 startups.

description:
**Role:** Microbiologist

**Department:** Quality Control / Microbiology  
**Reports To:** Microbiology Section Head / QC Manager  
**Location:** Vapi, Gujarat  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Company Overview

A leading pharmaceutical manufacturing company committed to producing safe, effective, and high\-quality drug products in compliance with cGMP and regulatory standards. We are seeking a detail\-oriented Microbiologist to join our Quality Control team.

Job Summary

The Microbiologist will be responsible for performing microbiological testing of raw materials, in\-process samples, finished products, water systems, and environmental monitoring to ensure compliance with cGMP, pharmacopoeial standards (USP/BP/EP/IP), and regulatory requirements. The role involves executing tests accurately, documenting results, and supporting investigations related to microbial contamination.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform microbiological testing including Bioburden, Sterility Testing, Bacterial Endotoxin Test (BET/LAL), Microbial Limit Test (MLT), and Growth Promotion Test.
* Conduct Environmental Monitoring (EM) of cleanrooms, including viable and non\-viable particle counts, surface monitoring, air sampling, and personnel monitoring.
* Test water systems (Purified Water, Water for Injection) as per schedule.
* Perform identification of isolated microorganisms using conventional and/or automated identification systems.
* Maintain and calibrate microbiology lab equipment (autoclaves, incubators, laminar air flow units, biosafety cabinets).
* Prepare, sterilize, and control culture media, reagents, and biological indicators.
* Document all testing activities in compliance with GDP (Good Documentation Practices) and maintain accurate laboratory records/logbooks.
* Investigate Out\-of\-Specification (OOS) and Out\-of\-Trend (OOT) microbiological results, and support root cause analysis and CAPA.
* Ensure adherence to cGMP, GLP, and safety protocols within the microbiology laboratory.
* Participate in method validation, method transfer, and microbial method suitability studies.
* Support internal and external audits (FDA, WHO\-GMP, EU\-GMP, customer audits) by providing documentation and technical justification.
* Maintain aseptic technique and ensure sterility of testing environment.
* Perform disinfectant efficacy studies and qualification of cleanroom areas.
* Ensure timely calibration/validation of microbiology equipment and maintain equipment logs.
* Train new team members on microbiological techniques and SOPs, as required.

Required Qualifications

* **Education:** M.Sc./B.Sc. in Microbiology, Biotechnology, or related life sciences discipline.
* **Experience:** 1–2 years of relevant experience in a pharmaceutical/biotech QC microbiology laboratory (freshers may be considered for junior roles).
* Strong understanding of cGMP, GLP, and pharmacopoeial (USP/EP/BP/IP) guidelines.
* Hands\-on experience with sterility testing, BET, bioburden, and environmental monitoring.
* Familiarity with regulatory requirements (US FDA, WHO, EU\-GMP, MHRA).

Preferred Skills

* Experience with automated microbial identification systems (e.g., VITEK, BD Phoenix).
* Knowledge of rapid microbiological methods (RMM).
* Exposure to LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System).
* Strong documentation, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication skills and ability to work in a team\-oriented environment.

Key Competencies

* Attention to detail and accuracy
* Strong aseptic technique
* Analytical and investigative mindset
* Time management and ability to handle multiple tests/deadlines
* Compliance\-oriented mindset

Work Environment

* Laboratory\-based role requiring gowning and adherence to cleanroom protocols.
* May require working in shifts, including weekends, based on production and testing schedules.

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

 Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, we will have 1 round of interview

We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

 As a remote\-first organization, these are essential attributes we look for in all our candidates.

description:
**About Us**  

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.


At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.


Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**


Visa’s People Shared Services team supports more than 20,000 employees globally across multiple locations and geographies and play a critical role in ensuring a best\-in\-class employee experience. The Associate Analyst role will be primarily responsible for processing employee data changes, program support and execution of task, Verification of Employment request, employee file record management and assisting with other queries related to employee data accuracy.

  

Our team partners closely with our Centers of Excellence teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement while guaranteeing an efficient and consistent approach to the execution of our People Shared Service operational goals.


This role reports to the Manager, People Shared Services.


Key areas of responsibility:

* Will assist in supporting global programs/processes such as Timely Termination Processing, HR Privileged Access Assignments, Team Reporting and Audit controls
* Work to analyze and resolve queries for both simple to medium complexity data processing request as it relates to employee transfers, terminations, personal demographic updates, VOE’s and other inquiries from People Managers, Business Partners, employees, internal COE’s and vendors
* Make appropriate adjustments per the request and communicating progress and outcomes to requestors in a timely and efficient manner, utilizing strong customer service skills
* Employs internal tools such as the case management system (ServiceNow), HRIS (Workday) and vendor tools (Smart Recruiters, ADP, Guardian etc.) effectively to research and assess next steps and accurate resolutions
* Supports cyclical HR events that impact employees (i.e., Annual Review/Promotions)
* Updates and improves the knowledge repository to enable team to take ownership of a higher percentage of inbound inquiries. Actively identifies opportunities for educating team.
* Assist in making recommendation related to training documentation and gaps
* Establish and maintain collaborative and respectful partnerships with our COE’s in HR, Payroll, Benefits, Compensation, and others to further our continuous effort to improve operations, streamline work processes, and work cooperatively and jointly to provide a high\-quality employee experience
* Be flexible and able to handle unexpected transactions and service requests
* Maintain discretion and adhere to strict confidentiality standards


Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

* Associate: Minimum of 6 months of work experience or a Bachelor's Degree


Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience using enterprise\-scale HRIS tools (like Workday, PeopleSoft, ADP etc.)

* General knowledge of HR functional policies and practices within a Global Shared Services model
* Familiar with the utilization and management of enterprise level systems such as Workday and ServiceNow, other comparable software tools acceptable
* Able to work in a fast paced/high volume environment with a focus on QA and meeting established KPIs/SLAs
* Collaborative style and a good team player with a strong customer centered mind\-set that focusses on employee experience and continuous improvement for all processes
* Strong communicator who can deliver easily understandable resolutions to employees and internal teams in common/natural language
* Proficient in Microsoft Office products (PP Presentations, Excel Pivots, VLOOKUP’s, Power BI etc)
* Able to work Monday – Friday and be available for meetings with teams in the US, APAC, CEMEA \& Europe when required

**Visa is an EEO Employer**


Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. title: Director of Talent Acquisition, APAC
description:
**About Analog Devices**

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .

  

**Director of Talent Acquisition, APAC**

**About the Role**  

The Director of Talent Acquisition, APAC, leads a multi\-country team responsible for end\-to\-end hiring across engineering and manufacturing in Asia Pacific (India, Thailand, Philippines, China, Taiwan). This leader brings regional coherence and operational consistency to the way ADI evaluates and attracts talent, while serving as the primary voice of the APAC talent function to global HR and executive leaders. In addition to managing the full spectrum of hiring activity, this role is tasked with building out university partnerships, supporting the promotions process, and shaping a three\-to\-five year talent strategy for the region. Success means both delivering on hiring goals and elevating the broader workforce strategy across a complex, post\-acquisition environment.


**Key Responsibilities**

* **Regional Talent Leadership** : Direct and coach talent acquisition teams across APAC countries, ensuring operational excellence and unified ways of working.
* **Stakeholder Engagement** : Serve as the primary point of contact for APAC talent to global HR, regional executives, and senior country leadership.
* **Talent Frameworks \& Evaluation** : Drive consistency in how talent is assessed and selected, building frameworks that support business needs and enable mobility.
* **University Partnerships** : Formalize and expand relationships with key higher education institutions to build long\-term hiring pipelines.
* **Strategic Workforce Planning** : Partner with APAC business and HR leaders to develop and implement a three\-to\-five\-year regional talent strategy.
* **Promotions Process \& Talent Programs** : Collaborate on the design and delivery of promotions, talent review, and workforce programs.
* **Cross\-Cultural Integration** : Foster collaboration and shared standards in a region shaped by acquisitions and diverse legacy cultures.
* **Operational Excellence** : Land global TA standards locally, ensuring managers experience a common ADI approach to hiring across all APAC countries.

**Must Have Skills**

* **Multi\-country Team Leadership** : Demonstrated experience leading and developing high\-performing TA teams spanning multiple countries and cultures.
* **Stakeholder Management \& Negotiation** : Skilled in building trust and negotiating with senior leaders across countries and functions.
* **Talent Framework Design** : Track record of designing and deploying scalable talent evaluation and selection frameworks.
* **University/External Partnerships** : Experience formalizing and growing higher\-ed partnerships to support talent pipelines.
* **Collaboration \& Influence** : An effective collaborator who can unify stakeholders and drive alignment in complex, matrixed environments.
* **Change Leadership** : Comfortable leading through ambiguity and integration, especially post\-acquisition.

**Preferred Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and 10\+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience supporting both engineering and manufacturing talent needs is a plus.
* Familiarity with APAC labor markets and regulatory environments.
* Proven ability to operate at both strategic and operational levels.

*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce \- Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State \- Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*

*Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.*

title: Recruitment Associate Intern
description:
Recruitment Associate Intern  
**Job Type:** Internship  
**Location:** Remote  
**Duration:** 3 Months  
**Stipend:** ₹10,000 per month

About the Role

We are looking for a **Recruitment Associate Intern** to join our recruitment team and work closely with our recruiters on live hiring mandates.

This is a hands\-on internship. You will be involved in the recruitment process from **candidate sourcing and screening to interview coordination and follow\-ups**. You will learn how recruitment actually works while contributing to real hiring assignments for our clients.

Key Responsibilities

* Source relevant candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, databases, referrals, and other channels.
* Review resumes and identify candidates who match specific job requirements.
* Conduct initial candidate screening and introductory calls.
* Understand candidates' experience, skills, expectations, availability, and career goals.
* Present suitable opportunities to candidates and explain roles clearly.
* Maintain regular communication and follow up with candidates throughout the hiring process.
* Coordinate interviews between candidates and clients.
* Maintain accurate candidate records and recruitment pipelines in the ATS.
* Research talent markets, companies, industries, and potential candidate pools.
* Support recruiters in managing multiple open positions simultaneously.
* Assist with recruitment\-related reporting and other day\-to\-day activities.

What We're Looking For

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Comfortable speaking with candidates over the phone.
* Good interpersonal and relationship\-building skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to evaluate information critically.
* Ability to understand a job description and identify relevant candidate profiles.
* Good organizational and follow\-up skills.
* Proactive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Basic knowledge of LinkedIn, MS Excel/Google Sheets, or similar tools is a plus.
* Previous experience in recruitment, HR, sales, customer\-facing roles, or internships is a plus, but **not required**.

Who Would Be a Good Fit?

This internship is suitable for students, recent graduates, or early\-career professionals who are interested in **recruitment, talent acquisition, HR, or client\-facing careers**.

We are more interested in your **communication skills, curiosity, judgment, and willingness to learn** than in a specific degree or academic background.

What You'll Learn

* End\-to\-end recruitment and talent acquisition
* Candidate sourcing and talent mapping
* Resume screening and candidate assessment
* Recruitment calls and candidate communication
* Interview management and follow\-ups
* ATS and recruitment operations
* Understanding hiring requirements and job markets
* Professional communication with candidates and clients

Why Join Us?

* Work on **live recruitment assignments**, not simulated internship projects.
* Get hands\-on exposure to the complete recruitment lifecycle.
* Work directly with an experienced recruitment team.
* Develop practical sourcing, screening, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Opportunity to continue with Sincline based on performance and business requirements.

Application

If you are interested in building a career in recruitment and enjoy working with people, we'd like to hear from you.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


Deliver employee relations (ER) support across Ameriprise India. Manage inbound queries submitted to the HR Service Center requiring general ER guidance to ensure compliance with HR policies, including providing consultation to employees, leaders, and HRBP on employee relations issues such as attendance, behavior, performance and policy violations. Provide intake and partner closely with the India ER COE in complex cases of harassment, discrimination etc. to ensure consistent case management and escalation procedures.**Key Responsibilities:**

**ER Case Management**

* Serve as the first point of contact for ER cases in India routed through HR Service Center.
* Manage assigned cases in a timely manner from intake to closure including fact\-finding, documentation, risk assessment, and resolution.
* Handle issues related to performance, attendance, behavioral concerns, and policy violations.

**Manager \& Employee Advisory**

* Provide direct ER consultation to managers and employees on workplace concerns.
* Advise on terminations, notice period queries, final settlement (F\&F), and rehire eligibility.
* Guide leaders on disciplinary actions, performance improvement processes, and documentation standards.

**Absence \& Leave Management Support**

* Provide ER\-related support for leave of absence (LOA), alternate work arrangements (AWA), Medical accommodations and related scenarios.
* Guide employees and managers on policy application, eligibility, and process related to absence management.
* Partner with HR operations to ensure seamless execution and compliance.

**Reporting, Documentation \& Process Improvement**

* Maintain accurate and comprehensive ER case documentation.
* Track case metrics and identify trends, root causes, and repeat issues.
* Provide insights to ER COE and HRBPs to support proactive risk mitigation.

**Required qualification:**

* 3\-5 years of relevant experience
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to recognize financial impacts and respond or escalate, as appropriate.
* Ability to take initiative and remain team player, act proactively, and think creatively.
* Ability to work independently following established procedures.
* Intermediate computer skills, including MS Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint.

**Preferred qualification:**

* Experience and knowledge of Employment/Labor laws, POSH etc.

Accenture’s Transaction Advisory team sits at the heart of strategic value creation across the deal lifecycle. We support both Private Equity (PE) and Corporate clients, partnering on initiatives from target screening and due diligence to integration, separation, and portfolio value enhancement.

description:
**Job Description:**


We are looking for a skilled HR manager to oversee all aspects of Human Resources practices and processes. You will support business needs and ensure the proper implementation of company strategy and objectives. The goal is to promote corporate values and enable business success through human resources management, including job design, recruitment, performance management, training \& development, employment cycle changes, talent management, and facilities management services.


Responsibilities:

* Enhances the organization's human resources by planning, implementing, and evaluating employee relations and human resources policies, programs, and practices.
* Maintains the work structure by updating job requirements and job descriptions for all positions.
* Supports organization staff by establishing and interviewing program; counselling managers on candidate selection; conducting and analyzing exit interviews; and recommending changes.
* Prepares employees for assignments by establishing and conducting orientation and training programs.
* Manages a pay plan by conducting periodic pay surveys; scheduling and conducting job evaluations; preparing pay budgets; monitoring and scheduling individual pay actions; and recommending, planning, and implementing pay structure revisions.
* Ensures planning, monitoring, and appraisal of employee work results by training managers to coach and discipline employees; scheduling management conferences with employees; hearing and resolving employee grievances; and counselling employees and supervisors.
* Implements employee benefits programs and informs employees of benefits by studying and assessing benefit needs and trends; recommending benefit programs to management; directing the processing of benefit claims; obtaining and evaluating benefit contract bids; awarding benefit contracts; and designing and conducting educational programs on benefit programs.
* Ensures legal compliance by monitoring and implementing applicable human resource federal and state requirements, conducting investigations, maintaining records, and representing the organization at hearings.

description:

Join us as a Operations Manager at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.


To be successful as a Operations Manager, must be subject matter expert providing a world class range of operational and transactional services for the benefit schemes that are provided to Barclays employees; engaging with key stakeholders within the Rewards \& Performance centres of excellence, external suppliers, and colleagues within the Benefits employee helpdesk.


Person Specification


* SME in Pensions and Benefits operation
* Proven ability to effectively manage multiple priorities/projects, ensuring consistent delivery to a high standard and customer satisfaction.
* Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills with the ability to influence and build commitment amongst senior stakeholders.
* Demonstrate resilience \- reacts positively to changes and maintains poise, focus and flexibility when encountering difficulties or obstacles.
* Possess a demonstrable ability to effectively engage with stakeholders, whilst being able to clearly communicate requirements and liaise with peers who are required to support the delivery.

Essential Skills/Basic Qualifications:


* Degree qualified or with equivalent professional qualifications or demonstrable experience in lieu of this
* Experience of Benefits, governance, controls and risk management.
* Excellent people management skills in relation to performance, motivation, development and delivery
* Customer Service experience – ability to deal with a varied customer base, including business customers \& senior stakeholders, and explain complex queries clearly

Desirable skills/Preferred Qualifications:


* Preferably degree qualified in a numerate or HR\-related discipline
* Experience of working within a HR operational and service delivery environment
* Generalist HR experience within complex organisations

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with pensions and benefits experience.


**Purpose of the role**


To design and implement programmes and initiatives that support the growth and development of the bank’s employees and leaders.


**Accountabilities**


* Development and implementation of training and development programmes and initiatives, including creation and execution of training sessions, workshops, and other learning opportunities.
* Collaboration with HR and hiring managers to analyse the current and future development needs of the organisation.
* Design and delivery of classroom and digital based training content, programmes and associated User Experience.
* Management of onboarding programmes including training, onboarding materials, introduction meetings and providing support throughout the onboarding process.
* Analysis of data and metrics to measure success of talent development programmes and initiatives.
* Development and implementation of coaching and mentoring programmes, train the trainer programmes for facilitators and relevant educational materials.
* Develop and implement talent pipelining processes, identifying, managing, progressing and promoting talent capability across the bank with succession management and career progression’.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**


* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

##### **About Company**


Arcitech AI, located in Navi Mumbai's bustling Vashi, is a trailblazer in software and IT, specializing in software development, AI, mobile apps, and integrative solutions. Committed to excellence and innovation, Arcitech AI offers incredible growth opportunities for team members. Enjoy unique perks like weekends off and a provident fund. Our vibrant culture is friendly and cooperative, fostering a dynamic work environment that inspires creativity and forward\-thinking. Join us to shape the future of technology.


Unit No. 15, Ground Floor, E Wing, Phase \- I, Akshar Business Park, Sector \- 25, Vashi\- 400703\.


##### **Job Description**


**About the Role**
------------------


This is a lead role, hands\-on UI/UX design role for someone who is genuinely strong across the entire design spectrum — both UX (research, flows, information architecture, usability) and UI (visual craft, design systems, interaction detail). You will own design end\-to\-end for products and features across our SaaS portfolio, from problem through to polished, production\-ready interface and developer handoff.


This is a lead role that combines hands\-on design with team leadership. You will be the most experienced designer in the room, set the quality standard through your own work, and manage a team of around five designers — owning their output, priorities, growth, and quality of work. You will still design directly; this is a hands\-on leader role, not a pure management seat. You should be comfortable in a high\-paced IT / product environment, able to juggle multiple products, and self\-directed enough to drive design without hand\-holding.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


**End\-to\-End Product Design**
-------------------------------


* Own the full design process across products: research, flows, wireframes, prototypes, and final UI.


* Conduct user research and usability testing, and turn findings into clear design decisions.


* Design pixel\-perfect, responsive interfaces for web and mobile, to a senior standard.


* Make and defend design decisions based on user needs and product goals.


Design Systems \& Craft Standard


* Build and maintain design systems, component libraries, and standards across products.


* Set and hold the visual and interaction quality bar — your work is the reference others follow.


* Drive consistency across a portfolio of products, not just individual screens.


**Team Leadership \& Collaboration**
----------------------------------------


* Manage a team of around five designers — set priorities, review work, hold the quality bar, and


support their growth.


* Partner closely with product managers and developers for clean handoff and faithful


implementation.


* Collaborate with the brand / marketing team to keep product and brand aligned.


* Balance your own hands\-on design work with leading the team, at pace, across multiple products.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
---------------------------------


* Experience: 5\+ years of hands\-on UI/UX / product design, with a strong portfolio that proves depth


* Full\-spectrum UI/UX: genuinely strong across both UX (research, flows, IA, usability) and UI (visual craft, design systems, interaction) — not specialized in only one side


* IT / product background: experience designing software / SaaS / digital products in an IT or product company


* Fast\-paced environment: proven ability to deliver quality in a high\-paced, multi\-project setting


* Tools: advanced Figma (mandatory); plus Adobe XD / Sketch / Framer as relevant


* Design systems: real experience building and maintaining design systems and component


libraries


* Team leadership: experience managing or leading a design team of around five — setting


priorities, reviewing work, and developing designers


* Communication: clear communicator who can present and defend design decisions to product and engineering


**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Working knowledge of graphic design tools (Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva) for supporting visual assets — a plus, not a requirement.


* Experience designing for AI\-driven products (chat, agents, AI\-output states).


* Familiarity with AI design tools (Figma AI, Uizard, Galileo, or similar).


* Basic understanding of front\-end constraints (components, responsive behaviour, HTML/CSS) for clean handoff.


**The Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------


* Is a senior, full\-spectrum product designer — equally strong at UX thinking and UI craft.


* Comes from an IT / product / SaaS background and thrives in a fast\-paced environment.


* Sets the quality bar through their own work and leads a small design team.


* Is self\-directed, owns design across multiple products, and delivers without hand\-holding.


* Can balance hands\-on design with managing and growing a team of around five.


**Portfolio Requirement**
-------------------------


A strong portfolio is required — applications without one will not be reviewed. We want to see senior\-level work that shows both your UX thinking (the problem, research, and decisions) and your UI craft (the final, polished interface). Relevant SaaS / product / AI work will stand out. Be prepared to walk us through one or two projects in depth.


Hiring Process Our process focuses on real design ability: portfolio review an initial HR conversation a practical design assignment (which you will present and defend) a panel discussion with the product and engineering teams. The emphasis throughout is on your portfolio and the assignment — the actual work.


**Why Join Arcitech AI**
------------------------


* Own design end\-to\-end across real AI\-native SaaS products — senior scope and real impact.


* Lead and shape the design team as the function scales.


* Work in a fast\-moving product company that takes design seriously.


* Collaborative environment with Provident Fund and employee benefits.

description:
###### **UI\-UX Design Manager**


Arcitech AI
###### **Arcitech AI** **Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India**

##### **About Company**


Arcitech AI, located in Navi Mumbai's bustling Vashi, is a trailblazer in software and IT, specializing in software development, AI, mobile apps, and integrative solutions. Committed to excellence and innovation, Arcitech AI offers incredible growth opportunities for team members. Enjoy unique perks like weekends off and a provident fund. Our vibrant culture is friendly and cooperative, fostering a dynamic work environment that inspires creativity and forward\-thinking. Join us to shape the future of technology.


Unit No. 15, Ground Floor, E Wing, Phase \- I, Akshar Business Park, Sector \- 25, Vashi\- 400703\.


##### **Job Description**


**About the Role**
==================


We are looking for a UI/UX Design Manager to own the design function across Arcitech’s product portfolio. This is the senior\-most design seat in the organization. You will set design strategy across products, manage a team of 5–8 designers (including a Senior Design Lead who owns hands\-on senior craft beneath you), run design across 7–8 concurrent projects, and be the design counterpart to product and engineering leadership. Reporting directly to the CEO, you are accountable for the shipped design of everything we ship.


This is a management role, not primarily a hands\-on IC role. You are the strategist, the reviewer, and the leader of the function. Hands\-on senior craft sits with the Design Lead beneath you; your job is to set direction, hold the bar, grow the team, and represent design at the leadership table. That said, at this stage of the company you will still design directly on the highest\-impact work when required — particularly on strategic explorations, new\-product launches, and cross\-brand systems.


Prior experience in an IT / SaaS / product company is non\-negotiable. Prior experience genuinely managing a design team of 5\+ is non\-negotiable. This is a role for someone who has already done this work before, not someone stepping up into it for the first time.


You will report directly to the CEO.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Design Strategy \& Direction**
--------------------------------


* Own the design vision and strategy across the SaaS portfolio.
* Set priorities across 7–8 concurrent projects; make trade\-offs when everything can’t be built.
* Represent design at the leadership table — product, engineering, and CEO reviews.
* Own release\-readiness and cross\-product design decisions.

**Team Management**
-------------------


* Manage a team of 5–8 designers, including the Senior UI/UX Design Lead as your direct report.
* Set clear expectations, run 1:1s and reviews, and own performance conversations end\-to\-end.
* Grow the team’s craft, career depth, and independence over time.
* Own hiring for the design team — who joins, at what level, and how they ramp up.

**Quality Bar \& Review**
-------------------------


* Define and hold the design quality bar across the whole team.
* Review the Design Lead’s work and the wider team’s work; catch issues before ship.
* Own design systems, brand\-design consistency, and cross\-product coherence.
* Set the standard through your own review — not by out\-designing the team.

**Cross\-Team Leadership**
--------------------------


* Partner with product management and engineering leadership on roadmap, scope, and trade\-offs.
* Represent design to the CEO and the wider org clearly — what’s being built, why, and what’s at risk.
* Communicate design decisions to non\-design stakeholders in business terms, not just design terms.
* Coordinate with Brand / Marketing and the graphic\-design function so brand and product visual languages stay aligned.

**Hands\-On Design (Selective)**
--------------------------------


* Personally own strategic design work on the highest\-impact / most\-critical launches.
* Design directly on cross\-brand systems, new\-product launches, and executive\-visibility work.
* Delegate day\-to\-day craft work to the Lead and the team — stay in strategy and review mode by default.

**Required Skills \& Experience**
---------------------------------


* **Experience:** 6\+ years in UI/UX design, with at least 3 years in a design\-management role
* **Team management (must\-have, non\-negotiable):** proven experience managing a design team of 5\+ — real people\-management with 1:1s, reviews, hiring, and performance calls; not just informal mentoring
* **IT / technology company background (must\-have, non\-negotiable):** prior experience designing for and inside a technology / SaaS / IT product company
* **UI depth (must\-have):** senior\-level UI craft — visual design systems, interaction patterns, component libraries, responsive design
* **UX depth (must\-have):** senior\-level UX craft — research, flows, information architecture, usability, and design decisions grounded in user reality
* **Design strategy (must\-have):** genuine experience setting design direction across multiple products or product lines
* **Multi\-project (must\-have):** proven ability to run design across 7–8 concurrent projects without dropping quality
* **Figma:** advanced Figma — components, variants, Auto\-Layout, plugins, libraries
* **AI\-tools fluency:** current, hands\-on with AI design tools; adopted in real work, not just tried
* **Communication:** clear, senior communicator; can represent design to the CEO and cross\-functional leadership
* **Portfolio:** senior\-level portfolio required; must include team\-led work and design\-strategy examples, not just personal craft

**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Prior experience building or scaling a design function from small to mid\-size.
* Experience designing for AI / ML / non\-deterministic product surfaces.
* Exposure to design ops — systems, documentation, and workflow tooling.
* Experience working across multiple brands / product lines within one company.
* Formal design education or equivalent professional depth.

**The Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------


* Has genuinely managed a design team of 5\+, and can point to what specifically improved under their leadership.
* Has worked inside a technology / SaaS / IT product company — not as an agency contractor — for a meaningful part of their career.
* Is strong across both UI and UX — not stronger on one at the expense of the other.
* Can balance strategy, review, team management, and selective hands\-on work.
* Communicates well with the CEO and leadership; represents design as a business function, not a purely creative one.
* Runs a design function with process and craft, not chaos and heroics.

**Portfolio Requirement**
-------------------------


A senior\-level portfolio is mandatory. We want to see two things clearly: (1\) your own personal design work at senior IC level, and (2\) work led through a team — what your team shipped, what your role was, and what changed under your leadership. Applications with only personal\-craft portfolios and no team\-led work will not clear the preliminary round.


**Hiring Process**
------------------


Our process is designed to assess design strategy, real management ability, and communication:


* Preliminary portfolio review — a senior portfolio with team\-led work is required to move forward.
* HR conversation — initial screen for fit, background, and communication.
* Design strategy conversation — with senior leadership on design direction, decisions, and philosophy.
* Practical design exercise — a short, role\-relevant strategy / review task; you walk us through your thinking.
* Panel discussion — with product, engineering, and cross\-functional stakeholders on collaboration and leadership.
* Final round with the CEO — a conversation on leadership, design ownership, and how you’d run the function.

**Why Join Arcitech AI**
------------------------


* Own the design function at a fast\-growing AI\-native SaaS company.
* Report directly to the CEO — close to the decisions, no layers of middle management.
* Build the design function as the products and team scale.
* Broad scope: product UI/UX, design systems, brand consistency, cross\-brand coherence.
* Collaborative environment with Provident Fund and employee benefits.
