JP Liquor Mart is a premium liquor retail business in Hyderabad, focused on building a differentiated customer experience around premium spirits, wines, beers, and emerging beverage brands.

As we continue expanding our retail presence, we're looking for a **Sales \& Marketing Intern** who is energetic, creative, commercially minded, and eager to learn how a real consumer business operates.

Role Overview

As a Sales \& Marketing Intern, you will work closely with the management team across **sales, marketing, brand activation, social media, customer engagement, and business development**.

This is a hands\-on role. You won't just be sitting at a desk—you'll get exposure to how brands are marketed, how customers make purchase decisions, how retail sales work, and how a growing business builds its brand.

Key ResponsibilitiesSales \& Business Development

* Support day\-to\-day sales initiatives across JP Liquor Mart outlets.
* Assist in identifying opportunities to increase sales and customer engagement.
* Track sales performance, product movement, and promotional performance.
* Assist with customer feedback and understanding purchasing preferences.
* Support relationships with brand representatives, distributors, and partners.
* Help execute promotional campaigns and in\-store activations.

Marketing \& Social Media

* Assist in planning and executing Instagram and other social media campaigns.
* Create ideas for reels, posts, stories, promotions, and brand collaborations.
* Coordinate with photographers, designers, influencers, and content creators.
* Research current trends in the **liquor, hospitality, lifestyle, food \& beverage, and premium consumer markets**.
* Help develop creative campaigns for new product launches and seasonal promotions.
* Monitor social media performance and prepare basic reports.

Market \& Competitor Research

* Research competing liquor retailers, premium brands, bars, restaurants, and lifestyle businesses.
* Track new product launches and emerging beverage trends.
* Identify interesting marketing campaigns and opportunities for JP Liquor Mart.
* Prepare simple presentations and reports for management.

Events \& Brand Activations

* Assist in organizing tastings, product launches, promotional events, and customer experiences.
* Coordinate with brand partners and vendors.
* Help manage event execution from planning through completion.

Management Support

* Work directly with the management team on special projects.
* Prepare presentations, spreadsheets, reports, and marketing proposals.
* Take ownership of assigned projects and ensure timely execution.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is:

* **Confident, energetic, and outgoing**
* Excellent at communication and interpersonal skills
* Interested in **sales, marketing, branding, entrepreneurship, and consumer businesses**
* Comfortable speaking to customers and business partners
* Creative and naturally curious
* Active on social media and understands digital trends
* Comfortable with **Instagram, Canva, Excel/Google Sheets, and PowerPoint**
* Willing to travel locally when required
* Organized and capable of working independently
* Hungry to learn and take responsibility

A Great Fit If You...

You're the kind of person who sees a product in a store and thinks:

**"Why is this selling? Who is buying it? How could we market it better?"**

You don't need to know everything about liquor. **We can teach you the category.**

What matters more is your attitude, curiosity, communication skills, and willingness to get your hands dirty.

* Sales \& retail operations
* Consumer behaviour
* Premium brand marketing
* Social media marketing
* Influencer marketing
* Product launches
* Event management
* Business development
* Market research
* Brand partnerships

title: Business Development Intern – MBA Marketing Fresher | Field Outreach & Demo Scheduling
description:
Business Development Intern – MBA Marketing Preferred \- Field Outreach, Lead Generation and Demo Scheduling

**Location:** Guwahati, Assam  
**Job Type:** Internship  
**Duration:** 3 months initially, with possibility of extension or conversion based on performance  
**Preferred Qualification:** MBA Marketing student / MBA Marketing fresher  
**Work Mode:** Market visits, field outreach, online research and office coordination

Job Summary

We are looking for a curious, confident, and growth\-oriented **Business Development Intern** to support B2B lead generation, prospect identification, first\-level qualification, and demo scheduling for a workforce technology platform.

This internship is best suited for an **MBA Marketing student or MBA Marketing fresher** who wants practical exposure to real business development, market visits, customer conversations, consultative selling, and pipeline building.

The selected intern will be expected to identify and visit potential prospects in Guwahati and nearby business areas, find the right decision\-makers, understand their basic workforce\-related challenges, keep prospects warm through follow\-ups, and schedule product demos or introductory meetings for the senior team.

The intern’s primary role will be to open conversations, identify genuine opportunities, keep prospects warm, and schedule demos. Product demonstrations, commercial discussions, and final closures will be handled by the business owner/founder after the opportunity is qualified.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and research potential organizations across selected industries such as manufacturing, education, healthcare, hospitality, logistics, trading, distribution, and growing businesses.
* Visit potential prospects in Guwahati and nearby business areas to identify the right contact person and understand the organization’s basic requirements.
* Build and maintain a structured lead database with company details, industry, location, decision\-maker information, contact details, workforce size, outreach status, and follow\-up notes.
* Identify relevant decision\-makers such as founders, owners, HR managers, operations heads, administrators, school management, hospital administrators, and business heads.
* Conduct first\-level outreach through market visits, phone calls, emails, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp where appropriate.
* Briefly introduce the platform and understand whether the organization has relevant workforce\-management needs.
* Ask basic discovery questions related to attendance, leave management, employee communication, hiring, training, task visibility, employee engagement, and workforce coordination.
* Qualify prospects based on relevance, need, interest level, decision\-maker access, and willingness to explore a discussion.
* Schedule product demos or introductory meetings for the senior team.
* Keep prospects warm through disciplined follow\-ups and regular communication.
* Maintain daily updates and weekly reports on prospects visited, leads researched, conversations held, qualified opportunities, demos scheduled, and next steps.

Required Skills

* MBA Marketing student or MBA Marketing fresher preferred.
* Good communication skills in English, Hindi, and preferably Assamese.
* Comfortable with field visits, market outreach, and meeting new people.
* Confidence to speak with business owners, HR professionals, administrators, operations leaders, and decision\-makers.
* Basic understanding of internet research, LinkedIn, email communication, Excel, and Google Sheets.
* Ability to listen carefully, ask relevant questions, and document prospect responses clearly.
* Good follow\-up discipline and attention to detail.
* Curiosity to understand business problems and customer needs.
* Willingness to learn about B2B sales, workforce technology, HR tech, and consultative selling.

Mindset We Are Looking For

We are not looking for a routine telecaller.

We are looking for someone who is curious, sincere, and hungry to learn business development from the ground up.

This opportunity is best suited for a person who wants to understand how real sales pipelines are built through market research, physical visits, customer conversations, follow\-ups, relationship building, and consistent effort.

The ideal candidate should have:

* Hunger to learn and grow professionally.
* Willingness to go to the market and meet prospects.
* Curiosity to understand how businesses work.
* Confidence to speak with new people and ask thoughtful questions.
* Persistence to follow up without losing discipline.
* Ownership to complete tasks properly and maintain accurate records.
* Patience to understand that B2B solution selling takes time.
* Ability to keep prospects warm and stay connected professionally.
* Openness to feedback and improvement.
* Interest in building a long\-term career in sales, marketing, business development, consulting, or client\-facing roles.

Note: This is not about selling a simple product. This is about learning how to identify business opportunities, understand customer problems, build trust, and create a qualified sales pipeline.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* MBA Marketing student or MBA Marketing fresher.
* Strong interest in sales, marketing, business development, B2B sales, or client\-facing roles.
* Comfortable with market visits and first\-level customer interaction.
* Interested in consultative selling rather than only calling or sending messages.
* Organized in maintaining lead data, reports, and follow\-ups.
* Able to identify genuine opportunities rather than simply collecting contact details.
* Familiarity with Guwahati’s local business areas and commercial ecosystem will be an advantage.
* Willing to learn, improve, and grow into a larger business development role over time.

What You Will Learn

* How to identify potential B2B opportunities in Guwahati and nearby markets.
* How to research and profile organizations.
* How to find and approach decision\-makers.
* How to conduct first\-level discovery conversations.
* How to qualify leads before a product demo.
* How to build and maintain a sales pipeline.
* How to keep prospects warm through follow\-ups.
* How consultative selling differs from regular telecalling.
* How workforce technology and HR tech platforms are positioned to businesses.
* How real business development works from the ground level.

Performance Expectations

The intern will be expected to:

* Visit selected prospects in the market.
* Build a clean and relevant prospect database.
* Identify suitable decision\-makers.
* Conduct professional first\-level outreach.
* Generate meaningful conversations.
* Schedule qualified product demos or introductory meetings.
* Maintain accurate records and follow\-up notes.
* Show improvement in communication, confidence, and business understanding over time.

Stipend and Incentives

A fixed internship stipend may be provided, along with performance\-based incentives for qualified demos or meetings scheduled.

Compensation will depend on the candidate’s commitment, communication ability, quality of work, field effort, and ability to generate qualified business opportunities.

Growth Opportunity

This internship may lead to a longer\-term role based on performance, maturity, ownership, communication skills, field discipline, and ability to generate qualified opportunities.

High\-performing interns may be considered for future roles such as:

* Business Development Associate
* Lead Generation Associate
* Inside Sales Associate
* Client Relationship Executive
* Product Sales Consultant

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹8,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Guwahati, Assam (Guwahati, Kamrup District)

title: Product Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
 The Product Manager will drive product development and manage the entire product life cycle for CallHippo's VoIP telephony platform, with a strong emphasis on using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, and similar) to accelerate market research, competitor analysis, and requirement definition. This role requires a strategic thinker who can combine product management fundamentals with hands\-on AI fluency to make faster, better\-informed decisions.
   

  

 Duties and Responsibilities
   

  

* Drive product development from concept to launch, ensuring alignment with business goals.
* Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, etc.) to conduct market research, synthesize customer needs, and surface emerging trends in VoIP, telephony, and SaaS communication.
* Perform structured competitor analysis with AI assistance — benchmarking features, pricing, positioning, and messaging — before defining product requirements.
* Draft, refine, and pressure\-test product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories, and specs using AI, while applying human judgment to validate output.
* Develop and maintain product roadmaps, ensuring timely delivery of features.
* Collaborate with engineering, design, and marketing teams to define product specifications.
* Use AI to analyze user feedback, support tickets, and product usage data at scale to identify pain points and opportunities.
* Manage product pricing and positioning strategies to maximize market share and profitability.
* Oversee product testing and QA processes to ensure product excellence.
* Monitor product performance and continuously feed insights back into the roadmap.
* Build and document repeatable AI\-assisted workflows and prompt templates the wider team can reuse.


**Qualifications And Requirements**
* 4\-7 years of experience in product management or a related field.
* Proven track record of driving product development and managing the product life cycle.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) for research, analysis, writing, or workflow automation.
* Strong knowledge of product planning, testing, and delivery management.

title: HR Fresher
description:
We are hiring an Human Resources Fresher who can support HR operations through data analysis, reporting, dashboards, and modern AI tools.
   

  

 This role is suitable for freshers or early\-career candidates who are interested in Human Resources, data analytics, Power BI, Excel/Google Sheets, and AI\-enabled work. The ideal candidate should not only understand HR processes but should also be comfortable working with data, creating reports, identifying patterns, and using AI tools to complete work faster and more accurately.
   

  

 The person will work closely with the HR team to analyze recruitment, employee, attendance, performance, and workforce data, build dashboards and reports, and use AI tools to improve speed, accuracy, and decision\-making.
   

  

 Core Job Responsibilities
   

  

* HR Data Analysis \& Reporting Collect, clean, organize, and analyze HR data related to recruitment, employee records, attendance, onboarding, performance, attrition, and workforce planning.
* Power BI Dashboards \& MIS Reporting Create and maintain dashboards, reports, and MIS trackers using tools such as Power BI, Excel, Google Sheets, or similar reporting platforms.
* Recruitment Analytics Track hiring funnel metrics such as applications received, shortlisted candidates, interview status, offer rollout, joining status, turnaround time, source effectiveness, and drop\-off points.
* Workforce Analytics Analyze employee data to identify trends related to headcount, attrition, attendance, performance, engagement, skills, and manpower requirements.
* AI\-Assisted Workflows Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar platforms to speed up data cleaning, report writing, formula creation, dashboard planning, insight generation, documentation, and process improvement.
* Data Interpretation \& Business Insights Convert raw HR data into clear insights and summaries that help the HR team and business leaders make better decisions.
* HR Operations Support Support day\-to\-day HR operations such as onboarding tracking, employee documentation, HRMS data updates, employee query tracking, and process documentation.
* Automation \& Process Improvement Identify repetitive HR reporting or operational tasks and suggest ways to automate or simplify them using Excel, Google Sheets, Power BI, AI tools, or other workflow tools.
* Data Accuracy \& Quality Checks Validate reports and AI\-generated outputs to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability before sharing them with internal stakeholders.
* Data Privacy \& Responsible AI Use Handle employee and candidate data responsibly, maintaining confidentiality and ensuring AI tools are used carefully and ethically.


 Key Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Strong interest in HR analytics, people data, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, charts, filters, lookup functions, and data cleaning.
* Familiarity with Power BI or willingness to build dashboards using Power BI.
* Ability to interpret data and explain insights in simple business language.
* Hands\-on usage of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar tools for work\-related tasks.
* Ability to write clear prompts, verify AI\-generated outputs, and improve responses through iteration.
* Good communication skills and ability to present findings clearly.
* Strong attention to detail and comfort working with structured data.
* Curiosity to learn new HR tech, analytics tools, and automation methods.


**Preferred Skills**
* Knowledge of Power BI, Power Query, DAX, or dashboard creation.
* Basic understanding of SQL, Python, or data visualization concepts.
* Experience with HRMS, ATS, payroll systems, or employee management tools.
* Prior internship, academic project, or personal project involving data analysis, dashboards, or HR analytics.
* Experience using AI tools to create reports, clean data, generate formulas, summarize trends, or automate repetitive work.
* Understanding of recruitment, onboarding, attendance, performance management, or employee lifecycle processes.

description:

Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


We are looking for a driven and intellectually curious Talent Sourcing Specialist to join BCG's APAC
  

Talent Acquisition team in Gurugram. In this role, you will lead proactive sourcing efforts for highpriority technology positions across India, with a strong focus on emerging and in\-demand tech skill
  

areas including Generative AI, Digital Product Management, Software Engineering, and other
  

cutting\-edge technology disciplines.  

Working in close partnership with Recruiters and Hiring Managers, you will own the end\-to\-end
  

sourcing strategy — from market mapping and talent intelligence to candidate engagement and
  

pipeline development — ensuring BCG continues to attract world\-class technology talent.  

  

WHAT YOU'LL DO  

  

* Lead proactive sourcing for critical technology roles across BCG India, spanning Generative AI,

Digital Product, Full\-Stack Engineering, Data Science, Cloud \& Infrastructure, and Platform
  

Engineering.  

* Partner closely with Hiring Managers and Recruiters to define role requirements, ideal

candidate profiles, and tailored sourcing strategies for each position.  

* Identify and engage both active and passive talent through direct outreach, social media

platforms (LinkedIn, GitHub, Kaggle), talent communities, and professional networks.  

* Develop and execute market mapping and talent intelligence exercises to provide data\-driven

insights on talent availability, competitor hiring trends, and compensation benchmarks.  

* Build and manage robust, future\-ready talent pipelines to support both immediate hiring

needs and long\-term workforce planning.  

* Articulate and champion the BCG employee value proposition compellingly across all candidate

interactions, networking events, and brand\-building activities.  

* Conduct initial screening and high\-level assessment of candidates' technical knowledge, skills,

and cultural fit.  

* Maintain accurate, real\-time tracking of candidate pipelines within the Applicant Tracking

System (ATS) and provide regular pipeline health reports to stakeholders.  

  

TECHNOLOGY SKILL AREAS YOU'LL SOURCE FOR  

You will build deep expertise in sourcing talent across BCG's key technology hiring domains,
  

including:  

* Generative AI \& Large Language Models (LLMs) — Prompt Engineers, AI/ML Researchers,

Applied AI Scientists  

* Digital Product Management — Product Managers, Product Owners, Agile Delivery Leads
* Software Engineering — Full\-Stack, Backend, Frontend, Mobile (iOS/Android)
* Data \& Analytics — Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers
* Cloud \& DevOps — Cloud Architects, Site Reliability Engineers (SREs), DevOps/Platform

Engineers  

* Cybersecurity \& Enterprise Technology — Security Engineers, ERP Specialists, IT Architects
  

What You'll Bring

* 2–4\+ years of talent acquisition or sourcing experience, with a strong track record in tech

hiring — agency or in\-house experience in professional services or consulting is a plus.  

* Proven expertise in sourcing for technology roles — ideally including GenAI, Digital Product, or

Engineering talent.  

* Proficiency with modern sourcing tools and platforms: LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, Boolean

search, talent intelligence tools (e.g., HireEZ, SeekOut).  

* Experience conducting talent mapping, competitor analysis, and market benchmarking

exercises.  

* Strong candidate assessment skills with experience in competency/behavioural\-based

screening.  

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to craft compelling outreach and

articulate complex roles clearly.  

* High degree of organisation and the ability to manage multiple concurrent searches without

compromising quality.  

* Creative problem\-solver who can adapt sourcing strategies when conventional approaches

don't yield results.  

* Bachelor's degree with strong academic achievement.

  

Who You'll Work With


BCG's Global Recruiting team is a high\-performing, collaborative function that partners directly with
  

business units to attract and select exceptional talent across every region. You will work alongside
  

Recruiters, Hiring Managers, HR Business Partners, and regional Talent Acquisition leads — with
  

direct exposure to BCG's technology and digital transformation agenda

  

Additional info


At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.  

  

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.  

  

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: People Operations Manager
description:
**Company Description**
**Who We Are**
 Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.
   

  

 We are feeding the world’s curiosity
   

  

**Job Description**
**About the Role**
 People Operations is the operational engine of the People function at Cint.
   

  

 Our mission is to build a scalable, intelligent and employee\-centric operating model that enables the business to grow without increasing complexity. We achieve this by combining exceptional operational excellence with technology, automation and AI.
   

  

 The way companies operate is changing rapidly. AI is transforming how work gets done, employees expect consumer\-grade experiences, and global businesses need operations that scale without adding complexity. Most People Operations functions are still built for yesterday's world. We intend to build one for tomorrow.
   

  

 This role will lead that transformation.
   

  

 You will work closely with People Technology, Employee Relations, People Partners, Talent Teams, Total Rewards, Payroll, IT and Legal. You'll lead the evolution of our global People Operations function, combining operational excellence, technology, automation and AI to build a service that is fast, intelligent and ready for the future.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Build the People Operations function of the future: Redesign how People Operations works globally, creating an operating model that is simple, scalable and built to support a fast\-growing international business.
* Lead with technology, not manual work: Continuously identify opportunities to automate, simplify and redesign processes using AI, workflows and modern HR technology. If a process requires unnecessary manual effort, you'll challenge it.
* Deliver service people actually love: Create an employee and manager experience that is intuitive, responsive and effortless. Great service isn't just about resolving tickets—it's about making support almost invisible.
* Turn operations into a competitive advantage: Own service delivery globally through clear governance, operational controls and meaningful performance metrics that drive continuous improvement.
* Lead and inspire a high\-performing global team: Build a culture of accountability, ownership and innovation where people are empowered to solve problems, improve processes and think beyond today's way of working.
* Partner across the business: Work closely with HR, People Technology, IT, Finance, Legal and business leaders to solve operational challenges, deliver complex initiatives and create joined\-up employee experiences.
* Use data, but apply judgement: Leverage operational metrics and workforce insights to identify trends, predict risks and make better decisions—while recognising that dashboards never replace critical thinking.
* Own complexity so others don't have to: Act as the senior escalation point for complex People Operations matters, balancing compliance, employee experience and business priorities with sound judgement.
* Build for scale before it's needed: Design resilient operations that support organisational growth, new markets and changing business needs without constantly adding more people or processes.
* Never stop improving: Constantly ask why things are done a certain way, challenge existing assumptions and build a culture where continuous improvement is simply how work gets done.


**Qualifications**
**What you'll bring to the role:**
* You've led a global People Operations, HR Operations or Shared Services function.
* You know what world\-class operational excellence looks like \- and how to build it.
* You've transformed operations, not just maintained them.
* You simplify, redesign and scale processes with confidence.
* You think in systems, not tasks.
* You're passionate about AI, automation and the future of work.
* You constantly look for smarter ways to get work done.
* You balance big\-picture strategy with hands\-on execution.
* You make sound decisions, even when the path isn't obvious.
* You balance employee experience, compliance and business needs with confidence.
* You've built high\-performing teams that embrace change.
* You influence senior stakeholders and build strong cross\-functional partnerships.
* You use data to drive decisions, but trust your judgement when it matters.
* You know how to turn HR technology into better experiences—not just digital processes.
* You challenge the status quo and are always looking for a better way.


**Bonus Points If You Have**
* Experience implementing AI\-enabled workflows within HR or business operations.
* Experience with platforms such as HiBob, SmartRecruiters, Ashby, Google Workspace, Slack and other modern People technology.
* Experience leading global shared services or service delivery transformations.
* Experience designing operational dashboards and executive reporting.
* Exposure to service design, organisational design or employee experience initiatives.
* Experience working in a high\-growth international technology company.
* A genuine passion for emerging AI technologies and how they'll reshape the workplace.
* A reputation for turning ambiguity into clear, scalable solutions that have lasting business impact.


**Additional Information**
**Our Values**
**Collaboration is our superpower**
* We uncover rich perspectives across the world
* Success happens together
* We deliver across borders.


**Innovation is in our blood**
* We’re pioneers in our industry
* Our curiosity is insatiable
* We bring the best ideas to life.


**We Do What We Say**
* We’re accountable for our work and actions
* Excellence comes as standard
* We’re open, honest and kind, always.


**We are caring**
* We learn from each other’s experiences
* Stop and listen; every opinion matters
* We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.


**More About Cint**
 We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.
   

  

 In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin\-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US\-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first\-party survey data in over 110 countries.
   

  

 Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (www.cint.com)

* Validate attendance, leave records, salary revisions, recoveries, deductions, incentives, and other payroll inputs.
* Ensure accuracy and confidentiality of payroll data.
* Oversee full and final settlement processes for separating employees.
* Coordinate with Finance and external payroll/compliance partners for timely payroll execution.



  





 3\. Attendance \& Leave Management
 


* Oversee attendance management systems and processes.
* Monitor leave administration and ensure adherence to University policies.
* Resolve attendance and leave\-related discrepancies in a timely manner.
* Ensure timely closure of monthly attendance records for payroll processing.



  





 4\. HRMS \& Employee Data Management

* Ensure data integrity, system accuracy, and timely updates of employee information.
* Generate HR dashboards, reports, and analytics for management review.
* Support digital transformation and automation initiatives within HR Operations.



  





 5\. Compliance Coordination
 


* Coordinate with external compliance consultants and service providers for statutory compliance activities.
* Ensure timely sharing of employee and payroll data required for statutory filings.
* Support internal audits, external audits, inspections, accreditation exercises, and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain compliance\-related records and documentation as per applicable regulations.



  





 6\. Employee Services \& Query Resolution
 


* Act as the primary escalation point for employee queries related to payroll, attendance, leave, benefits, HR records, and employment documentation.
* Ensure timely and effective resolution of employee concerns.
* Enhance employee experience through responsive and service\-oriented HR support.



  





 7\. Policy Implementation \& Process Governance
 


* Ensure effective implementation of HR policies, procedures, and operational guidelines.
* Monitor policy adherence and recommend process enhancements where required.
* Support development and implementation of new HR initiatives and process improvements.



  





 8\. Team Leadership
 


* Lead, guide, and develop the HR Operations and Payroll team.
* Allocate responsibilities, monitor performance, and ensure achievement of operational objectives.
* Build a culture of accountability, accuracy, service excellence, and continuous improvement.



  





 9\. Stakeholder Management
 


* Collaborate with academic and administrative departments to ensure smooth HR service delivery.
* Coordinate closely with Finance, IT, Compliance Partners, and other internal stakeholders.
* Provide operational insights and HR metrics to support decision\-making by University leadership.

* Manage the complete employee lifecycle from onboarding to exit, including employee records, documentation, transfers, promotions, confirmations, and exits.

**What We're Looking For** 



* 2–5 years of experience in HR Operations, Payroll, HR Generalist, or HR Analytics

* Experience working with large volumes of employee data and data from multiple sources.

 :

We are looking to recruit a resource who possesses the ability to distill a bird’s eye view of the overall strategy to an ant’s eye view across functional teams strategy. description:
**Overview**
 Founded in 1988, Trimont (www.trimont.com) is a specialized global commercial real estate loan services provider and partner for lenders and investors seeking the infrastructure and capabilities needed to help them scale their business and make informed, effective decisions related to the deployment, management and administration of commercial real estate secured credit. As the largest master servicer of commercial real estate loans in the United States, Trimont manages securitizations with meticulous oversight and coordination—protecting cash flows, mitigating risk, and ensuring portfolio performance.
   

  

 We do this with a team of 1100\+ extraordinary team members who serve a global client base from offices in Atlanta (headquarters), Bengaluru, Charlotte, Dallas, Hyderabad, Kansas City, London, New York and Sydney. We empower our people with advanced technology, industry\-leading knowledge, and a culture centered on our core values. This approach enables our teams to deliver exceptional client service, build lasting relationships and take pride in the high\-quality work they perform.
   

  

 Trimont is an innovative firm where visionary professionals come to learn, grow, and thrive with colleagues driven by curiosity and collaboration.
   

  

**Learn:** 
 We believe ongoing learning is critical and are focused on providing a work environment where all team members can take ownership of their careers.
   

  

**Grow:** 
 We work alongside the largest institutional lenders in the world, overseeing the most significant projects in the industry. This unique opportunity allows us to broaden our skillset and develop our abilities by tackling some of the industry’s most challenging and exciting endeavors.
   

  

**Thrive:** 
 Our firm is a place where ethics and excellence meet to create an experience that matches our capabilities. There are no limits to what we as team members and as an organization, can achieve together.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a highly analytical and business\-focused
 **Analyst Data \& Insights Professional** 
 to transform raw data into actionable insights that inform strategic decision\-making. This high\-impact role sits at the intersection of
 **data analytics, business intelligence, automation, and GenAI\-enabled insight generation** 
 .
   

  

 The ideal candidate will champion a
 **data\-driven and AI\-aware culture** 
 , mentor others, and continuously evolve analytics capabilities using modern tools and responsible AI practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Insights \& Strategy**
* Transform complex data into actionable insights that support strategic and operational decision\-making.
* Identify trends, outliers, and key performance drivers across functions using advanced analytics, structured querying, and AI\-enabled techniques.
* Develop executive\-ready dashboards and reports with strong narrative context and clear recommendations.
* Leverage GenAI tools to accelerate insight discovery, analysis, and storytelling where appropriate.


**Reporting \& Analytics Excellence**
* Own the full reporting lifecycle: data sourcing, SQL\-based data modeling, automation, validation, visualization, and enhancement.
* Write, optimize, and maintain complex, performant SQL queries and reusable datasets.
* Ensure consistency, accuracy, and clarity in reporting outputs.
* Define and govern data definitions, metric logic, and standards to maintain a single version of the truth, including responsible use of AI\-generated outputs.


**Tools, Automation \& Platform Development**
* Design, build, and maintain Power Apps solutions to streamline data capture, workflows, and business self\-service.
* Use VBA to automate repetitive reporting tasks, data preparation, and operational workflows.
* Apply Python for data analysis, transformation, and exploratory analytics as needed.
* Integrate Power Platform, BI tools, and AI\-enabled capabilities to deliver scalable and intuitive analytics solutions.
* Apply GenAI fundamentals such as prompt design, insight validation, and workflow augmentation to improve productivity and reporting efficiency.
* Continuously evaluate and enhance the BI and analytics ecosystem, including emerging AI and GenAI capabilities.


**Innovation, Enablement \& Leadership**
* Mentor analysts and business partners on advanced SQL, analytical thinking, GenAI fundamentals, and effective insight development.
* Explore opportunities in predictive analytics, forecasting, and AI\-assisted modeling to move from descriptive to prescriptive insights.
* Stay current on GenAI trends and responsible AI practices, assessing applicability to analytics and decision support.
* Promote best practices, reusable assets, and standards to strengthen a data\-driven culture.


**Required Qualifications**
* 0\-1 year of hands\-on experience in analytics, business intelligence, or reporting roles
* Strong expertise in SQL, including complex query development, optimization, and dataset modeling
* Proven experience building high\-quality Power BI dashboards with strong performance and business context
* Demonstrated ability to analyze data to identify trends, outliers, and performance drivers
* Experience managing the end\-to\-end reporting and analytics lifecycle
* Working knowledge of Power Apps and the Power Platform for data capture, automation, or self\-service
* Basic proficiency in VBA and Python for data analysis, reporting automation, and workflow efficiency
* Exposure to GenAI tools or analytics copilots, including prompt design and validation of AI\-generated insights
* Strong communication skills with the ability to translate analysis into concise, executive\-ready narratives
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field (or equivalent experience)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Advanced Power BI skills, including data modeling, DAX, and performance optimization
* Experience defining data governance standards and metric frameworks
* Hands\-on use of GenAI to augment analytics workflows (insight discovery, summarization, narration)
* Exposure to forecasting, trend analysis, or basic predictive analytics
* Experience in financial services, operations, SaaS, or enterprise analytics environments
* Strong background working with large datasets and multiple data sources
* Understanding of responsible AI practices, including validation, bias awareness, and data privacy


 Trimont is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud to support and celebrate diversity in the workplace. If you have a disability and need an accommodation or assistance with the application process and/or using our website, please contact us. We are proud to maintain a drug\-free policy, ensuring that our community is a secure and productive space for all our team members.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION** 




  





**Summary/Objective:** 




  





 House of Spices (India) is seeking a Data Engineer to design, build, maintain, and optimize data solutions that support reporting, analytics, and data\-driven decision\-making across the organization. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience in T\-SQL, Azure Data Services, data warehousing, data modeling, and ETL/ELT development. This role will work closely with BI developers, IT teams, and business stakeholders to develop reliable, scalable, and well\-documented data pipelines and data models. The Data Engineer will help improve data quality, performance, and availability while supporting enterprise reporting needs, including data from Microsoft Dynamics NAV / Business Central and other business systems.
 



**Essential Functions** 




**Data Solution Development:**



* Build, enhance, and support reliable data solutions for reporting, analytics, and system integration needs.
* Create, update, and optimize logical and physical data models to improve data accuracy, scalability, and query performance.



**ETL/ELT Development:**



* Build, maintain, and troubleshoot ETL/ELT processes using T\-SQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics and other Azure data services.
* Monitor, tune, and resolve issues in data pipelines to support reliable processing, timely data availability, and production stability.



**Azure Data Engineering:**



* Develop and support data pipelines using Azure Data Factory and Azure Synapse Analytics.
* Desirable: Support data orchestration and workflow automation using Azure Logic Apps and related Azure services.



**Data Warehousing:**



* Build and maintain data warehouse tables, views, stored procedures, and related objects that support BI and reporting needs.
* Tune data warehouse queries and objects to improve report performance, data retrieval, and processing efficiency.



**Data Governance \& Quality:**



* Apply data governance, security, and compliance standards while developing and maintaining data solutions.
* Develop and run data quality checks, validation rules, and reconciliation processes to maintain trusted and accurate data.



**Collaboration \& Communication:**



* Work with BI developers, data scientists, IT teams, and business stakeholders to convert approved requirements into working data pipelines, datasets, and technical deliverables.



  





**Competencies** 




  




1. **Teamwork \& Collaboration.** 
 Works effectively with BI developers, IT teams, data analysts, business users, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
2. **Clear Communication.** 
 Communicates technical information clearly and professionally to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
3. **Ethical Handling of Data.** 
 Handles business, customer, financial, and operational data responsibly while following confidentiality, security, and compliance expectations.
4. **Analytical Thinking \& Problem Solving.** 
 Investigates data issues, identifies root causes, and applies practical solutions to support accurate reporting and reliable data processing.
5. **Attention to Detail.** 
 Reviews data pipelines, queries, transformations, and outputs carefully to reduce errors and improve data accuracy.
6. **Data Quality Mindset.** 
 Maintains a strong focus on validation, reconciliation, consistency, completeness, and trustworthiness of data.
7. **Technical Troubleshooting.** 
 Monitors, diagnoses, and resolves issues related to data pipelines, SQL queries, performance, and data availability.
8. **Adaptability \& Continuous Learning.** 
 Learns new tools, technologies, business processes, and data sources as needed to support changing business and reporting needs.



  





**Supervisory Responsibility** 




 This position is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. The employee may be expected to share knowledge, document best practices, and support knowledge\-transfer sessions for team members and business users as needed.
 



**Work Environment** 




 This job operates primarily in a remote professional work environment. The employee is expected to maintain a reliable internet connection, use company\-approved collaboration and communication tools, and work effectively with teams across India and U.S. business hours. Based on business requirements, the employee may be required to visit the Mumbai office for corporate meetings approximately one to four times per month. This role routinely uses standard technology and office equipment such as laptop computers, monitors, smartphones, and collaboration software.
 



**Position Type/Expected Hours of Work** 




 This is a full\-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday to Friday, 2:00 p.m. to 10:30 p.m. IST, unless otherwise assigned based on business needs. This schedule is intended to support required overlap with U.S. business hours. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required as job duties demand.
 



**Travel** 




 No travel is expected for this position.
 



**Qualifications** 




**Required Qualifications** 



* Graduate or post\-graduate degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related field.
* 4–7 years of hands\-on experience in data engineering, database development, ETL/ELT development, or related data roles.
* Strong hands\-on experience with T\-SQL, including complex queries, stored procedures, views, joins, indexing concepts, and performance tuning.
* Hands\-on experience building, maintaining, and troubleshooting ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory and related Azure data services.
* Working knowledge of data lake and lakehouse concepts, including structured and semi\-structured data storage, transformation, and downstream reporting use cases.
* Working knowledge of data warehousing concepts, including fact tables, dimension tables, star schema, and reporting\-focused data structures.
* Experience creating and maintaining logical and physical data models to support reporting, analytics, and data integration needs.
* Ability to troubleshoot data issues, validate data accuracy, and support reconciliation between source systems and reporting outputs.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and debugging skills with the ability to work under deadlines.
* Good communication skills with the ability to explain technical details clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Good documentation skills for data pipelines, data models, transformation logic, and support procedures.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Familiarity with Azure Logic Apps for workflow automation and integration.
* Experience with Azure Analysis Services and Azure DevOps.
* Familiarity with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI or SSRS.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate or other relevant data/cloud certifications.
* Previous experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV / Business Central data.
* Business process experience in the food supply and distribution industry.
* Experience working with global teams, global clients, or cross\-cultural stakeholders.
* Ability to support user training or knowledge\-sharing sessions when needed.

title: Quantitative Researcher - Early Career (INDIA)
description:
Trexquant is a systematic hedge fund where we use thousands of statistical algorithms to trade equity, futures and other markets globally. Starting with many data sets, we develop large sets of features and use various machine learning methods to discover trading signals and effectively combine them into market\-neutral portfolios. We are looking for data scientists, physicists, engineers, economists and programmers to develop the next generation of machine learning strategies that can accurately predict the future movements of liquid financial assets.
 



 Our Quantitative Researchers are embedded within the following teams{{:}}
 



**Alpha Researcher{{:}}** 




 As a member of the Alpha Researcher team, you will be involved in developing market\-neutral signals, parsing and analyzing large data sets and collaborating with the Data and Strategy Research team to build a diverse set of predictive models.
 



**Data Scientist{{:}}** 




 As a member of the Data Science team, you will be involved in parsing and analyzing large data sets, working on discovering and obtaining new sources of data and collaborating with the Alpha and Strategy team to build predictive machine learning models.
 



**Strategy Researcher{{:}}** 




 As a member of the Strategy team, you will be developing systematic strategies based on a variety of machine learning and statistical methods. The data you train and validate comes from actual market trading
 



 When you apply for a Quantitative Researcher role at Trexquant, we will first assess you on the core skills required for the Quantitative Researcher. During the interview process, we will be able to get to know you better, learn about your strengths and match you to the best research team that closely aligns with your skills and preference.
 



**Your Responsibilities{{:}}** 



* Design, implement, and optimize various machine learning models aimed at predicting liquid assets using a wide set of financial data and a vast library of trading signals
* Parse data sets to be used for future alpha(strategy) development
* Investigate and implement state\-of\-the\-art academic research in the field of quantitative finance
* Collaborate with experienced and resourceful quantitative researchers to carry out experiments and test hypothesis using simulations


**Requirements**
* Graduate degree (Bachelors, Masters, or PhD) in any STEM discipline from a prestigious institution
* Passion for machine learning and quantitative finance
* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Ability to work effectively both as an individual and a team player
* Proficient in programming languages such as Python
* Previous experience in alpha research and the development of trading signals and strategies
* The role is also open for candidates graduating from Tier 1 campuses in 2027


**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation with bonus tied to the performance of algorithms you develop
* Work in a collaborative and friendly environment, participate in decision\-making process for research direction, and have opportunity to lead on new ideas
* Pre\-tax commuter benefits
* Weekly company meals



 Trexquant is an Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Data Scientist
description:
As a Data Scientist on the AI \& ML (Data Collection) team, you will own AI\-powered solutions that extract structured information from PitchBook's reports, news, and other content. You will apply data analysis, machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), and generative AI to improve the quality, coverage, and timeliness of PitchBook data.
   

  

 You will take end\-to\-end responsibility for data science initiatives, from problem definition, data exploration, and success metrics through model development, evaluation, production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Your work may include large language models (LLMs), retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, and other information\-extraction techniques.
   

  

 You will collaborate with Product Managers, Machine Learning Engineers, Software Engineers, and domain experts to deliver scalable solutions. You will remain accountable for model quality and business impact after launching by evaluating performance, investigating regressions, and guiding improvements through data and experimentation. You will also contribute through peer reviews, reproducible work, documentation, and knowledge sharing.
   

  

 You will join a multidisciplinary team of Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers developing AI and ML capabilities for PitchBook's data collection pipelines. Data Scientists own the analytical and modeling lifecycle and partner with engineering teams to operationalize, scale, and maintain successful solutions.
   

  

**Primary Job Responsibilities**
* End\-to\-End Data Science Ownership: Own extraction and enrichment problems from discovery through production and continuous improvement. Define the problem, select data and methods, establish success criteria, evaluate results, and monitor outcomes
* Problem Formulation \& Data Strategy: Translate business requirements into measurable data science problems. Explore structured and unstructured data, identify quality and source\-variability issues, and define training, validation, test, and labeling requirements with domain partners
* Model Development \& Experimentation: Design and optimize NLP, machine learning, and LLM solutions for document understanding and information extraction

title: AI Engineer
description:
**About Fermi**
 Fermi is an early\-stage AI tutoring startup, an initiative of Meraki Labs, dedicated to revolutionizing education globally. Our mission is to democratize world\-class tutoring by making it accessible to every student through advanced AI. We are a dynamic and lean team of educators, designers, and engineers, united by a strong conviction that thoughtful design and cutting\-edge AI can profoundly transform the learning experience.
   

  

 Led by experienced founders, including Mukesh Bansal (Founder – Myntra, CureFit, Nurix) and Peeyush Ranjan (VP\-Google, CTO\-Flipkart, Airbnb), we are building a product that aims to reshape how millions of students learn—turning academic challenges into accomplishments. We operate out of Bangalore, India, fostering a high\-velocity environment that prioritizes impact, ownership, and direct collaboration to define and build the future of AI in education.
   

  

****Role Overview****
 We’re hiring an
 **AI Engineer** 
 who is a
 **problem\-solver first** 
 : someone who can
 **ship** 
 ,
 **debug** 
 , and
 **iterate fast** 
 . You’ll help build the core AI workflows powering our tutoring product—especially
 **agentic tutoring systems** 
 —and harden them into
 **production\-grade** 
 ,
 **scalable** 
 ,
 **observable** 
 systems.
   

  

 This role is intentionally not for everyone. If you want tight scope, predictable tasks, or “only research / only backend,” this won’t fit. If you like building real systems end\-to\-end and seeing your work hit production quickly, you’ll love it.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Build and ship core AI workflows for our tutoring app:
+ agentic tutoring flows (hinting, step\-by\-step guidance, misconception detection)
+ answer evaluation / grading and feedback loops
+ retrieval \+ grounding (content ingestion, chunking, embedding, re\-ranking)
+ personalization (student memory, progress signals, difficulty adaptation)
+ multimodal pipelines (images/diagrams; bonus if you’ve touched voice)

* Turn prototypes into robust production systems:
+ latency \+ cost optimization (caching, batching, streaming, fallbacks)
+ eval\-driven iteration (offline test sets, regression checks, quality gates)
+ observability (traces, logs, metrics, prompt/version tracking)
+ reliability \+ safety (guardrails, refusal behavior, policy/age\-appropriate output)

* Own features end\-to\-end:
+ from rough PRD → implementation → deployment → monitoring → iteration

* Collaborate closely with product/design/education to translate learning goals into AI behavior.


****What We’re Looking For (Must\-have Signals)****
**Core engineering**
* 1 to 5 years of strong Python fundamentals; you can write clean code and also “hack” when needed.
* Comfortable building services with FastAPI/Flask, writing APIs, and debugging production issues.
* Practical understanding of Docker, local dev workflows, and basic deployment concepts.
* Good CS foundations (data structures, basic systems thinking, debugging).


**AI engineering readiness**
* Hands\-on experience with at least one:
+ OpenAI SDK (or similar), LangChain, Haystack (or comparable LLM framework)

* You understand the difference between:
+ prompting vs tooling vs retrieval vs agents vs evals

* You’ve built something real:
+ internships, substantial course projects, shipped side projects, research engineering, or open\-source contributions.


**Pedigree / proof of work (we care about evidence, not labels)**
* CS background preferred (or equivalent demonstrated capability).
* Strong signal from top engineering programs in India or an equivalent track record (exceptional projects / OSS / internships that clearly show you can perform).


****How You Work (This Matters)****
 You’ll do well here if you:
   

  

* default to ownership: you don’t wait to be told every step
* can move fast without being sloppy
* enjoy ambiguity and turn it into clear execution
* treat quality as an engineering problem: tests, evals, instrumentation, iteration


****Why Join Fermi?****
* Build core AI product (not demos) that students use daily.
* Massive scope for learning: agents, evals, multimodal tutoring, production hardening.
* Small team, high trust, direct impact—your code ships and matters.
* Work with a team that cares about craft, not just hype.


****This is not for you If…****
* You want remote/hybrid (this is onsite Bangalore only).
* You prefer narrow tickets and minimal ambiguity.
* You’re not excited about production engineering (monitoring, reliability, cost, latency).
* You’re mainly looking for a “research\-only” role.

title: Intermediate Quality Engineer - Performance Testing [T500-28605]
description:
**About CIBC:** 




 CIBC is a leading North American bank, with a history of more than 150 years of living our purpose \- to help make your ambition a reality. Client relationships are at the center of our strategy, and our growth is enabled by a highly engaged and connected global team. From digital banking to community impact, we’re proud to drive progress for our clients and our communities. Recognized for our culture, award\-winning innovation and community investment, CIBC continues to evolve by putting people and progress at the center of everything we do.
 



  





**About CIBC India:** 




 CIBC India is a technology and operations hub in Hyderabad, where you’ll be part of our highly engaged and global team, and play a central role in supporting our growth. Whether you’re driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you’ll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting\-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.
 



  





**What CIBC India Offers:** 




 At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.
 


* We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance\-based incentive programs, a family\-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points\-based recognition program
* Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide
* We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development



  





**What You’ll Be Doing (position summary):** 




 The Intermediate Performance Testing Engineer leads performance testing activities within CIBC’s Enterprise Technology (ET) Quality Engineering (QE) team. This role is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining performance test cases and automated performance test scripts, coordinating end\-to\-end test support, and ensuring all testing processes meet quality standards and project timelines. The incumbent works closely with project managers, developers, quality engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver high\-quality solutions and continuous improvement in testing methodologies.
 



 At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on\-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.
 



  





**How You’ll Succeed (responsibilities):** 




**Testing Expertise:** 



* Lead the investigation and translation of business and technical requirements into performance test cases.
* Design and manage end\-to\-end performance testing activities for multiple projects.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive performance test plans, schedules, and resource allocations.
* Develop and maintain automated test cases and test suites using performance testing tools.
* Execute performance test cases, document results, and manage defects throughout the testing lifecycle.
* Prepare and present status reports, test metrics, and risk assessments to project leadership.
* Ensure all testing activities comply with organizational policies, industry standards, and regulatory requirements.



  





**Defect \& Compliance Management:** 



* Manage defects throughout their lifecycle, ensuring timely resolution and documentation.
* Identify, manage, and implement remediation for any noncompliance items and deviations.
* Ensure adherence to QA/QE standards and support the implementation of new standards.
* Recognize and identify areas for process, policy, or tool improvement.



  





**Performance Testing Expertise:** 



* Create and execute performance test strategies, tools, and frameworks.
* Build performance testing scripts and integrate them with DevOps tools.



  





**Leadership Skills:** 



* Coach and mentor testing team members in business domain, performance testing, automation, and non\-functional testing.
* Ensure test teams are compliant with CIBC’s test methodologies and industry best practices.
* Identify opportunities to enhance testing processes, tools, and methodologies.
* Proactively identify and address issues throughout all test phases.



  





**Project Coordination:** 



* Coordinate efforts of internal and external testing teams to ensure timely completion of test phases.
* Identify and communicate obstacles or risks impacting project timelines or success.
* Provide regular status updates to stakeholders and escalate issues as necessary.
* Ensure performance test deliverables are received, approved, and aligned to project goals and budget.



  





**CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:** 



* Serve as the primary point of contact for all performance testing\-related communications among project stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and technology partners to ensure quality standards are met.
* Work closely with project managers, developers, quality engineers, and external vendors to coordinate performance testing activities and resolve issues.



  





**COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES:** 



* As an employee of CIBC, the incumbent must comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines, and controls.



  





**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:** 



* As a key contributor to the business unit, this job has the authority to recommend changes to business processes in order to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.



  





**JOB DIMENSIONS:** 



* Scope includes coordination of performance, batch and operability testing activities for ET QA projects.
* Responsible for managing performance testing efforts across multiple projects and teams.
* Responsible for supporting quality assurance across various geographies and business lines as assigned.
* Direct influence over the quality of deliverables impacting ET QA projects
* Advisory responsibilities for process improvement and technology adoption within the team.



  





**Experience:** 
 5\+ years of experience
 



**Who You Are (skills/qualifications):** 



* 5\+ years QA/QE experience, minimum 2\+ years of experience in a Performance Test Coordination role, with proficient knowledge of Testing Life Cycle, SDLC, and Defect Management.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience working with performance testing tools.
* Web UI, API/web services, batch performance test experience. Preferably for financial, banking, planning and budgeting applications.



  





**Must Have Skills:** 



* Strong Banking Applications knowledge and experiences.
* Performance Testing Tools – NeoLoad/NeoLoad Web/JMeter.
* Artefacts repositories \- GitHub.
* Experience in working with AI LLM’s – GTP/Cloude/GitHub Pilot/Databricks Genie
* AI LLM’s Integrations with test tools via MCP’s.
* Defect and Test management tools (Any tool \- OpenText AQM, JIRA, Confluence).
* Experience in preparing performance test plans and test cases \& responsible for execution.
* Ability to support multiple projects concurrently.
* Strong organizational, time management, and communication skills.
* Ability to coach and mentor team members, and influence outcomes through expertise.
* Commitment to continuous learning and staying abreast of emerging technologies and industry developments.



  





**Good to Have:** 



* Experience in Finance or equivalent ERP systems (e.g. PeopleSoft, SAP) is a big asset.
* Other performance testing tools \- LoadRunner
* CI/CD tools – Jenkins/GitHub Actions
* Automation Testing (Any tools \- Tosca DI/Python/Selenium/Robot Framework/Parasoft SOAtest/Postman/RestAssured/ Cucumber/Kainos Smart).
* Working knowledge of cloud/Azure environment (e.g., Databricks).
* Power BI or data visualization tools knowledge.
* Familiar with AI trends and opportunities related to QE.

 By proceeding with the creation of a profile and submitting an application in response to this job posting, you acknowledge and agree that your personal data will be collected, used, retained and disclosed by CIBC India and its affiliates, as described in the Candidate Privacy Statement.

* Understanding of database schemas, table spaces, indexing, and performance optimization techniques

* Experience using and/or developing on a Unix/Linux platform

Whether you are working directly with customers, driving go to market strategies, supporting operations, building products, or enabling teams, your contributions help shape the future of software quality for organizations worldwide. Join us in our mission.
 



**DevOps Engineer \- Test Hub** 




 You'll be joining a globally distributed team with engineers in Bengaluru, Poland, Ireland, and the United States. We're a highly collaborative group at various skill levels — we invest in each other's growth, enjoy solving hard problems together, and don't take ourselves too seriously while doing it. If you want to deepen your technical expertise in cloud\-native engineering while working with a team that genuinely values curiosity and good humour, you'll fit right in.
 



**About the Role** 




 We're looking for a hands\-on DevOps Engineer with 4–5\+ years of experience to join a highly collaborative, globally distributed engineering team. You'll own cloud infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and operational reliability — partnering closely with development and product teams across Bengaluru, Poland, Ireland, and the United States.
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions — covering build, test, security scanning, and multi\-environment deployments for web applications throughout their full lifecycle.
* Provision and manage scalable, highly available cloud infrastructure on AWS (primary) and Azure using Terraform; architect greenfield environments following IaC best practices.
* Deploy, configure, and operate containerized workloads on Kubernetes using Helm charts; manage cluster lifecycle, namespaces, RBAC, and networking policies.
* Build and maintain Docker images and container registries; enforce image security scanning and vulnerability remediation within the pipeline.
* Develop automation scripts and tooling in Python and Bash to reduce toil, enforce consistency, and support development teams across the organization.
* Instrument applications and infrastructure with observability tooling (metrics, logs, traces) to ensure system health visibility and enable proactive incident detection.
* Lead and participate in incident response — from detection and triage through root\-cause analysis and post\-incident review — driving continuous reliability improvements.
* Collaborate with Development, Product, and Support teams to build high\-availability processes and translate non\-functional requirements into operational reality.
* Author clear, maintainable documentation for all systems, runbooks, and processes across internal and external applications.



**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 



* 4\+ years of experience in a DevOps, Platform Engineering, or SRE role in a cloud\-native environment.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS (EC2, ECS/EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, Route 53, CloudWatch) and a working knowledge of Azure.
* Proficiency with Terraform for infrastructure\-as\-code; experience structuring reusable modules and managing remote state.
* Strong GitHub Actions experience — writing custom workflows, reusable actions, matrix builds, and environment\-gated deployments.
* Solid Kubernetes skills: deployments, services, ingress, config/secrets management, resource limits, HPA, and cluster troubleshooting.
* Experience packaging and deploying applications with Helm; authoring and customizing Helm charts.
* Proficiency with Docker — multi\-stage builds, layer optimization, and container security practices.
* Practical scripting in Python and Bash for automation, tooling, and operational tasks.
* Experience with observability platforms (e.g. Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana, CloudWatch, or equivalent) — dashboards, alerting, SLOs/SLIs.
* Demonstrated experience in on\-call and incident response — clear triage process, effective communication, and blameless post\-mortems.
* Strong command of git, branching strategies, and source\-code management workflows.



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience with CloudFormation or Ansible alongside Terraform.
* Familiarity with Rancher for Kubernetes cluster management.
* Experience with SonarQube, Nexus, or similar quality/artefact management tools.
* Exposure to FinOps practices — tagging strategies, cost allocation, and cloud spend optimization.
* Familiarity with service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd) or advanced networking patterns

* You can grow your career at every level.

description:
**Job Title: Azure DevOps Engineer (AI \& Automation)** 




  





**Location: Noida** 




  





**Experience: Min 2\+ Years** 




  





**Department: Engineering / Infrastructure \& Platform** 




  





**Role Overview** 




**We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to own our core DevOps administration while leading the** 




**implementation of AI\-driven development workflows. In this role, you will manage** 




**repositories, establish automated CI/CD pipelines, and design autonomous coding, testing,** 




**and code\-review agents using technologies like Claude Code, Anthropic Agent SDK, and** 




**GitHub Copilot Workspace/Agents. You will bridge classical platform engineering with AI** 




**native software development lifecycles.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. DevOps Administration \& Repository Management** 




**• Repository Architecture: Design, enforce, and maintain repository branching strategies** 




**(e.g., Trunk\-Based, GitFlow, Feature\-Branching) and access governance across** 




**organizations.** 




**• CI/CD Pipeline Engineering: Build, optimize, and secure multi\-environment** 




**deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps with caching** 




**and automated quality gates.** 




**• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Provision and manage cloud resources using Terraform,** 




**Pulumi, or Bicep, ensuring zero\-drift environments.** 




**• DevSecOps Integration: Implement automated secret scanning (e.g., Gitleaks),** 




**dependency vulnerability checks (Trivy/Snyk), and SAST/DAST within CI steps.** 




**2\. AI Coding Agent Setup \& Branch Workflows** 




**• Coding Agent Deployment: Configure and orchestrate developer AI agents (e.g.,** 




**Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Cloud Agents, or custom agent frameworks) to perform** 




**autonomous task execution across different Git branches.** 




**• Repository Context \& Prompts: Author and maintain repository\-level context files** 




**(AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, custom system prompts, and MCP server integrations) to** 




**steer agents toward project conventions and architecture patterns.** 




**• Multi\-Branch Automation: Configure workflow triggers that allow AI agents to pick up** 




**issue tickets, work within dedicated feature/bugfix branches, and automatically draft** 




**PRs.** 














**3\. Automated Code Review \& Testing Agents** 




**• Code Review Agents: Integrate automated AI code\-review agents within pull request** 




**workflows to perform compliance checks, security audits, and style adherence reviews** 




**before human sign\-off.** 




**• Automated Testing \& QA Agents: Build autonomous testing pipelines where agents** 




**analyze diffs, generate missing unit/integration tests, triage test failures, and suggest** 




**fixes directly in CI.** 




**• Governance \& Safeguards: Establish strict safety guardrails, execution sandboxes, and** 




**human\-in\-the\-loop approvals for agent\-generated code.** 




**Technical Qualifications** 




**Must\-Have Experience** 




**• Core DevOps (2\+ Years): Hands\-on expertise in CI/CD pipeline building, Docker,** 




**Kubernetes, and IaC (Terraform/Bicep/CloudFormation).** 




**• Git Administration: Mastery of Git internals, branch protection rules, merge strategies,** 




**and repository permissions.** 




**• AI Coding Tools \& SDKs: Proven experience configuring or extending GitHub Copilot** 




**(Copilot Workspace, Agent Mode, Custom Instructions/Skills) or Claude (Claude Code** 




**CLI, Anthropic API/SDK, Model Context Protocol).** 




**• Automation Languages: High proficiency in Python, Bash, or TypeScript/Node.js for** 




**building custom hooks, bots, and API integrations.** 




  





**Nice\-to\-Have Experience** 




**• Experience building multi\-agent orchestrations (e.g., CrewAI, LangChain, or custom** 




**sub\-agents).** 




**• Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) server setups to connect AI agents with** 




**internal tooling, databases, and monitoring systems.** 




**• Deep understanding of DevSecOps standards and cloud infrastructure cost** 




**optimization.** 









**Expected 90\-Day Deliverables** 




**Month 1: Audit existing repos and establish standardized CI/CD templates and branch** 




**protection rules across all development projects.** 




**Month 2: Deploy initial Claude / GitHub Copilot agent workflows for automated PR code** 




**reviews and unit test generation.** 




**Month 3: Fully operationalize an end\-to\-end agentic workflow where feature tickets can be** 




**assigned to branch\-specific coding agents to generate, test, and submit initial pull requests.**

description:
**Positions \-** 
 1

 Tech Lead / Architect

 with occasional travel to the pilot hospital
