title: Workday Support Specialist
description:
**Job title** 
 : Workday Support Specialist
   

  

* Location: Hyderabad


**About The Function**
 The People Services Technology \& Solutions (PPLS) team is a key enabler of Opella's HR digital transformation. It leverages technology to streamline HR processes, optimise system performance, and support operational teams. Following the Workday Greenfield Go\-Live, the team ensures business continuity through a hybrid, AI\-enabled support model spanning Level 0 (AI self\-service) to Level 3 (product ownership).
   

  

 The L1 Support team acts as the single, centralised first human support layer — close to the business — providing triage, user guidance, demand validation, and operational resolution for Workday\-related queries and incidents.
   

  

**PURPOSE OF THE ROLE**
 As a Workday L1 Support Specialist, you are an essential member of the first human support layer for Workday at Opella. This is a junior, structured\-entry role designed to build deep Workday operational expertise over time. You will handle day\-to\-day support requests, execute mass data loads following documented procedures, maintain and refresh standard reports, and ensure every ticket is accurately triaged, resolved, or escalated with full documentation. You will work closely with Senior Specialists who will guide, coach, and review your work, helping you grow into an independent Workday practitioner. You will also contribute directly to the AI\-enabled support vision by maintaining an up\-to\-date knowledge base for OpellaGPT and ServiceNow HRSD.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Foundation \& Workday Operations
* Handle standard foundation data requests: access provisioning, position management support, and supervisory organisation queries, following documented runbooks.
* Execute pre\-approved Standard Service Requests (SSRs) under defined procedures: role assignments and standard data updates.
* Perform first\-line incident diagnosis: identify the issue, guide users to resolution, and triage to senior colleagues or L2 as needed with full, structured documentation.
* Collect information and coordinate approvals for non\-standard service requests under senior guidance.
* Support first\-line diagnosis, user guidance, and triage across Core HCM, Foundation, Rewards \& Performance, People Success, and External Workforce modules.
* Serve as a point of contact for Workday incidents and service requests raised via ServiceNow HRSD, managing your personal case queue proactively.
* Mass Data Management
* Execute Workday mass data loads (EIBs / iLoads) using validated templates and documented procedures provided by the senior team.
* Perform pre\-load data checks: verify file format, required fields, completeness, and alignment with source data before submission.
* Monitor load results, identify errors, and coordinate corrections with senior colleagues or the data owner; escalate where required.
* Log all load activities accurately; update load documentation and runbooks after each execution.
* Support data integrity checks before and after mass loads; flag anomalies and discrepancies promptly.
* Workday Reporting – Maintenance \& Standard Builds
* Maintain existing standard and custom Workday reports: refresh on schedule, validate outputs, and distribute to stakeholders as per the agreed distribution list.
* Execute standard report requests (SSR) using defined templates and documented procedures, under senior guidance.
* Support the setup and management of report scheduling and distribution lists.
* Investigate report output discrepancies; document findings clearly and escalate to senior colleagues with full context.
* Develop a working understanding of Workday Standard, Custom, and Matrix report types, progressing towards independent builds with coaching.
* Assist in validating report accuracy against source data as directed by senior team members.
* Data Accuracy \& Basic Audit Support
* Apply careful, methodical data quality standards across all ticket handling, data entries, and load executions.
* Validate information before acting; flag anomalies and inconsistencies to senior colleagues without delay.
* Support periodic data and access audit activities as directed, providing accurate documentation of your work.
* Maintain audit\-ready records of every load, ticket, and resolution you own.
* Assist in identifying recurring data discrepancy patterns and escalate findings to the senior team for root\-cause analysis.
* ServiceNow HRSD \& Ticket Management
* Triage incoming ServiceNow HRSD cases: validate business context, apply the correct service category and priority, and route accurately.
* Manage your personal case queue within SLA targets; flag at\-risk tickets to the team lead proactively.
* Provide clear, empathetic user guidance for Workday queries across all supported modules.
* Escalate to senior colleagues or L2 with full context documentation when tickets exceed L1 scope, minimising back\-and\-forth.
* Follow HRSD workflows and use the HR knowledge base to attempt resolution before escalating.
* Maintain accurate and timely ticket documentation in ServiceNow HRSD after every interaction.
* AI Enablement \& Continuous Improvement
* Document resolution steps clearly and completely for every resolved ticket to enrich the AI knowledge base (OpellaGPT / ServiceNow HRSD).
* Flag recurring issues, error patterns, or user confusion trends to senior colleagues for AI use case identification.
* Participate in team sessions on AI agent training, knowledge base validation, and knowledge base article review.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing within the team; apply feedback from senior colleagues to continuously improve quality.
* Proactively develop Workday functional, mass data, and reporting knowledge through daily practice and structured learning.
* Governance \& Operational Reporting
* Maintain accurate and timely ticket and load documentation in ServiceNow HRSD at all times.
* Support SLA trend reporting as directed by the team lead.
* Assist in annual HR business cycle activities (compensation cycle, year\-end review, Your Voice survey) under senior guidance.
* Contribute to user access audit support activities as directed.


**SCOPE OF SUPPORT**
* Foundation
+ Access provisioning
+ Supervisory organisation and position management queries
+ Standard role assignments
+ Examples: Supervisory org not visible, standard access request, position creation query

* Core HCM
+ First\-level diagnosis
+ User guidance
+ Ticket triage
+ Employee lifecycle support
+ Examples: Hire BP stuck, absence balance not updated, employee record query

* Reward \& Performance
+ First\-level diagnosis
+ Triage
+ Standard report requests
+ One\-time correction support under guidance
+ Examples: Bonus not calculating, allowance assignment update

* People Success
+ First\-level diagnosis
+ Triage
+ Requisition and recruiter management updates
+ Examples: Requisition stuck in approval, candidate not progressing

* External Workforce
+ Data management
+ Onboarding/offboarding triage
+ Examples: Contingent worker status not updated

* Mass Data Management
+ Execution of mass data loads using validated templates
+ Pre\-load checks
+ Error monitoring
+ Load log maintenance
+ Examples: EIB execution for position upload, cost centre update, employee data correction

* Reporting – Maintenance
+ Refresh and validate existing standard and custom reports
+ Schedule and distribution management
+ Discrepancy escalation
+ Standard report builds under guidance
+ Examples: Standard report refresh, report scheduling setup, report output discrepancy

* Data Quality \& Audit
+ Pre/post\-load data checks
+ Anomaly flagging
+ Access audit support
+ Audit\-ready documentation
+ Examples: Data check before mass load, access audit support

* Transversal
+ Knowledge base updates after every resolved ticket
+ Ticket coordination
+ SLA queue management
+ Examples: KB article update, monthly SLA queue review


**Competencies \& Skills**
* Workday Functional Knowledge (Working)
* 
+ Working knowledge of Workday HCM (Core HCM and/or Foundation)
+ Executes standard procedures and resolves common L1 tickets with guidance
+ Actively developing breadth across Rewards, People Success, and External Workforce

* Mass Data Management (Developing)
* 
+ Executes Workday mass data loads (EIBs / iLoads) using validated templates
+ Performs pre\-load checks and monitors results
+ Escalates errors with clear documentation
+ Building independence under senior supervision

* Workday Reporting (Basic → Developing)
* 
+ Runs, refreshes, and distributes existing Workday reports
+ Executes standard report requests following defined procedures
+ Learns to build Custom and Standard reports with guidance
+ Developing awareness of Matrix report types

* Data Accuracy \& Audit Support (High)
* 
+ Applies strong data quality standards across all activities
+ Validates information before action and flags anomalies immediately
+ Supports audits with accurate and timely documentation

* ServiceNow HRSD (Basic)
* 
+ Creates, manages, and updates HR cases
+ Follows HRSD workflows and uses the knowledge base before escalation
+ Ensures accurate categorisation and prioritisation

* AI Appetence \& Digital Mindset (Curious)
* 
+ Curious about AI\-enabled HR support
+ Documents resolutions to feed AI learning
+ Understands how knowledge quality impacts AI deflection

* Communication \& Customer Service (Strong)
* 
+ Clear, empathetic, and responsive with users
+ Escalates with structured context to reduce back\-and\-forth

* Collaboration \& Learning (Active)
* 
+ Works effectively within the team
+ Applies feedback proactively
+ Continuously develops Workday and HRIS knowledge


**Essential**
**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in HR operations, HRIS support, or shared services.
* Basic to working knowledge of Workday HCM (Core HCM or Foundation modules).
* Exposure to Workday mass data loads (EIBs / iLoads) or equivalent bulk data tools.
* Familiarity with Workday standard reporting: ability to run, refresh, and distribute reports.
* Exposure to a ticketing tool — ServiceNow HRSD experience is a strong advantage.
* Attention to detail and a structured approach to data entry, validation, and documentation.
* Fluent in English; additional languages are an asset.


**Preferred**
* Workday training or formal HR system education (HCM Fundamentals or equivalent).
* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow HRSD case management or HR knowledge base maintenance.
* GCC or shared services centre background (Hyderabad or Kuala Lumpur preferred).
* Interest in HR technology, AI\-enabled tools, or digital self\-service platforms.
* Basic awareness of data quality principles and HR data governance concepts.


**LEARNING \& GROWTH PATH**
**Role**
 This role is designed as a structured entry point into the Workday HRIS specialism at Opella. The following milestones outline the expected development journey:
   

  

**Month 1–2:** 
 Shadow senior colleagues on live tickets; complete Workday HCM Fundamentals training; execute first supervised mass data loads.
   

  

**Month 3–4:** 
 Handle standard Foundation and Core HCM tickets independently; run and refresh reports without guidance; maintain clean KB documentation after every resolved case.
   

  

**Month 5–6:** 
 Execute EIBs end\-to\-end with light supervision; build first Custom reports with coaching; demonstrate consistent SLA adherence on personal queue.
   

  

**Month 7–12:** 
 Handle the majority of L1 tickets independently; develop working knowledge of reporting types (Standard, Custom, Matrix); contribute meaningfully to AI knowledge base; receive recognition from the team lead for documentation quality.
   

  

**Year 2\+:** 
 Progress toward Senior Specialist responsibilities: lead complex Foundation tickets, own mass data cycles, build Advanced/Matrix reports, mentor incoming L1 colleagues.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
**✔** 
 Consistent SLA adherence on owned tickets with minimal escalations due to missing or incomplete information.
   

  

**✔** 
 Mass data loads executed accurately using validated templates; every load logged, documented, and reconciled with zero unresolved errors.
   

  

**✔** 
 Reports refreshed on schedule and distributed correctly; discrepancies escalated promptly with full context.
   

  

**✔** 
 Accurate, complete ticket and KB updates after every resolved case — audit\-ready at all times.
   

  

**✔** 
 Demonstrable growth in Workday functional, mass data, and reporting knowledge within the first 6 months.
   

  

**✔** 
 Active and consistent contribution to the AI knowledge base; resolution patterns documented clearly for OpellaGPT.
   

  

**✔** 
 Positive feedback from senior colleagues, team lead, and HR users on communication quality and responsiveness.
   

  

**✔** 
 Increasing independence and reduction in rework or back\-and\-forth escalations over the first year.
   

  

**Why us?**
 At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
   

  

**We Are Challengers.**
 We Are Dedicated To Making Self\-care As Simple As It Should Be. That Starts With Our Culture. We Are Challengers By Nature, And This Is How We Do Things
   

  

**All In Together:** 
 We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
   

  

**Courageous:** 
 We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.
   

  

**Outcome\-Obsessed:** 
 We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
   

  

**Radically Simple:** 
 We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.
   

  

 Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.

description:
**Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients.** 




**Who are we:** 




 Core Insurance Platforms (CIP) is Zurich’s global capability responsible for building, running, and evolving core insurance technology. We set a unified, scalable operating model—covering governance, standards, architecture, service delivery, and reuse—so our business units can deliver at speed and scale.
 



 CIP is the strategic steward of Zurich’s Guidewire ecosystem, aligning platform roadmaps to business strategy while driving stability, modernization, reduced supplier dependency, and long term cost efficiency.
 



 India delivery center is one of our global delivery and capability hub. We bring together experts in AI, engineering, analysis, quality, and architecture to deliver product \& process solutions, application run services, change and transformation initiatives, and centralized platform services across both on prem and Guidewire Cloud environments. Our teams operate from multiple global delivery centers, supporting Zurich’s business units worldwide.
 







**As a Data Scientist, your main tasks will involve:** 



* Understand business problems and structure analytical approaches to solve them.
* Generate proof of concepts from data that help deliver improved business results.
* Prepare and pre\-process datasets needed to deliver analytical solutions.
* Generate distinctive risk insights that deliver improved business results.
* Build and implement predictive models and other analytical solutions using both structured and unstructured data.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers, ML/AI Ops, and IT teams to deploy models into production environments and monitor models performance.
* Support communication of findings, implications, and performance of the models to business stakeholders.



  





**AI\-related expectations (in line with Zurich’s AI\-first approach):** 



* Use AI\-enabled tools and platforms, where available, across the data science lifecycle (for example, for data exploration, feature engineering, model experimentation, documentation support, and performance monitoring), while maintaining full accountability for the quality and robustness of models.
* Identify opportunities to redesign analytical workflows using automation, AI agents and generative AI, with a focus on reducing manual work and accelerating experimentation and deployment.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure that AI and ML solutions follow Zurich’s responsible AI principles, including transparency, fairness, robustness and appropriate human oversight.



  





**Your Skills and Experience:** 



* As a Data Scientist, your skills and experience will ideally include:
* University education (Bachelor’s degree or higher).
* Ideal for fresh graduates or students finishing their degree.
* Working knowledge of Python and basic data science packages.
* Passion working with data and developing insights for use in business decisions.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills from the following:
* Advanced knowledge of statistical and predictive modeling techniques such as machine learning models (GBM, Random Forest etc.), decision trees, probability networks, association rules, clustering, regression, GLMs, SVMs, HMMs, time series, survival analysis, and neural networks and their application to business decisions.
* Use state\-of\-the\-art deep learning approaches (e.g. CNN, transformer, RNN/LSTM/GRU, GCN/GNN) to extract value from massive amounts of unstructured data (text, images).
* Advanced knowledge of fine\-tuning (e.g. PEFT, LoRA, RLHF) and customizing large language models (e.g. GPT, BERT, Flan\-T5, Llama, Dolly, BART), embedding approaches (e.g. Word2Vec, t\-SNE), prompt engineering, and vectorization.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially the ability to translate technical results for business audiences.
* English – B2 or better.
* Experience with Azure and Databricks is an advantage.
* Experience with SQL and other programming languages is an advantage.
* Prior work experience in insurance is a plus



  





**AI\-related skills and mindset:** 



* Experience or clear interest in using AI\-supported tools (e.g. for data exploration, notebook assistance, code generation, experiment tracking or documentation) as part of day\-to\-day data science work.
* Ability to critically assess, validate and refine AI\-generated outputs (code, analyses, content) so they meet Zurich’s standards for quality, security and compliance.
* Curious and proactive mindset towards learning new AI capabilities, experimenting safely, and sharing best practices that improve efficiency, insight generation and model performance across the team.

title: GenAI Developer
description:
We are looking for an enthusiastic
 **Generative AI Developer** 
 to join our Controls Technology team and support the development and integration of generative AI solutions. In this hands\-on role, you will work under the guidance of senior developers and AI architects to help build retrieval\-grounded, context\-aware, and increasingly
 **agentic** 
 AI applications. You will contribute to reliable, AI\-driven features while growing your expertise across the modern GenAI stack. This role focuses on
 **applying pre\-trained and hosted foundation models** 
 — through context engineering, RAG, knowledge graphs, and agentic workflows — rather than training or fine\-tuning models.
   

  

 This is a growth\-oriented role: you'll take ownership of well\-scoped components, learn established patterns from senior engineers, and progressively increase your technical depth and independence.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Assist in building and integrating generative AI applications using pre\-trained and hosted foundation models (via managed GenAI APIs and open\-model endpoints).
* Support the implementation of context engineering workflows — assembling system instructions, retrieved knowledge, tool definitions, and conversation memory into reliable, token\-efficient prompts, following established patterns.
* Contribute to prompt engineering (zero\-shot, few\-shot, chain\-of\-thought, role\-based prompting) for AI\-powered workflows.
* Help develop and maintain Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) components, including chunking, embedding, and semantic/keyword search.
* Support the development of knowledge graph and Graph RAG pipelines under guidance to enable grounded, traceable responses.
* Contribute to agentic workflows — helping build AI agents with tool\-calling and basic planning/memory, using frameworks such as Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangGraph, or CrewAI.
* Assist with integrating agents to external tools and data sources via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), with exposure to the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol.
* Support the deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of GenAI and agentic applications in production environments.
* Perform data preprocessing, document ingestion, and basic API development for AI applications.
* Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to integrate AI capabilities into products.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, and documentation to ensure quality and reliability.
* Stay curious about advancements in GenAI and agentic AI, and share learnings with the team.


**Required Technical Skills**
* Proficiency in Python for GenAI development, data preprocessing, and scripting.
* Solid understanding of core generative AI concepts — foundation models, LLMs, tokenization, embeddings, and context windows.
* Hands\-on experience with prompt engineering; foundational understanding of context engineering techniques.
* Practical experience (project or professional) building RAG systems, including chunking, vector databases, and semantic search.
* Familiarity with knowledge graphs and interest in Graph RAG for relationship\-aware retrieval.
* Exposure to agentic AI development — building tool\-using agents or multi\-step workflows with a framework such as Google ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI, or the OpenAI Agents SDK.
* Awareness of agent tooling and protocols, including tool/function calling and the Model Context Protocol (MCP); familiarity with the A2A protocol is a plus.
* Basic understanding of agent harness concepts — session/state management, memory, and guardrails.
* Experience consuming major GenAI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Gemini, Claude) and exposure to orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex.
* Understanding of application deployment and containerization (Docker).
* Working knowledge of version control systems (Git).
* Awareness of AI compliance, data privacy, guardrails, and responsible AI principles.


**Required Soft Skills**
* Strong teamwork and communication abilities.
* Eagerness to learn new AI/GenAI and agentic technologies and frameworks.
* Analytical mindset and attention to detail.
* Openness to feedback, coaching, and continuous improvement.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or a related field.
* 4\+ years of experience with atleast 2–4 years of professional experience in software/AI development, with exposure to Generative AI and agentic AI.
* Experience contributing to AI/GenAI or software projects in a collaborative team setting.
* Exposure to cloud\-based AI/ML environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) is a plus.

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
**Position:** 
 Software Development Engineer (SDE)
 



**Team:** 
 Solutioning \& Integration
 



**Location:** 
 Gurgaon
 



**Experience:** 
 0–2 years
 



**Working Model:** 
 In\-office
 



**Role Type:** 
 Software Engineering \| Integrations \| Automation \| Solutioning
 



  





 QuickReply.ai is a cutting\-edge WhatsApp Marketing Automation platform built for e\-commerce businesses. In just 18 months, we’ve onboarded 700\+ global customers and achieved 15x revenue growth. As businesses rapidly shift from email and SMS to WhatsApp, we are building a category\-defining product in this space.
 



 Founded by IIT Delhi alumni, we raised seed funding in April 2023 and are now scaling our team.
 



 We help brands automate customer journeys across the buyer lifecycle — lead capture, abandoned cart recovery, customer support, order updates, retention, upsell, feedback, and more.
 



 Our platform works closely with systems like Shopify, CRMs, ERPs, payment gateways, logistics tools, custom backends, and WhatsApp Business APIs. As customers grow, their workflows become more complex. This is where our
 **Solutioning \& Integration team** 
 comes in.
 



  





**Role overview** 




 We are looking for a
 **Software Development Engineer (SDE)** 
 to join our
 **Solutioning \& Integration team** 
 .
 



 This is a software engineering role focused on building technical solutions that connect QuickReply with customer systems and business workflows. You will work across APIs, webhooks, integrations, automation workflows, data transformation, technical debugging, and custom engineering solutions.
 



 You will work closely with customers, CSMs, Product, and Engineering teams to understand technical requirements, design solutions, build integrations, troubleshoot issues, and take solutions from requirement to production.
 



 It is an engineering role with significant exposure to real\-world customer problems.
 



 The right person should be comfortable reading API documentation, working with JSON and webhooks, writing scripts, debugging technical issues, understanding data flows, and building pragmatic solutions quickly.
 



 You will act as the engineering layer between
 **customer requirements and working technical solutions** 
 , while also contributing learnings back to the product team.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




**Understand Customer Workflows** 




 You will work with customers and internal CSMs to understand how their business works and translate business requirements into technical flows.
 



 Examples:
 


* How do they capture leads?
* Where does customer data live?
* How do orders, checkouts, payments, shipments, or appointments get created?
* Which events should trigger WhatsApp messages?
* What data is needed to personalize a message?
* When should a bot hand over to a human?
* What should happen after a customer replies?



 Your job is to convert these business flows into clear, scalable technical flows.
   





**Design WhatsApp Automation Solutions** 




 You will help design end\-to\-end automation journeys using QuickReply.
 



 Examples:
 


* Abandoned cart recovery flow
* Order confirmation and payment collection flow
* COD confirmation and RTO reduction flow
* Lead qualification bot
* Appointment reminder flow
* Feedback/NPS collection flow
* Support triage bot
* CRM lead handover flow
* Shopify or custom cart automation flow



 You should be able to think through edge cases, fallbacks, customer replies, data requirements, and handover logic.
 



  





**Work on Integrations and APIs** 




 A major part of this role will involve building and configuring integrations between QuickReply and customer systems.
 

 You may work with:
 


* Shopify
* Custom e\-commerce websites
* CRMs like HubSpot, Salesforce, LeadSquared, Zoho, etc.
* ERPs or internal systems
* Payment gateways
* Logistics platforms
* Webhooks
* REST APIs
* Google Sheets / Airtable / internal tools
* Customer databases or custom backends



 You should be able to read API documentation, understand request/response formats, test APIs, map payloads, and coordinate with customer technical teams.
 



  





**Debug Customer Issues** 




 You will investigate and resolve technical issues across integrations and automation workflows.
 



 Examples:
 


* Webhook not received
* Wrong customer data coming in
* WhatsApp template not triggering
* Bot flow breaking at a specific step
* CRM lead not getting created
* Shopify event missing data
* API authentication failing
* Duplicate contact being created
* Incorrect order status being passed
* Customer replies not mapping correctly



 You should be comfortable using logs, payloads, Postman, browser tools, and internal dashboards to identify root causes and implement fixes.
 



  





**Build Small Scripts, Tools, and Custom Solutions** 




 Sometimes a customer may need something small but important that is not yet available directly on the platform.
 



 You may build:
 


* Data transformation scripts
* Webhook middleware
* Small internal tools
* API connectors
* Google Apps Script automations
* One\-time migration scripts
* Custom payload mappers
* Utility scripts for testing or monitoring
* Creating mini web apps for customers



 This is not about building large products from scratch. It is about solving technical problems quickly, cleanly, and reliably.
 



  





**Own Technical Go\-Lives** 





 You will be responsible for making sure customers go live smoothly from a technical perspective.
 




 This includes:
 


* Understanding requirements
* Preparing technical solution notes
* Coordinating with CSMs, Product, Engineering, and customer teams
* Testing flows before launch
* Monitoring initial go\-live
* Debugging issues quickly
* Documenting what was implemented
* Creating reusable learnings for future customers



 Success in this role means customers go live faster, with fewer technical escalations and better automation outcomes.
 



  





**Share Product and Engineering Feedback** 





 Because you will work closely with real customer workflows, you will identify repeated technical gaps and opportunities.
 




 You should actively share:
 


* Which integrations are repeatedly needed
* Which product flows are confusing
* Where customers get stuck
* Which manual work should be automated
* Which features can reduce implementation effort
* Which use cases can become reusable templates
* Which technical capabilities can make future integrations faster



 You will bring these learnings back to the Product and Engineering teams to help improve the platform.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




**Must Have** 



* 0–2 years of experience in software engineering, integration engineering, solution engineering, or a similar technical role
* Strong understanding of APIs, webhooks, JSON, HTTP methods, authentication, and basic system design
* Ability to write scripts or small applications using
 **JavaScript/Node.js or Python**
* Ability to debug technical issues logically and systematically
* Ability to understand business workflows and convert them into technical flows
* Comfortable working directly with customers and customer technical teams
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking skills
* High ownership and willingness to solve ambiguous problems
* Fast learner with a bias for action
* Excellent communication skills, particularly for explaining technical concepts clearly
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership startup environment
* Exposure to AI tools / LLM\-based workflows is preferred



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience with Shopify or e\-commerce platforms
* Experience with CRM tools like HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, or LeadSquared
* Experience with Postman, API testing, logs, and webhook debugging
* Basic understanding of WhatsApp Business API, messaging templates, bots, or customer engagement platforms
* Experience with Google Apps Script, Airtable, Zapier, Make, or similar automation tools
* Familiarity with databases and SQL
* Exposure to AI tools for faster coding, debugging, documentation, or solutioning



  





**What We're Looking For** 




**Strong Software Engineering Mindset** 




 Someone who enjoys building, debugging, testing, and shipping technical solutions rather than simply coordinating them.
 



  





**Builder Mindset** 





 Someone who can take a problem from
 
**understanding the requirement → designing the solution → writing code → testing → debugging → deploying** 

 .
 




  





**AI\-Native Approach** 





 A developer who actively leverages AI tools to accelerate coding, debugging, documentation, research, and solutioning while maintaining engineering quality and ownership.
 




  





**High Ownership** 





 Someone who takes responsibility for solving problems end\-to\-end instead of waiting for detailed instructions.
 




  





**Comfort With Ambiguity** 





 Real customer problems rarely come with perfectly defined requirements. You should be comfortable figuring things out, asking the right questions, and creating practical solutions.
 




  





**Strong Curiosity** 





 You should enjoy learning new APIs, systems, technologies, tools, and business workflows quickly.
 




  





**Customer Empathy** 





 While this is an engineering role, you will work directly with customers. You should be able to understand their problems, communicate clearly, and translate their requirements into technical solutions.
 




  





**Why This Role Is Different** 





 As a Software Development Engineer in the
 
**Solutioning \& Integration team** 

 , you will work on problems that sit at the intersection of:
 




**Software Engineering \+ APIs \+ Integrations \+ Automation \+ Customer Problems** 




 You will not be limited to writing code against predefined requirements.
 



 You will have the opportunity to:
 


* Work with real\-world technical problems
* Build integrations with different systems
* Design automation workflows
* Debug APIs and data flows
* Write custom scripts and tools
* Work directly with customer technical teams
* Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering
* Use AI to accelerate development
* See the solutions you build go directly into production



 If you enjoy building things, solving ambiguous technical problems, and working close to the real\-world use of software, this role is for you.
 



  





**Working Model** 




**5\-day work week with alternate Saturdays mandatory** 




  





**Location** 





 Our office is located in Gurgaon, and we are building an in\-office team.
 




**Office Address:** 
 Plot 23, Sector 18, Maruti Industrial Development Area, Gurugram, Haryana 122015

title: Founding engineer
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Founding Engineer based in India.**
 This is a high\-impact founding engineering opportunity for a hands\-on builder who wants to shape both product and engineering from an early stage.
   

  

 You will lead development of a web application and blockchain\-based infrastructure designed to accelerate scientific research and collaboration.
   

  

 The role combines software development, technical decision\-making, product thinking, and engineering leadership.
   

  

 You will work across modern web technologies and smart contracts while helping define scalable technical foundations.
   

  

 As the organization grows, you will play a key role in building an exceptional engineering team and establishing a strong engineering culture.
   

  

 The position offers significant autonomy, ownership, and influence over both the technology roadmap and product direction.
   

  

 It is ideal for an experienced engineer who is technically strong, collaborative, optimistic, and energized by building something ambitious from the ground up.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Lead the development and evolution of the web application, delivering high\-quality features aligned with product goals and user needs.
* Make and own engineering decisions that support the product roadmap, technical scalability, reliability, and long\-term maintainability.
* Contribute to the design and evolution of the platform's cryptoeconomic structure and reward mechanisms.
* Establish scalable engineering practices, development processes, and quality standards that enable the organization to grow effectively.
* Help shape the technical direction and product vision as a founding member of the engineering organization.
* Following product\-market fit, recruit, develop, and lead a high\-performing engineering team.
* Establish a strong engineering culture centered on quality, collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate closely with product and other stakeholders to translate ideas into reliable, scalable technology.


**Requirements**
* Proven experience building scalable, testable, and high\-quality web or mobile applications.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to make sound technical decisions in an evolving product environment.
* Demonstrated experience building or leading high\-quality engineering teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to communicate clearly, concisely, and thoughtfully.
* Strong ownership mentality and the ability to operate autonomously while maintaining alignment with broader product objectives.
* Humble, optimistic, energetic, and inspiring approach to collaboration and leadership.
* Experience with Django and React is highly desirable.
* Experience developing mobile applications with React Native is a plus.
* Experience writing Ethereum smart contracts and working with Solidity is a strong advantage.
* Familiarity with PostgreSQL and modern web application architectures is beneficial.


**Benefits**
* Founding\-level ownership and influence over product and engineering direction.
* Opportunity to shape an engineering organization and culture from an early stage.
* Remote working environment with the flexibility to contribute from Canada.
* Opportunity to work across web development, blockchain, smart contracts, and innovative technology.
* Significant autonomy in technical decision\-making and execution.
* Opportunity to help build products designed to accelerate scientific research and collaboration.
* Potential to grow into a key engineering leadership position as the organization scales.

The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre\-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR).  Bangalore, India
   

  

****Experience:****
 1\-3 Years
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are building a cutting\-edge technology platform and are looking for a highly motivated Back End Software Engineer to join our team in Bangalore, India. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in backend development, preferably with exposure to Financial Services, Real Assets (Oil \& Gas, Real Estate, etc.), or Fintech. Hands\-on experience with our technology stack—including Ruby on Rails, Kafka, Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Azure—is highly preferred.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Participate in the design, development, testing, and maintenance of backend services and APIs.
* Collaborate with senior engineers, front\-end developers, UX/UI designers, and other cross\-functional stakeholders to enhance product functionality and user experience.
* Assist in defining software requirements and technical solutions in collaboration with business and product teams.
* Participate in code reviews and follow engineering best practices, with a focus on clean, maintainable, and scalable code.
* Work with both SQL and NoSQL databases in cloud\-based environments such as Azure.
* Contribute to the development and improvement of CI/CD pipelines and engineering processes.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize backend applications and services.
* Continuously learn and stay current with emerging technologies, industry trends, and development best practices.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant professional experience will also be considered.
* 1\+ years of experience in backend software development.
* Strong experience building and maintaining scalable backend applications and services.
* Experience working in collaborative, cross\-functional engineering teams.


**Technical Skills**
****Programming Languages \& Frameworks****
* Strong proficiency in Ruby on Rails.
* Strong understanding of modern programming concepts, data structures, and software development fundamentals.


****Data Processing Libraries****

* PostgreSQL

****Cloud \& Containers****

****DevOps \& CI/CD****
* Experience working with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and modern software development practices.


 Web Development
   

  

* Extensive experience building, maintaining, and supporting web applications and backend APIs.


****Why Join Stronghold's Bangalore Team?****
 At Stronghold, you're not just another employee—you are part of our global team. We believe in nurturing talent, fostering innovation, and celebrating success together. With state\-of\-the\-art technology and a team of experienced industry professionals, Stronghold provides an environment for continuous growth, development, and learning.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Mission\-driven work
* Competitive compensation and bonus
* Comprehensive health and wellness benefits
* Opportunity to work with exceptionally smart peers
* Agile like a startup, grounded like an enterprise


****Equal Opportunity Employer****
 Stronghold Investment Management is an equal opportunity employer.
   

  

 We believe in creating a diverse and inclusive workforce where individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can thrive. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We encourage applicants from underrepresented groups to apply and welcome the unique perspectives and contributions they bring to our organization.

title: Software Engineer - Backend
description:
**About Impact Analytics**
 Impact Analytics is an agentic\-first AI software company transforming retail merchandising through cutting\-edge AI, LLMs, and Generative AI technologies. As a fast\-growing Series D company with deployments across five continents, it is building both industry\-leading merchandising solutions and foundational AI agents that are redefining how retail decisions are made.
   

  

 What makes Impact Analytics unique is its combination of deep retail domain expertise, strong innovation culture, and global presence. It is one of the few India\-born AI companies recognized globally by organizations like Fortune, Gartner, and the Inc. 5000\.
   

  

 For candidates looking to work on next\-generation AI products with global scale and real\-world impact, Impact Analytics is an exciting place to build your career. Here’s a link to our website: www.impactanalytics.co.
   

  

**The impact that you will be making**
 The role would require you to develop sophisticated products that add value to the client and result in new projects and revenue streams.
   

  

**What Lands You In This Role**
**Must Have**
* 1\-3 years of experience in Backend development (C\+\+, Golang/Python/Rust).
* Expertise in at least one of Django, Flask or FastAPI
* Strong coder with object\-oriented design skills and knowledge of design patterns.
* Having exposure in AI/ML, distributed systems is highly desired.
* Knowledge of key\-value stores, caching, search, and messaging queues.
* Critical thinker with a research\-oriented mindset.


**Good to have**
* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with Linux\-like operating systems.


**What We Offer**
* An opportunity to develop some of the best enterprise SaaS products to be built out of India
* Opportunities to quench your thirst for problem\-solving, experimenting, learning, and implementing innovative solutions
* A flat, collegial work environment, with a work hard, play hard attitude
* A platform for rapid growth if you are willing to try new things without fear of failure.
* Remuneration with best in class industry standards with generous health insurance cover


**Some Of Our Accolades Include**
* Ranked as one of America's Fastest\-Growing Companies by Financial Times for five consecutive years: 2020\-2024\.
* Ranked as one of America's Fastest\-Growing Private Companies by Inc. 5000 for seven consecutive years: 2018\-2024\.
* Voted \#1 by more than 300 retailers worldwide in the RIS Software LeaderBoard 2024 report.
* Ranked \#72 in America’s Most Innovative Companies list in 2023—by Fortune— alongside companies like Microsoft, Tesla, Apple, IBM, etc.
* Forged a strategic partnership with Google to equip retailers with cutting\-edge generative AI tools.
* Recognized in multiple Gartner reports, including Market Guides and Hype Cycle, spanning assortments, merchandising, forecasting, algorithmic retailing, and Unified Price, Promotion, and Markdown Optimization Applications.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
UnknwnAI is looking for a Mid\-Level Full Stack Developer to join our growing engineering team.
 



 We develop modern software across SaaS, enterprise systems, healthcare technology, AI, integrations and business\-critical applications. We work across a broad technology landscape, so we are looking for a developer with strong full\-stack fundamentals who is comfortable working beyond a single framework or language.
 



 This role is suited to someone with approximately 3\+ years of professional software development experience who can contribute across frontend, backend, databases, APIs and integrations, while continuing to broaden their technical capabilities.
 



 You should be comfortable taking a requirement or problem, understanding the wider context, designing an appropriate solution and seeing it through to a reliable production implementation.
 



  





**What you will be doing:** 



* Designing, developing and maintaining full\-stack applications
* Building modern frontend applications and user interfaces
* Developing backend services, APIs and business logic
* Designing and working with relational databases
* Writing efficient SQL queries and working with complex data
* Building integrations with third\-party services, platforms and APIs
* Working across new applications as well as established production systems
* Taking features from initial requirements through development, testing and deployment
* Investigating application, API, database and infrastructure issues
* Debugging problems across multiple layers of a system rather than treating symptoms in isolation
* Contributing to application architecture and technical design decisions
* Improving performance, scalability, maintainability and reliability
* Implementing appropriate authentication, authorization and security controls
* Working with cloud\-hosted applications and services
* Participating in code reviews and helping maintain engineering standards
* Writing clear, maintainable and reusable code
* Working collaboratively with developers and other members of the business
* Contributing ideas and proposing better technical approaches where appropriate
* Learning and working with unfamiliar technologies where a project requires them



  





**Essential:** 



* Around 3\+ years of professional software development experience
* Strong understanding of full\-stack software development
* Good experience building modern web applications
* Strong programming fundamentals and understanding of software design principles
* Commercial experience with at least one modern frontend framework such as React, Next.js, Vue or Angular
* Experience developing backend applications, APIs or services
* Experience with backend technologies such as Node.js, TypeScript/JavaScript, C\#/.NET, Python, Java or similar
* Strong understanding of REST APIs and application integrations
* Good knowledge of SQL and relational databases
* Experience with databases such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL or similar
* Understanding of data modelling and relational database design
* Good knowledge of HTML, CSS and modern frontend development
* Experience using Git within a collaborative development environment
* Understanding of authentication, authorization and common web security principles
* Ability to debug problems across frontend, backend, API and database layers
* Ability to understand and work confidently within existing codebases
* Ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions
* Good understanding of application architecture and separation of concerns
* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Good attention to detail and a disciplined approach to testing your own work
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Ability to work independently while remaining closely connected with the wider team
* Availability to work standard UK business hours



  





**Our Current Technology Landscape:** 




 Our technology varies between products and projects and will continue to evolve.
 



 Technologies we currently work with include:
 


* TypeScript
* JavaScript
* Next.js
* React
* Node.js
* Tailwind CSS
* PostgreSQL
* Microsoft SQL Server
* Python
* C\# / .NET
* REST APIs
* AWS
* Microsoft Azure
* Docker
* GitHub



 Experience with every technology above is not required.
 



 We are more interested in developers who have strong engineering fundamentals and can confidently move between technologies than someone whose experience is limited to one specific framework.
 



  





**Useful Additional Experience:** 




 Experience in any of the following would be beneficial:
 


* AWS or Microsoft Azure
* Cloud application architecture
* Docker and containerized environments
* CI/CD pipelines
* Automated testing
* Redis or other caching technologies
* RabbitMQ, message queues or event\-driven systems
* Background jobs and asynchronous processing
* Microservices or distributed systems
* SaaS and multi\-tenant application architecture
* Third\-party API integrations
* E\-commerce or marketplace integrations
* ERP or complex business management systems
* Healthcare technology
* AI and LLM integrations
* Authentication and identity platforms
* Performance optimization
* Application monitoring and logging
* Legacy system integration or modernization
* Secure software development
* High\-availability or business\-critical systems



  





**What we expect from our Developer:** 




  





**Ownership** 




 You should be comfortable taking responsibility for a piece of work from beginning to end.
 



 That includes understanding the problem, identifying dependencies, considering edge cases, implementing the solution, testing it properly and making sure the finished result actually meets the requirement.
 



  





**Problem Solving** 




 Software development frequently involves unfamiliar problems.
 



 We expect developers to investigate issues properly, read documentation, understand existing code, test assumptions and work methodically towards the root cause.
 



 Knowing everything is not expected.
 



 Being capable of finding things out is.
 



  





**Engineering Judgement** 




 There is rarely only one way to build something.
 



 We value developers who can consider maintainability, performance, security, complexity and delivery time before choosing an approach.
 



 We also want people who are comfortable questioning an existing approach when they can explain why another solution would be better.
 



  





**Communication** 




 Our team works remotely, so communication is important.
 



 We expect developers to:
 


* Raise blockers early
* Ask questions when requirements genuinely need clarification
* Communicate progress clearly
* Explain technical decisions
* Flag potential risks before they become problems
* Work collaboratively rather than disappearing into tasks



  





**Quality** 




 Speed matters, but not at the expense of reliability.
 



 Developers should care about:
 


* Clean and maintainable code
* Appropriate testing
* Error handling
* Security
* Performance
* Edge cases
* Data integrity
* The wider impact of changes to a system



  





**Adaptability** 




 We do not want developers whose capability begins and ends with one framework.
 



 Technology changes, projects have different requirements and sometimes the correct solution involves working in an unfamiliar part of the stack.
 



 You should be willing and able to learn.
 



  





**Why Join UnknwnAI?** 



* Work across a broad range of technically challenging software
* Build both new applications and major functionality for established systems
* Gain exposure across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, integrations and cloud infrastructure
* Work with different technologies rather than being restricted to a single framework
* Have meaningful input into technical decisions
* Take genuine ownership of features and systems
* Work directly with a growing engineering team without unnecessary layers of management
* Develop experience across SaaS, enterprise software, healthcare technology, AI and complex business systems
* Join a growing company where your responsibilities and technical scope can expand significantly over time



  





**How to Apply:** 




 Please submit your CV along with your GitHub profile, portfolio or examples of relevant technical work, where available.
 



 During the interview process, we will focus on what you personally contributed to previous projects, how you approach technical problems and how well you understand the systems you have worked on.
 



 We are less interested in how many technologies appear on your CV but more interested on whether you can demonstrate strong engineering fundamentals, genuine hands\-on experience and the ability to learn and solve problems effectively.

title: SDE 2/3 — AI Engineer, Digital Production (GenAI × 3D × Agents)
description:
**Role Overview** 




  





 Metadome.ai builds frontier AI that turns text, drawings, and CAD into production\-ready, interactive 3D — powering immersive product experiences and aftersales modernization for 30\+ automotive and heavy\-equipment manufacturers, including Stellantis, Lexus, Mahindra, MG Motor, Asian Paints, and Titan.
 



  





 We're now building Digital Production, a new marketing AI platform that replaces days of manual 3D content work — asset identification, material assignment, shot composition, lighting, rendering — with generative models and agents that drive tools like Blender and Unreal Engine directly. As one of the founding engineers on this platform, you'll set the technical bar for how it's built — agentic workflows, AI\-assisted development, aggressive automation, tight eval loops — with a direct line to the CTO.
 



 This role calls for a 100x, agentic mindset: if you've done something twice by hand, you script it or build an agent for it. You treat AI tools as force multipliers and own their output completely. Prototype to production is one motion for you — ship fast, measure, iterate — and you default to ownership, finding problems and closing them without being asked.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Own generative AI, computer\-vision, and diffusion\-model features end\-to\-end, carrying each one from prototype through production, evaluation, and iteration.
* Design and ship agentic systems — built on LangGraph and MCP — that drive Blender and Unreal Engine through Python to automate asset preparation, material assignment, shot composition, lighting, and rendering.
* Build the infrastructure around the models: model serving and backend services and APIs in Python (FastAPI), Go, and Node.js, deployed on GCP (Cloud Run, serverless, and GPU workers) and backed by PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and Neo4j — with evals powered by RAG pipelines and LangSmith/Ragas, observability through Prometheus and Grafana, and modern web frontends where needed.
* Work directly with 3D and geometric data — meshes, materials, cameras, lighting, and render pipelines — to bring the pipeline to production quality.
* Break ambiguous, research\-flavored problems into shippable increments, measuring quality with evals rather than intuition.
* Raise the technical bar around you as a hands\-on individual contributor — through code reviews, internal demos, mentoring, and disciplined CI/CD practice via GitHub Actions and Cloud Build.



  





  





**Requirements** 




**Experience \& Background** 



* \~3–7 years shipping and maintaining production software, with a track record of end\-to\-end ownership.
* Hands\-on production experience with LLM systems (RAG, tool use / function calling, agents) and/or diffusion or vision models — shipped systems, not notebooks.
* Strong grounding in training, evaluating, and deploying models against real quality and latency bars.
* Proficiency in Python (FastAPI) plus Go or Node.js, a modern frontend framework, cloud experience (GCP preferred), and solid CI/CD habits.
* Daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) — with rigorous verification, testing, and ownership of every line you ship.
* Comfort building golden datasets, grading trajectory vs. outcome, and enforcing quality gates in CI.



  





**Tools \& Technologies** 




**Core Stack** 



* Python (FastAPI), Go, Node.js
* GCP — Cloud Run, serverless, GPU workers
* LangGraph, MCP, RAG \+ evals (LangSmith/Ragas)
* Diffusion \& vision models
* Blender \& Unreal Engine
* PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Neo4j
* Prometheus/Grafana, GitHub Actions/Cloud Build



  





**Good to Have** 



* 3D/graphics programming: WebGL/OpenGL, GLSL shaders, rendering pipelines, performance profiling (draw calls, instancing, culling)
* Blender or Unreal Engine Python scripting; any DCC/3D pipeline automation
* Generative 3D/CAD exposure: text\-to\-CAD, 2D\-to\-3D reconstruction, controllable/conditioned generation
* Backend depth: resiliency patterns (circuit breakers, retries), security\-first API design (OAuth2/JWT), GitOps
* Research output, patents, hackathon wins, or open\-source contributions



  





**Role Benefits \& Growth** 




 You will take founding\-level ownership of a brand\-new AI product with real enterprise pull — 30\+ OEM customers from day one.
 



  





 This is an AI\-native environment by default, with model access and compute budgets built in and full backing to reach for the best available tools — a clean slate with no legacy system to maintain, and the opportunity to help define the engineering patterns everyone who joins after you will follow.
